### FOR EACH SHAPE: PRISM

The `Prism` shape (`[Shape("Prism")] public class Prism : Shape`) creates a 5-sided triangular prism primitive stretched along the Z-axis.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- The `Prism` shape has no shape-specific properties. `SetParametersToBuiltInShape()` and `CopyShape(Shape shape)` are empty no-op methods.
- The editor property drawer `PrismDrawer` provides an empty `OnGUI` implementation.

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Dimension setup: `meshSize = Math.Abs(size)`, `baseY = new Vector3(0, meshSize.y / 2f, 0)`, `meshSize.y *= 2f`.
- 6 template vertices:
  - Front triangle: `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(-0.5f, 0f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [0], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0.5f, 0f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [1], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0f, 0.5f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [2].
  - Back triangle: `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(-0.5f, 0f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [3], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0.5f, 0f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [4], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0f, 0.5f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [5].
- 18 vertices `v`:
  - Front triangle (3 verts): `template[0]`, `template[1]`, `template[2]`.
  - Right slope quad (4 verts): `template[1]`, `template[4]`, `template[2]`, `template[5]`.
  - Back triangle (3 verts): `template[4]`, `template[3]`, `template[5]`.
  - Left slope quad (4 verts): `template[3]`, `template[0]`, `template[5]`, `template[2]`.
  - Bottom quad (4 verts): `template[0]`, `template[1]`, `template[3]`, `template[4]`.
- 5 Face instances `f`:
  - Front: `Face(new int[3] { 2, 1, 0 })`
  - Right side: `Face(new int[6] { 5, 4, 3, 5, 6, 4 })`
  - Back: `Face(new int[3] { 9, 8, 7 })`
  - Left side: `Face(new int[6] { 12, 11, 10, 12, 13, 11 })`
  - Bottom: `Face(new int[6] { 14, 15, 16, 15, 17, 16 })`
- Scaling and orientation: `v[i] = Vector3.Scale(rotation * v[i], sizeSigns)`.
- Parity check: If `sizeSign < 0`, reverses all faces via `face.Reverse()`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.

### FOR EACH SHAPE: SPHERE

The `Sphere` shape (`[Shape("Sphere")] public class Sphere : Shape`) creates an icosphere based on recursive triangle subdivision of a regular icosahedron.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Subdivisions` (`int`): `[Range(1, 5)] [SerializeField]`, default `3` (built-in preset `2`). Number of recursive subdivisions applied to each icosahedron triangle.
- `m_BottomMostVertexIndex` (`int`): Runtime index of the lowest vertex on the Y-axis.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` on all faces.

2. Static Template Geometry:
- `k_IcosphereVertices` (`Vector3[12]`): Built using the golden ratio `Math.phi = (1 + Mathf.Sqrt(5f)) / 2f` (~1.618034f): `(-1, phi, 0)`, `(1, phi, 0)`, `(-1, -phi, 0)`, `(1, -phi, 0)`, `(0, -1, phi)`, `(0, 1, phi)`, `(0, -1, -phi)`, `(0, 1, -phi)`, `(phi, 0, -1)`, `(phi, 0, 1)`, `(-phi, 0, -1)`, `(-phi, 0, 1)`.
- `k_IcosphereTriangles` (`int[60]`): 20 triangular faces forming a regular icosahedron.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Generates base icosahedron vertices: `v[i] = k_IcosphereVertices[k_IcosphereTriangles[i]].normalized * radius` (`radius = 0.5f`).
- Recursive subdivision loop (`m_Subdivisions` times):
  - `SubdivideIcosahedron(v, radius)` splits each triangle `(p0, p2, p5)` into 4 smaller triangles using normalized midpoint vectors: `p1 = ((p0 + p2) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`, `p3 = ((p0 + p5) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`, `p4 = ((p2 + p5) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`.
  - Produces 4 triangles: `(p0, p1, p3)`, `(p1, p2, p4)`, `(p1, p4, p3)`, `(p3, p4, p5)`.
- Face construction: Allocates `Face[v.Length / 3]` with `smoothingGroup = m_Smooth ? 1 : 0`, `manualUV = false`.
- Tracks `m_BottomMostVertexIndex` by scanning for lowest vertex on Y.
- Projection texture groups: For each face, computes face normal via `Math.Normal` and assigns `textureGroup` based on `Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis(nrm)`:
  - `ProjectionAxis.X` -> `2`
  - `ProjectionAxis.Y` -> `3`
  - `ProjectionAxis.Z` -> `4`
  - `ProjectionAxis.XNegative` -> `5`
  - `ProjectionAxis.YNegative` -> `6`
  - `ProjectionAxis.ZNegative` -> `7`
- UV unwrapping: `mesh.unwrapParameters = new UnwrapParameters() { packMargin = 30f }`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.

### FOR EACH SHAPE: SPRITE

The `Sprite` shape (`[Shape("Sprite")] public class Sprite : Shape`) creates a 1x1 quad plane mesh on the XZ plane.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- The `Sprite` shape has no shape-specific properties. `SetParametersToBuiltInShape()` and `CopyShape(Shape shape)` are empty no-op methods.
- The editor property drawer `SpriteDrawer` provides an empty `OnGUI` implementation.

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- `meshSize = Math.Abs(size)`.
- Degenerate dimension check: If `meshSize.x < float.Epsilon || meshSize.z < float.Epsilon`, clears the mesh and returns an empty `Bounds()`.
- 4 2D quad vertices: `p[0] = (-width / 2f, -height / 2f)`, `p[1] = (width / 2f, -height / 2f)`, `p[2] = (-width / 2f, height / 2f)`, `p[3] = (width / 2f, height / 2f)`.
- 1 quad Face with 6 triangle indices: `Face(new int[6] { 0, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2 })`.
- 3D vertex mapping: `v[i] = new Vector3(p[i].y, 0f, p[i].x)`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.

### FOR EACH SHAPE: STAIRS

The `Stairs` shape (`[Shape("Stairs")] public class Stairs : Shape`) creates straight or curved staircases with configurable step heights, step counts, side walls, and curvature.

1. Enums and Configurable Parameters:
- `StepGenerationType` enum:
  - `Height`: Predictable fixed step height, automatically adapts the number of steps to match the bounding height.
  - `Count`: Fixed number of steps regardless of staircase height.
- `m_StepGenerationType` (`StepGenerationType`): `[SerializeField]`, default `StepGenerationType.Count`.
- `m_StepsHeight` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.2f` (built-in preset `0.4f`). Height of each step when `m_StepGenerationType == StepGenerationType.Height`.
- `m_StepsCount` (`int`): `[Range(1, 256)] [SerializeField]`, default `10` (built-in preset `6`). Step count when `m_StepGenerationType == StepGenerationType.Count`.
- `m_HomogeneousSteps` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Forces every step to have identical rounded height.
- `m_Circumference` (`float`): `[Range(-360, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `0f` (built-in preset `0f`). Curvature of staircase in degrees (0 = straight stairs, positive = right turn, negative = left turn).
- `m_Sides` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Generates side and back wall polygons.
- `m_InnerRadius` (`float`): `[Min(0f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0f`. Distance from center to inner edge of curved stairs.

2. Straight Stairs Algorithm (`BuildStairs`):
- Calculates step count and step height: If `useStepHeight`, `steps = (int)(stairsHeight / stepsHeight)`. Clamped to `256`.
- Quad generation: 2 quads (8 vertices) per step:
  - Riser quad: `(x0, y0, z0)`, `(x1, y0, z0)`, `(x0, y1, z0)`, `(x1, y1, z0)`.
  - Tread quad: `(x0, y1, z0)`, `(x1, y1, z0)`, `(x0, y1, z1)`, `(x1, y1, z1)`.
- Side walls (if `sides`): For each side (0 and 1), constructs stepped wall quads and connecting triangles (`i > 0`) with `textureGroup = side + 1`.
- Back wall: Full quad at `z = meshSize.z`.
- Points rotated and scaled by `sizeSigns`. Reverses faces if `sizeSign < 0`.

3. Curved Stairs Algorithm (`BuildCurvedStairs`):
- `cir = Mathf.Abs(circumference) * Mathf.Deg2Rad`, `outerRadius = innerRadius + stairWidth`.
- Per step `i` from `0` to `steps - 1`:
  - Riser quad (4 verts): `v0 * innerRadius`, `v0 * outerRadius`, `v0 * innerRadius (at h1)`, `v0 * outerRadius (at h1)`.
  - Tread quad: 3 vertices if `noInnerSide` (`innerRadius < Epsilon`), 4 vertices otherwise.
  - Tread UV rotation: `uvRotation = ((inc1 + inc0) * -0.5f) * Mathf.Rad2Deg; uvRotation %= 360f; if (uvRotation < 0f) uvRotation = 360f + uvRotation; faces[t+1].uv.rotation = uvRotation`.
- Curved side walls: Generates inner and outer curved wall strips with quad + triangle pairs per step.
- Negative angle handling: If `circumference < 0f`, flips X axis (`new Vector3(-1f, 1f, 1f)`) and reverses face windings.
- Centering: `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, mesh.transform.TransformDirection(-mesh.mesh.bounds.center))` and `mesh.Refresh()`.

### FOR EACH SHAPE: TORUS

The `Torus` shape (`[Shape("Torus")] public class Torus : Shape`) constructs a donut-shaped parametric torus mesh formed by revolving a circular tube cross-section along an elliptical path.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Rows` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)] [SerializeField]`, default `16` (built-in preset `12`). Number of faces defining the tube's cross-sectional circumference.
- `m_Columns` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)] [SerializeField]`, default `24` (built-in preset `16`). Number of slices defining the torus's revolution path.
- `m_TubeRadius` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.1f` (built-in preset `0.3f`). Radius of the revolving tube cross-section in meters.
- `m_HorizontalCircumference` (`float`): `[Range(0, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `360f` (built-in preset `360f`). Sweep angle of the torus revolution in degrees.
- `m_VerticalCircumference` (`float`): `[Range(0, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `360f` (built-in preset `360f`). Sweep angle of the tube cross-section in degrees.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Enables smoothing group `1` on torus faces.

2. Cross-Section Helper Methods (`GetCirclePoints`):
- Overload 1: `GetCirclePoints(int segments, float radius, float circumference, Quaternion rotation, float offset)` evaluates 2D circle points along the vertical circumference and rotates them by `rotation` with an X offset.
- Overload 2: `GetCirclePoints(int segments, float radius, float circumference, Quaternion rotation, Vector3 offset)` rotates 2D circle points and adds a 3D `offset` vector.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Clamping parameters: `clampedRows = Mathf.Clamp(m_Rows + 1, 4, 128)`, `clampedColumns = Mathf.Clamp(m_Columns + 1, 4, 128)`, `clampedTubeRadius = Mathf.Clamp(m_TubeRadius, 0.01f, Mathf.Min(xOuterRadius, yOuterRadius) - 0.001f)`.
- Revolution loop (`i` from `1` to `clampedColumns - 1`):
  - Angle: `angle = (i / (float)col) * clampedHorizontalCircumference`.
  - Ellipse coordinate: `ellipseCoord = new Vector2(xOuterRadius * Mathf.Cos(Deg2Rad * angle), yOuterRadius * Mathf.Sin(Deg2Rad * angle))`.
  - Tangent direction: `tangent = new Vector2(-ellipseCoord.y / (yOuterRadius * yOuterRadius), ellipseCoord.x / (xOuterRadius * xOuterRadius))`.
  - Slice rotation: `rot = Quaternion.Euler(Vector3.up * Vector2.SignedAngle(Vector2.up, tangent.normalized))`.
  - Evaluates circle slice `cir = GetCirclePoints(clampedRows, clampedTubeRadius, clampedVerticalCircumference, rot, new Vector3(ellipseCoord.x, 0, -ellipseCoord.y))`.
- Face mesh generation: Connects adjacent slices `(i, i+1)` into quads: `Face(new int[] { a, b, c, b, d, c })` with `smoothingGroup = m_Smooth ? 1 : -1`, `manualUV = true`.
- Transformed by `rotation`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(vertices, faces)`.
- Centering: `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, mesh.transform.TransformDirection(-mesh.mesh.bounds.center))` and `mesh.Refresh()`.
- Box project UVs: `UVEditing.ProjectFacesBox(mesh, mesh.facesInternal)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.

### SHAPE GENERATOR (LEGACY)

The `ShapeGenerator` class (`public static class ShapeGenerator` in namespace `UnityEngine.ProBuilder`) provides the legacy static API for generating primitive `ProBuilderMesh` instances directly without requiring the `ProBuilderShape` component.

1. ShapeType Enum:
- `ShapeType` enum defines: `Cube`, `Stair`, `CurvedStair`, `Prism`, `Cylinder`, `Plane`, `Door`, `Pipe`, `Cone`, `Sprite`, `Arch`, `Sphere`, `Torus`.

2. Central Dispatch Method:
- `public static ProBuilderMesh CreateShape(ShapeType shape, PivotLocation pivotType = PivotLocation.Center)`: Dispatches to the corresponding static generation method with default parameters, sets `pb.gameObject.name = shape.ToString()`, and assigns `pb.renderer.sharedMaterial = BuiltinMaterials.defaultMaterial`.

3. Static Primitive Generation Methods and Parameters:
- `GenerateCube(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size)`: Creates a cube from `k_CubeVertices` and `k_CubeTriangles`. If `pivotType == PivotLocation.Center`, sets UV offset `face.uv.offset = new Vector2(-0.5f, -0.5f)`. Sets pivot via `mesh.SetPivot(pivotType)`.
- `GenerateStair(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size, int steps, bool buildSides)`: Generates straight stairs with `steps` count, riser/tread quads, optional side walls and back face.
- `GenerateCurvedStair(PivotLocation pivotType, float stairWidth, float height, float innerRadius, float circumference, int steps, bool buildSides)`: Generates curved radial stairs with angular sweep `circumference`.
- `GenerateStair(PivotLocation pivotType, int steps, float width, float height, float depth, bool sidesGoToFloor, bool generateBack, bool platformsOnly)`: Internal legacy overload supporting `sidesGoToFloor` and `platformsOnly` toggles.
- `GeneratePrism(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size)`: Creates a triangular prism using 6 template vertices and 5 faces.
- `GenerateCylinder(PivotLocation pivotType, int axisDivisions, float radius, float height, int heightCuts, int smoothing = -1)`: Generates a cylinder with even `axisDivisions` (clamped <= 64), `heightCuts`, and top/bottom fans.
- `GeneratePlane(PivotLocation pivotType, float width, float height, int widthCuts, int heightCuts, Axis axis)`: Generates a subdivided plane oriented along normal axis `Axis.Right`, `Axis.Left`, `Axis.Up`, `Axis.Down`, `Axis.Forward`, or `Axis.Backward`.
- `GenerateDoor(PivotLocation pivotType, float totalWidth, float totalHeight, float ledgeHeight, float legWidth, float depth)`: Generates a doorframe with 5 front quads, 5 back quads, and 3 inner frame quads.
- `GeneratePipe(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, float height, float thickness, int subdivAxis, int subdivHeight)`: Generates outer/inner pipe walls and rim faces. If `pivotType != PivotLocation.Center`, centers pivot on vertex 1 via `pb.CenterPivot(new int[1] { 1 })`.
- `GenerateCone(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, float height, int subdivAxis)`: Generates a cone with base ring, side triangles, and bottom fan, applying manual UV unwrapping projected with `Vector3.up`.
- `GenerateArch(PivotLocation pivotType, float angle, float radius, float width, float depth, int radialCuts, bool insideFaces, bool outsideFaces, bool frontFaces, bool backFaces, bool endCaps)`: Generates an arch with configurable face visibility flags.
- `GenerateIcosahedron(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, int subdivisions, bool weldVertices = true, bool manualUvs = true)`: Generates an icosphere with optional vertex welding (`SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions`) and directional projection texture groups (`ProjectionAxis.X` through `ZNegative`).
- `GenerateTorus(PivotLocation pivotType, int rows, int columns, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, bool smooth, float horizontalCircumference, float verticalCircumference, bool manualUvs = false)`: Generates a torus with parametric revolution.

        /// <returns>A new GameObject with the ProBuilderMesh initialized to the primitve shape.</returns>
        public static ProBuilderMesh CreateShape(ShapeType shape, PivotLocation pivotType = PivotLocation.Center)
        {
            ProBuilderMesh pb = null;

            if (shape == ShapeType.Cube)
                pb = GenerateCube(pivotType, Vector3.one);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Stair)
                pb = GenerateStair(pivotType, new Vector3(2f, 2.5f, 4f), 6, true);
            if (shape == ShapeType.CurvedStair)
                pb = GenerateCurvedStair(pivotType, 2f, 2.5f, 2f, 180f, 8, true);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Prism)
                pb = GeneratePrism(pivotType, Vector3.one);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Cylinder)
                pb = GenerateCylinder(pivotType, 8, 1f, 2f, 2);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Plane)
                pb = GeneratePlane(pivotType, 5f, 5f, 5, 5, Axis.Up);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Door)
                pb = GenerateDoor(pivotType, 3f, 2.5f, .5f, .75f, 1f);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Pipe)
                pb = GeneratePipe(pivotType, 1f, 2f, .25f, 8, 2);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Cone)
                pb = GenerateCone(pivotType, .5f, 1f, 8);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Sprite)
                pb = GeneratePlane(pivotType, 1f, 1f, 0, 0, Axis.Up);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Arch)
                pb = GenerateArch(pivotType, 180f, 2f, 1f, 1f, 9, true, true, true, true, true);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Sphere)
                pb = GenerateIcosahedron(pivotType, .5f, 2, true, false);
            if (shape == ShapeType.Torus)
            {
                pb = GenerateTorus(pivotType, 12, 16, 1f, .3f, true, 360f, 360f, true);
                UVEditing.ProjectFacesBox(pb, pb.facesInternal);
            }

            if (pb == null)
            {
#if DEBUG
                Log.Error(shape.ToString() + " type has no default!");
#endif
                pb = GenerateCube(pivotType, Vector3.one);
            }

            pb.gameObject.name = shape.ToString();
            pb.renderer.sharedMaterial = BuiltinMaterials.defaultMaterial;

            return pb;
        }

        public static ProBuilderMesh GenerateCube(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size)
        {
            Vector3[] points = new Vector3[k_CubeTriangles.Length];

            for (int i = 0; i < k_CubeTriangles.Length; i++)
                points[i] = Vector3.Scale(k_CubeVertices[k_CubeTriangles[i]], size);

            ProBuilderMesh mesh = ProBuilderMesh.CreateInstanceWithPoints(points);
            mesh.gameObject.name = "Cube";

            if(pivotType == PivotLocation.Center)
                foreach (var face in mesh.facesInternal)
                    face.uv = new AutoUnwrapSettings(face.uv) { offset = new Vector2(-.5f, -.5f) };

            mesh.SetPivot(pivotType);

            return mesh;
        }

        public static ProBuilderMesh GenerateIcosahedron(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, int subdivisions, bool weldVertices = true, bool manualUvs = true)
        {
            // http://blog.andreaskahler.com/2009/06/creating-icosphere-mesh-in-code.html

            Vector3[] v = new Vector3[k_IcosphereTriangles.Length];

            // Regular Icosahedron - 12 vertices, 20 faces.
            for (int i = 0; i < k_IcosphereTriangles.Length; i += 3)
            {
                v[i + 0] = k_IcosphereVertices[k_IcosphereTriangles[i + 0]].normalized * radius;
                v[i + 1] = k_IcosphereVertices[k_IcosphereTriangles[i + 1]].normalized * radius;
                v[i + 2] = k_IcosphereVertices[k_IcosphereTriangles[i + 2]].normalized * radius;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; i++)
            {
                v = SubdivideIcosahedron(v, radius);
            }

            Face[] f = new Face[v.Length / 3];

            Vector3 bottomMostVertexPosition = Vector3.positiveInfinity;
            int bottomMostVertexIndex = -1;

            for (int i = 0; i < v.Length; i += 3)
            {
                f[i / 3] = new Face(new int[3] { i, i + 1, i + 2 });
                f[i / 3].manualUV = manualUvs;

                // Get the bottom most vertex of the whole shape. We'll use it as a pivot point.
                for (int j = 0; j < f[i / 3].indexes.Count; ++j)
                {
                    int index = f[i / 3].indexes[j];

                    if (v[index].y < bottomMostVertexPosition.y)
                    {
                        bottomMostVertexPosition = v[index];
                        bottomMostVertexIndex = index;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!manualUvs)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < f.Length; i++)
                {
                    var nrm = Math.Normal(v[f[i].indexesInternal[0]], v[f[i].indexesInternal[1]], v[f[i].indexesInternal[2]]);
                    var axis = Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis(nrm);

## D02: Draw shape tool, edit shape tool, shape state machines

### DRAW TOOL STATE MACHINE

The shape creation workflow in ProBuilder is governed by a finite state machine architecture centered around the abstract base class `ShapeState` and three concrete state subclasses: `ShapeState_InitShape`, `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`, and `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.

1. Finite State Machine Lifecycle and Structure:
- `ShapeState` base class:
  - `public static ShapeState s_defaultState`: Static reference to the entry/reset state (`ShapeState_InitShape`).
  - `[SerializeReference] public ShapeState m_nextState = null`: Polymorphic pointer to the subsequent state in the sequence.
  - `public static DrawShapeTool tool`: Static reference to the driving `DrawShapeTool` instance.
  - `StartStateMachine()`: Invokes `s_defaultState.InitState()` and returns `s_defaultState`.
  - `InitState()`: Protected virtual hook executed whenever a state becomes active.
  - `DoState(Event evt)`: Abstract event processor handling input events (`EventType.MouseDown`, `EventType.MouseDrag`, `EventType.MouseUp`, `EventType.MouseMove`, `EventType.KeyDown`, `EventType.Repaint`) and returning the next active `ShapeState`.
  - `EndState()`: Protected virtual hook executed before exiting a state.
  - `NextState()`: Invokes `EndState()`, verifies `m_nextState` (falls back to `ResetState()` if null), calls `m_nextState.InitState()`, triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`, and returns `m_nextState`.
  - `ResetState()` / `ResetTool(DrawShapeTool t)`: Destroys temporary `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.gameObject` if instantiated, re-initializes `s_defaultState`, repaints the scene view, and returns `s_defaultState`.
- Tool Initialization (`DrawShapeTool.InitStateMachine`):
  - Instantiates `ShapeState_InitShape`, `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`, and `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.
  - Assigns `ShapeState.tool = this` and `ShapeState.s_defaultState = initState`.
  - Links transitions cyclically: `initState.m_nextState = drawBaseState`, `drawBaseState.m_nextState = drawHeightState`, and `drawHeightState.m_nextState = initState`.
  - Enters the state machine via `ShapeState.StartStateMachine()`.

2. State 1: `ShapeState_InitShape` (Awaiting Plane Selection & Placement Click):
- Initialization (`InitState`):
  - Sets `tool.m_IsShapeInit = false`.
  - Allocates 6 bounding box face descriptors (`m_Faces = new EditorShapeUtility.FaceData[6]`).
  - Resets `m_HitPosition = Vector3.positiveInfinity`.
  - Disables the `MeshRenderer` on the duplicate preview object (`tool.m_DuplicateGO`).
- Active Editing of Previously Created Shape:
  - If `tool.m_LastShapeCreated != null`, forwards GUI interaction to `EditShapeTool.DoEditingHandles(tool.m_LastShapeCreated, tool)` so the user can interactively resize and reorient the most recent shape without switching tools.
  - If `evt.isKey && evt.type == EventType.KeyDown && evt.keyCode == KeyCode.Return`, restores the persistent tool via `ToolManager.RestorePreviousPersistentTool()` and calls `ResetState()`.
- Plane and Surface Raycasting:
  - If `EditorHandleUtility.SceneViewInUse(evt)` is true (e.g. orbiting camera with Alt), returns `this` immediately.
  - When `evt.isMouse && HandleUtility.nearestControl == tool.controlID`:
    - Calls `EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlaneAndBitangent(evt.mousePosition, tool.m_DuplicateGO)` to resolve the active 3D plane (`res.item1`) and bitangent forward direction (`res.item2`).
    - Raycasts against `res.item1` to determine hit point.
    - Validates cardinal plane normal via `Math.IsCardinalAxis(planeNormal)` and checks grid alignment (`offGrid |= Mathf.Abs(snapVal[i] % center[i]) > epsilon`), setting `tool.m_IsOnGrid = !offGrid`.
    - Computes snapped hit position: `m_HitPosition = tool.GetPoint(ray.GetPoint(hit))`.
- State Transition:
  - On `EventType.MouseDown` with `evt.button == 0`:
    - Initializes tool plane: `tool.m_Plane = res.item1`, `tool.m_PlaneForward = res.item2`, `tool.m_PlaneRight = Vector3.Cross(tool.m_Plane.normal, tool.m_PlaneForward)`.
    - Initializes bounding box corners: `tool.m_BB_Origin = m_HitPosition`, `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_Origin`, `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Returns `NextState()` to transition to `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`.
- Visualization:
  - Calls `tool.DoDuplicateShapePreviewHandle(m_HitPosition)` to display duplicate shape ghost preview when Shift is held.
  - On `EventType.Repaint`, if `GUIUtility.hotControl == 0`, draws placement preview dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `m_HitPosition`.

3. State 2: `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape` (Dragging 2D Base Footprint):
- Initialization (`InitState`): Resets `m_IsDragging = false`.
- Event Handling:
  - Cancellation: `KeyCode.Delete` or `KeyCode.Escape` key down returns `ResetState()`.
  - Dragging: `EventType.MouseDrag` or `MouseMove` with `evt.button == 0`:
    - Sets `m_IsDragging = true` and disables `tool.m_DuplicateGO` renderer.
    - Raycasts cursor ray against `tool.m_Plane` to compute world distance.
    - Computes offset `deltaPoint = ray.GetPoint(distance) - tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Converts offset into local plane orientation: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
    - Snaps displacement via `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
    - Updates opposite base corner: `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Sets `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner` and calls `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Completion (`EventType.MouseUp` with `button == 0`):
    - Shift-Click Instant Duplicate: If `!m_IsDragging && evt.shift`, calls `CreateLastShape()` (instantiates shape, applies last size and parameters, rebuilds, selects GameObject) and returns `ResetState()`.
    - Minimum Size Abort: If `Vector3.Distance(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_BB_Origin) <= Mathf.Min(0.01f, tool.minSnapSize)`, returns `ResetState()`.
    - Records center offset: `tool.m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * ((tool.m_BB_Origin - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner) * 0.5f)`.
    - Returns `NextState()` to transition to `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.

4. State 3: `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape` (Extruding 3D Height):
- 2D Shape Bypass: If `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.shape is Plane` or `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.shape is Sprite`, height definition is bypassed immediately by returning `ValidateShape()` (which calls `NextState()`).
- Event Handling:
  - Key Input: `KeyCode.Space`, `KeyCode.Return`, or `KeyCode.Escape` calls `ValidateShape()` to commit the shape at current height. `KeyCode.Delete` calls `ResetState()` to discard creation.
  - Height Dragging (`MouseMove` / `MouseDrag`):
    - Constructs mouse ray `HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(evt.mousePosition)`.
    - Computes closest 3D point between the extrusion axis ray (origin `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`, direction `tool.m_Plane.normal`) and cursor ray using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.origin, ray.direction)`.
    - If rays are parallel (`dot == 0`), computes delta as `ray.origin - tool.m_Plane.ClosestPointOnPlane(ray.origin)`; otherwise `heightPoint - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
    - Converts delta to local plane space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
    - Snaps height delta: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
    - Updates height corner: `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
    - Invokes `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Mouse Up (`EventType.MouseUp` with `button == 0`):
    - Updates `tool.m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * ((tool.m_BB_Origin - tool.m_BB_HeightCorner) * 0.5f)`.
    - Returns `ValidateShape()`.
- State Termination (`EndState`):
  - Detaches selection change handler (`tool.handleSelectionChange = false`).
  - Registers undo operation: `UndoUtility.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(shape, "Draw Shape")`.
  - Sets `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.gameObject.hideFlags = HideFlags.None`.
  - Initializes mesh: `EditorUtility.InitObject(tool.m_ProBuilderShape.mesh)`.
  - Finalizes geometry: `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Selects created shape: `Selection.activeObject = shape`.
  - Collapses undo operations into a single group via `Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group)`.
  - Persists active shape index and parameters: `DrawShapeTool.s_ActiveShapeIndex.value = ...`, `tool.SaveShapeParams(tool.m_ProBuilderShape)`.
  - Sets `tool.m_LastShapeCreated = tool.m_ProBuilderShape` and clears `tool.m_ProBuilderShape = null`.
  - Transitions back to `ShapeState_InitShape`.

> **Godot Note:** In Godot 4, an EditorPlugin handles 3D viewport input via `_forward_3d_gui_input(Camera3D viewport_camera, InputEvent event)`. A state machine enum (`INIT`, `DRAW_BASE`, `DRAW_HEIGHT`) manages transitions. Ray-plane intersections map mouse coordinates via `camera.project_ray_origin` and `camera.project_ray_normal` with `Plane.intersects_ray`. Closest points on two 3D rays use vector cross-product geometry.

### MOUSE INTERACTION

ProBuilder translates 2D mouse cursor coordinates in the SceneView into 3D geometric operations using a multi-tiered plane resolution hierarchy, followed by plane-local drag projections for width/depth and height extrusion.

1. Plane Determination Hierarchy (`EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlaneAndBitangent`):
When the user moves or clicks the mouse, ProBuilder determines the active 3D drawing plane and bitangent alignment vector in the following strict priority order:
- Priority 1: Picked Scene Mesh or Terrain Surface (`GetPlaneFromPickedObject`):
  - Calls `HandleUtility.PickGameObject(mousePosition, false, ignorePicking.ToArray())`.
  - If a hit `GameObject` contains a `MeshFilter` with a valid `sharedMesh`:
    - Executes `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.HandleUtility.MeshRaycast(HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition), go, out hit)`.
    - Constructs the plane using the transformed hit normal and point: `plane = new Plane(go.transform.TransformDirection(hit.normal), go.transform.TransformPoint(hit.point))`.
    - Derives the bitangent forward vector via `GetBitangent(plane.normal)`.
  - If the hit `GameObject` contains a `Terrain`:
    - Runs `Physics.Raycast(HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition), out hit)`.
    - Plane is `new Plane(hit.normal, hit.point)`, and bitangent aligns with terrain forward or up (`Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(plane.normal, forward)) > .9f ? go.transform.up : forward`).
- Priority 2: ProGrids Active Axis Grid (`GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`):
  - If `ProGridsInterface.IsActive()` and `ProGridsInterface.GridVisible()` are true:
    - If `ProGridsInterface.IsFullGridEnabled()` is active: raycasts against 3 orthogonal planes (`Vector3.right`, `Vector3.up`, `Vector3.forward`) positioned at ProGrids pivot (`ProGridsInterface.GetPivot`), selecting the plane with the smallest raycast distance.
    - Otherwise queries single active axis (`HandleAxis.X`, `HandleAxis.Y`, `HandleAxis.Z`) and applies `ProGridsInterface.GetActiveGridOffset()` along that axis normal.
- Priority 3: SceneView Grid Plane (`GetPlaneFromSceneView`):
  - If `EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapActive` or `SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.showGrid` is enabled:
    - Queries active grid axis `sceneView.sceneViewGrids.gridAxis` and pivot `sceneView.sceneViewGrids.GetPivot(axis)`.
    - Inverts normal if camera forward dot normal > 0 (`normal *= -1f`).
    - Validates camera side: if `plane.GetSide(cameraTransform.position)` is true, returns this plane.
- Priority 4: Scene Camera Projection Fallback (`GetPlaneFromCameraDirection`):
  - Computes camera pitch `pitch = Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(cameraDirection, Vector3.up))`.
  - If pitch < 0.02f (indicating orthographic or side perspective), sets projection axis to `ProjectionAxis.X` or `ProjectionAxis.Z` based on `right > forward`.
  - Otherwise uses `ProjectionAxis.Y` (horizontal floor plane).
  - Returns `new Plane(Projection.ProjectionAxisToVector(axis), EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.pivot))`.

2. Base Dimensioning via Plane Raycast (Width and Depth):
- In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.Drag(Vector2 mousePosition)`:
  - Generates world ray `Ray ray = HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition)`.
  - Intersects with tool plane: `tool.m_Plane.Raycast(ray, out distance)`.
  - Calculates world offset: `var deltaPoint = ray.GetPoint(distance) - tool.m_BB_Origin`.
  - Transforms offset into plane local rotation space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
  - Snaps local coordinates: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
  - Updates bounding box opposite corner: `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_Origin`.
  - Sets `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
- Bounding Box Computation (`DrawShapeTool.RecalculateBounds`):
  - Computes diagonal vector `var diag = m_BB_OppositeCorner - m_BB_Origin`.
  - Projects diagonal onto plane vectors: `var forward = Vector3.Dot(diag, m_PlaneForward.normalized)`, `var right = Vector3.Dot(diag, m_PlaneRight.normalized)`.
  - Computes local height: `var localHeight = Quaternion.Inverse(m_PlaneRotation) * (m_BB_HeightCorner - m_BB_OppositeCorner); var height = localHeight.y;`.
  - Calculates final 3D bounds: `m_Bounds.size = forward * Vector3.forward + right * Vector3.right + height * Vector3.up`.
  - Calculates bounds center: `m_Bounds.center = m_BB_Origin + 0.5f * (m_BB_OppositeCorner - m_BB_Origin) + 0.5f * (m_BB_HeightCorner - m_BB_OppositeCorner)`.
  - Applies slight Y offset if `Mathf.Abs(m_Bounds.center.y) < 0.0001f` to prevent Z-fighting with drawing surface.

3. Height Dimensioning via Ray-to-Ray Closest Point:
- In `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape.DoState(Event evt)`:
  - Casts mouse ray `Ray ray = HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(evt.mousePosition)`.
  - Projects mouse ray onto the height line extending from `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner` along `tool.m_Plane.normal` using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.origin, ray.direction)`.
  - Handles parallel grazing angle: checks `dot = Vector3.Dot(tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.direction)`. If `dot == 0`, delta is `ray.origin - tool.m_Plane.ClosestPointOnPlane(ray.origin)`; otherwise `heightPoint - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
  - Transforms delta to local plane rotation space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
  - Snaps height: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
  - Updates height corner: `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
  - Rebuilds geometry via `tool.RebuildShape()`.

### GRID SNAPPING

ProBuilder integrates grid and incremental snapping across all phases of shape drawing and shape editing.

1. Snapping Properties and Queries:
- `gridSnapEnabled => true`: Virtual property on `DrawShapeTool` and `EditShapeTool` signaling to Unity's `ToolManager` to activate grid snapping handles.
- `minSnapSize`: Computes the minimum snapping threshold:
  - If `m_IsOnGrid` is true: returns `Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.x, Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.y, EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.z))`.
  - If `m_IsOnGrid` is false: returns `Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.x, Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.y, EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.z))`.

2. Point Snapping Method (`DrawShapeTool.GetPoint`):
- Signature: `public Vector3 GetPoint(Vector3 point, bool useIncrementSnap = false)`.
- Step 1: If `useIncrementSnap` is true, returns `ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(point, EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue)`.
- Step 2: If `m_IsOnGrid && EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapActive`, returns `ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(point, EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue)`.
- Step 3: Otherwise returns the un-snapped `point`.

3. Plane On-Grid Detection (`ShapeState_InitShape`):
- When a hit plane is identified, ProBuilder checks whether the plane itself aligns with the active grid:
  - Verifies if the plane normal is cardinal: `Math.IsCardinalAxis(planeNormal)`.
  - Calculates plane center: `planeCenter = res.item1.normal * -res.item1.distance`.
  - Applies normal masking: `Vector3 center = Vector3.Scale(ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(planeNormal), planeCenter)`.
  - Compares against active snap increment: `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) offGrid |= Mathf.Abs(snapVal[i] % center[i]) > epsilon` (with `epsilon = .00001f`).
  - Sets `tool.m_IsOnGrid = !offGrid`. For non-cardinal surfaces (e.g. angled mesh faces), `m_IsOnGrid` is false, switching the tool to incremental snapping.

4. Base and Height Snapping Application:
- Base footprint: In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.UpdateShapeBase`, `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)` snaps the local plane X and Z coordinates before rebuilding mesh bounds.
- Height extrusion: In `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape.DoState`, `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)` snaps the extrusion height along the plane normal.
- Degeneracy Guard: In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.DoState` and `DrawShapeTool.RebuildShape`, if `Vector3.Distance(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_BB_Origin) <= Mathf.Min(0.01f, tool.minSnapSize)` or `m_Bounds.size.sqrMagnitude <= Mathf.Min(.01f, minSnapSize * minSnapSize)`, the shape creation aborts or clears geometry to prevent zero-volume artifacts.

5. EditShapeTool Handle Snapping (`EditShapeTool.DoSizeHandles`):
- When dragging face size handles on existing shapes:
  - If `Math.IsCardinalAxis(proBuilderShape.transform.up) && EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapEnabled && !EditorSnapSettings.incrementalSnapActive && !evt.alt`:
    - World face position: `facePosition = s_StartPositionGlobal + Vector3.Scale(delta, s_StartScaleInverse)`.
    - Snapping value: `snapValue = Vector3.Scale(Vector3.Scale(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue, s_StartScaleInverse), Math.Abs(face.Normal))`.
    - Snaps world position: `facePosition = ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(facePosition, snapValue)`.
    - Adjusts target size: `targetSize += Vector3.Scale((facePosition - s_StartPositionGlobal), s_Direction)`.
  - Incremental Snapping: If incremental snapping is active or the shape transform is non-cardinal, uses `snapValue = EditorSnapSettings.incrementalSnapActive ? Vector3.Scale(Vector3.Scale(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue, s_StartScaleInverse), Math.Abs(face.Normal)) : Vector3.zero; targetSize += ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(delta, snapValue)`.

6. ProGrids Integration:
- In `EditorHandleUtility.GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`, ProBuilder interfaces directly with ProGrids via reflection:
  - `ProGridsInterface.IsActive()`: Checks if ProGrids plugin is running.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GridVisible()`: Verifies grid visibility.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GetPivot()`: Obtains active ProGrids origin point.
  - `ProGridsInterface.IsFullGridEnabled()`: Determines if 3-axis snapping is active.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GetActiveGridAxis()` / `GetActiveGridOffset()`: Retrieves single-axis grid plane and offset distance.

### SHAPE SELECTION

ProBuilder manages primitive shape types through attribute-driven reflection, dedicated tool subclasses, preference serialization, and parameter propagation.

1. Shape Discovery and Reflection:
- `EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes`: Scans assemblies via `TypeCache.GetTypesWithAttribute<ShapeAttribute>().Where(t => t.BaseType == typeof(Shape)).ToArray()`.
- `EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypes`: Extracts display names from `((ShapeAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(x, typeof(ShapeAttribute))).name`.
- `EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypesGUI`: Constructs grouped `GUIContent[]` lists (up to `s_MaxContentPerGroup = 6` items per group) loading custom icons from `"Tools/ShapeTool/" + name` with the tooltip `"Click and drag to place and scale the shape, or SHIFT+click once to duplicate last size settings."`.

2. Tool Subclasses and Menu Actions:
ProBuilder provides 12 specialized subclasses of `DrawShapeTool`, each exposing a menu item under `Tools/ProBuilder/Editors/Create Shape/<ShapeName>`:
- `CreateCubeTool`: Shortcut `%#K` (Cmd+Shift+K / Ctrl+Shift+K), priority 0.
- `CreateSphereTool`: Priority 1.
- `CreatePlaneTool`: Priority 2.
- `CreateCylinderTool`: Priority 3.
- `CreateConeTool`: Priority 4.
- `CreatePrismTool`: Priority 5.
- `CreateStairsTool`: Priority 6.
- `CreateTorusTool`: Priority 7.
- `CreatePipeTool`: Priority 8.
- `CreateArchTool`: Priority 9.
- `CreateDoorTool`: Priority 10.
- `CreateSpriteTool`: Priority 11.
Each subclass maintains shape-specific preferences:
- `Pref<Vector3> m_LastSize = new Pref<Vector3>("ShapeBuilder.LastSize.<Name>", Vector3.one)`
- `Pref<Quaternion> m_LastRotation = new Pref<Quaternion>("ShapeBuilder.LastRotation.<Name>", Quaternion.identity)`
- `Pref<PivotLocation> m_PivotLocation = new Pref<PivotLocation>("ShapeBuilder.PivotLocation.<Name>", PivotLocation.Center)`
In `OnActivated()`, the tool updates `s_ActiveShapeIndex.value = Array.IndexOf(EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes, typeof(TargetShape))`.

3. Inspector & Overlay Dropdown Integration:
- In `ProBuilderShapeEditor.DrawShapeParametersGUI`:
  - Determines active shape index across multi-selection via `HasMultipleShapeTypes`. If mixed, shows `-1`.
  - Draws dropdown via `m_ActiveShapeIndex = EditorGUILayout.Popup("Shape", m_ActiveShapeIndex, EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypes)`.
  - When the selection changes, resolves target `Type type = EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes[m_ActiveShapeIndex]`.
  - For each selected `ProBuilderShape`, records undo via `UndoUtility.RecordComponents<Transform, ProBuilderMesh, ProBuilderShape>` and replaces the active shape instance via `proBuilderShape.SetShape(EditorShapeUtility.CreateShape(type))`.

4. Parameter Preservation and Reset:
- Caching System (`EditorShapeUtility`):
  - `s_Prefs`: Static `Dictionary<string, Shape>` indexed by `"ShapeBuilder." + type.Name`.
  - `ResetPrefs()`: Instantiates each non-abstract `Shape` subclass and retrieves stored settings via `ProBuilderSettings.Get(name, SettingsScope.Project, instance)`.
  - `SaveParams<T>(T shape)`: Copies current shape fields via `data.CopyShape(shape)` and persists to `ProBuilderSettings.Set(name, data)`.
  - `CopyLastParams(Shape shape, Type type)`: Copies cached properties into `shape` using `shape.CopyShape(data)`.
  - `CreateShape(Type type, bool copyLastParams = true)`: Instantiates `Activator.CreateInstance(type)` and invokes `CopyLastParams`.
- Parameter Behavior Across Shape Switches:
  - Primitive-specific parameters (such as `Stairs` step count, `Arch` angle/radius, `Cylinder` axis/sides) remain preserved in `s_Prefs` for each individual shape class.
  - Overall dimensions (`size`), world center position, and internal orientation (`shapeRotation`) are preserved on the `ProBuilderShape` component when changing shape types.
  - 2D vs 3D Dimension Adaptation (`ProBuilderShape.SetShape`):
    - If transitioning to a flat 2D shape (`Plane` or `Sprite`), `size.y` and `m_LocalCenter.y` are set to `0`.
    - If transitioning from a 2D shape to a 3D shape (`wasFlat && !isFlat`), if `Mathf.Abs(m_Size.y) < k_MinHeight` (0.0001f), `m_Size.y` is restored to `1f`.

### EDIT SHAPE TOOL

The `EditShapeTool` provides direct in-scene interactive handles to modify bounding dimensions and internal orientation of existing `ProBuilderShape` instances.

1. Tool Activation and Lifecycle:
- Class: `sealed class EditShapeTool : EditorTool` with attribute `[EditorTool("Edit Shape", typeof(ProBuilderShape))]`.
- Menu Entry: `Tools/ProBuilder/Edit/Edit Shape` (validated if any selected object contains a `ProBuilderShape`).
- Overlay Window: Renders `SceneViewOverlay` titled `"Shape Settings"` hosting `DrawShapeGUI()` and `DrawShapeParametersGUI(null)`.
- Mode Change Listeners: Subscribes to `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged` and `ToolManager.activeContextChanged` to restore the previous persistent tool when exiting shape editing context.

2. Handle Setup and Face Data Extraction (`DoEditingHandles`):
- Transformation Matrix: Configures Handles scope to `Matrix4x4.TRS(proBuilderShape.shapeWorldCenter, proBuilderShape.transform.rotation, Vector3.one)`.
- Bounding Face Calculation (`EditorShapeUtility.UpdateFaces`):
  - Populates 6 `FaceData` instances representing the bounding box faces: `-X` (0), `+X` (1), `-Y` (2), `+Y` (3), `-Z` (4), `+Z` (5).
  - Each `FaceData` stores `CenterPosition`, `Normal`, `Points` (4 corner vertices), `IsValid`, and `IsVisible`.
  - Face visibility test: `IsVisible` checks `Vector3.Dot(cameraDir, worldDir) < 0` where `worldDir = Handles.matrix.MultiplyVector(Normal).normalized` and `cameraDir` is the camera-to-face vector.
- Control IDs: Allocates 4 control IDs for orientation handles (`k_OrientationControlIDs`) and 6 control IDs for face size handles (`s_FaceControlIDs`).

3. Bounds Face Size Handles (`DoSizeHandles` and `DoFaceSizeHandle`):
- Wireframe Bounding Box: Drawn using `k_BoundsHandleColor` (`Color(.2f, .4f, .8f, 1f)`). Visible faces use alpha 1.0; occluded faces use alpha 0.5.
- Face Dot Cap: Drawn at each `face.CenterPosition` via `Handles.DotHandleCap` with size `HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(face.CenterPosition) * s_DefaultMidpointHandleSize` (0.03f). Highlighted in `EditorHandleDrawing.edgeSelectedColor` when hovered.
- Mouse Drag Line Translation:
  - Computes displacement along world face normal using `HandleUtility.CalcLineTranslation(s_StartMousePosition, evt.mousePosition, s_StartPositionGlobal, trs.TransformDirection(face.Normal).normalized)`.
  - Alt Key Symmetrical Modifier: When Alt is held, `modifier = evt.alt ? 2f : 1f`, expanding both opposing faces symmetrically around the center.
  - Non-Alt Single-Side Drag: Updates the center position by `center = Vector3.Scale((targetSize - s_StartSize) / 2f, s_Direction)` so the opposing face remains fixed in space.
  - Snapping: Snaps `delta` along face normal to active grid or incremental snap increments.
  - Applies properties via `ApplyProperties(proBuilderShape, s_StartCenter + center, targetSize)`, which calls `proBuilderShape.UpdateBounds(bounds)`.

4. Orientation Arrow Handles (`DoOrientationHandles` and `DoOrientationHandle`):
- Applicability: Active on all non-Cube shapes when bounding size in X, Y, and Z > epsilon.
- Hover Detection: When the cursor is inside a visible face (`EditorShapeUtility.PointerIsInFace(face)` via `PointInQuad2D`), orientation arrow handles appear.
- Visual Arrow Construction:
  - Computes 4 arrow polylines (`arrowsLines[4]`) radiating from `face.CenterPosition` toward each edge of the face.
  - Renders polylines via `Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(5f, arrowsLines[i])`.
  - When hovered: sets cursor to `MouseCursor.RotateArrow` and draws shape internal coordinate axes (`shapeRotation * Vector3.up` and `shapeRotation * Vector3.forward`).
- Rotation Execution (on `EventType.MouseUp`):
  - Identifies clicked arrow control ID and extracts `targetedNormal = (arrowsLines[i][1] - face.CenterPosition).normalized`.
  - Calculates rotation axis: `Vector3 rotationAxis = Vector3.Cross(currentNormal, targetedNormal)`.
  - Calculates rotation angle: `var angle = Vector3.SignedAngle(currentNormal, targetedNormal, rotationAxis)`.
  - Constructs quaternion: `s_ShapeRotation = Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, rotationAxis)`.
  - Applies rotation: `proBuilderShape.RotateInsideBounds(s_ShapeRotation)` (updates `shapeRotation` and rebuilds mesh without changing bounds).

5. Mesh Editability Check and Reset:
- Editability Condition: `proBuilderShape.isEditable` evaluates `m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion == mesh.versionIndex`.
- Manual Mesh Modification: If the user modifies mesh vertices, edges, or faces in ProBuilder, `mesh.versionIndex` increments, making `isEditable` false.
- Reset Workflow: When `!isEditable`, `ProBuilderShapeEditor.DrawShapeGUI` disables parametric editing controls and displays an info HelpBox: *"You have manually modified the selected shape(s). Reset the shape to remove all manual changes in order to proceed."* Clicking "Reset Shape" calls `shapeComponent.UpdateShape()` and restores the parametric shape.

### PIVOT OFFSET

ProBuilder provides explicit control over shape pivot placement relative to bounding geometry, ensuring that pivot locations remain stable and predictable during creation, resizing, and shape switching.

1. Pivot Location Enum and Configuration:
- `PivotLocation` enum (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.ShapeFactory`):
  - `Center` (0): Positions the transform pivot at the exact geometric center of the shape bounding box.
  - `FirstVertex` (1): Positions the transform pivot at the first corner vertex where the user began drawing (`m_BB_Origin`).
- Configurable in `DrawShapeTool` inspector and SceneView overlay via `tool.pivotLocation = (PivotLocation)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup(k_ShapePivotLabel, tool.pivotLocation)`.
- Persisted per shape type via `Pref<PivotLocation> m_PivotLocation = new Pref<PivotLocation>("ShapeBuilder.PivotLocation.<ShapeName>", PivotLocation.Center)`.

2. Preview Pivot Calculation (`DrawShapeTool.previewPivotPosition`):
- Computed dynamically during interactive drawing:
  - If `pivotLocation == PivotLocation.FirstVertex`:
    - Computes corner offset: `var pivotOffset = instance.m_PlaneRotation * (instance.m_Bounds.size * -0.5f)`.
    - Returns `pivotOffset + instance.m_Bounds.center`.
  - If `pivotLocation == PivotLocation.Center`:
    - Returns `m_Bounds.center`.
- In `DrawShapeTool.RebuildShape`, calls `proBuilderShape.Rebuild(pivotLocation == PivotLocation.Center ? m_Bounds.center : m_BB_Origin, m_PlaneRotation, m_Bounds)`.

3. Mesh Pivot Assignment and Ratio Tracking (`ProBuilderShape.Rebuild`):
- Parameterized rebuild method: `Rebuild(Vector3 pivotPosition, Quaternion rotation, Bounds bounds)`:
  - Step 1: Sets transform position to `bounds.center` and rotation to `rotation`.
  - Step 2: Assigns `size = bounds.size`.
  - Step 3: Rebuilds primitive geometry: `m_Shape.RebuildMesh(mesh, size, shapeRotation)` and fits mesh vertices via `MeshUtility.FitToSize(mesh, bbox, size)`.
  - Step 4: Shifts vertex positions relative to pivot: `mesh.SetPivot(pivotPosition)`. This translates all mesh vertex coordinates by `transform.position - pivotPosition` and relocates the GameObject transform position to `pivotPosition`.
  - Step 5: Computes local bounding center: `m_LocalCenter = mesh.transform.InverseTransformPoint(bounds.center)`.
  - Step 6: Computes normalized pivot ratio `m_PivotRatio`:
    - `m_PivotRatio = new Vector3(RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.x, bounds.size.x), RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.y, bounds.size.y), RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.z, bounds.size.z))`
    - Where `RatioOrZero(localCenterComponent, sizeComponent)` computes `Mathf.Clamp(localCenterComponent / (sizeComponent * 0.5f), -1f, 1f)` if `Mathf.Abs(sizeComponent) >= 0.0001f`, else `0f`.
    - For `PivotLocation.Center`, `m_LocalCenter` is `(0, 0, 0)` and `m_PivotRatio` is `(0, 0, 0)`.
    - For `PivotLocation.FirstVertex`, `m_LocalCenter` sits at half-extents, yielding `m_PivotRatio` of `(1, 1, 1)` or `(-1, -1, -1)`.

4. Pivot Preservation During Shape Resizing (`ProBuilderShape.UpdateShape`):
- When `ProBuilderShape.size` is modified (via Inspector property or `EditShapeTool` face handles), the shape must resize without shifting its anchored pivot position.
- Algorithm in `UpdateShape()`:
  - Derives new local center: `var newLocalCenter = Vector3.Scale(m_PivotRatio, size * 0.5f)`.
  - Transforms local center to world space: `var newWorldCenter = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(newLocalCenter)`.
  - Rebuilds shape maintaining transform position: `Rebuild(mesh.transform.position, mesh.transform.rotation, new Bounds(newWorldCenter, size))`.
- This ensures that a corner-anchored shape grows outward from the corner without moving the pivot point.

5. Dynamic Pivot Switching on Last Created Shape:
- In `DrawShapeTool.pivotLocation` property setter:
  - If the user changes `pivotLocation` while the most recently created shape is selected in the overlay (`instance.currentShapeInOverlay == instance.m_LastShapeCreated`):
    - Computes `newPivotPosition = lastShape.shapeWorldCenter`.
    - If `value != PivotLocation.Center`, adds `instance.m_PlaneRotation * m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin`.
    - Invokes `instance.m_LastShapeCreated.Rebuild(newPivotPosition, lastShapeTrs.rotation, lastShape.shapeWorldBounds)`.
    - Updates `shapePivotLocation = value`.

        internal void UpdateBounds(Bounds bounds)
        {
            Rebuild(mesh.transform.position, mesh.transform.rotation, bounds);
        }

        internal void Rebuild(Vector3 pivotPosition, Quaternion rotation, Bounds bounds)
        {
            var trs = transform;
            trs.position = bounds.center;
            trs.rotation = rotation;
            size = bounds.size;
            Rebuild();
            mesh.SetPivot(pivotPosition);
            m_LocalCenter = mesh.transform.InverseTransformPoint(bounds.center);
            m_PivotRatio = new Vector3(
                RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.x, bounds.size.x),
                RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.y, bounds.size.y),
                RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.z, bounds.size.z));

            m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion = mesh.versionIndex;
        }

        static float RatioOrZero(float localCenterComponent, float sizeComponent)
        {
            if (Mathf.Abs(sizeComponent) < 0.0001f)
                return 0f;
            return Mathf.Clamp(localCenterComponent / (sizeComponent * 0.5f), -1f, 1f);

> **Godot Note:** In Godot 4, changing a node's pivot involves translating its mesh vertex positions in `ArrayMesh` surfaces by negative pivot offset while offsetting the `Node3D.global_position` by positive pivot offset. Storing a normalized pivot ratio vector `pivot_ratio` allows automatic recalculation of vertex offsets whenever dimensions change.

**Cross References:**
- D01: Defines primitive Shape classes (Cube, Sphere, Plane, Cylinder, etc.) and the ProBuilderShape component data structures instantiated and edited by DrawShapeTool and EditShapeTool.
- D03: Provides specialized polygon (PolyShape) and spline extrusion (BezierShape) creation tools operating alongside DrawShapeTool.
- A01: Defines core ProBuilderMesh data structures, version tracking (versionIndex), and SetPivot mesh operations used during shape creation and rebuilding.
- A02: Supplies math utilities (Math.IsCardinalAxis, Math.GetNearestPointRayRay, ProBuilderSnapping) utilized by shape state machines and edit handles.
- F01: Defines EditorTool infrastructure, ToolManager context switching, and persistent tool restoration.
- H01: Manages ProBuilder preference persistence (ProBuilderSettings, Pref<T>) for shape dimensions, rotations, and active shape selection.
- K01: Manages undo/redo group collapsing (UndoUtility, Undo.CollapseUndoOperations) for atomic shape drawing and resizing transactions.

## D03: PolyShape tool and Bezier shape tool

### POLYSHAPE

The PolyShape subsystem provides interactive creation and extrusion of arbitrary 2D polygon perimeters into 3D meshes. It is implemented across runtime component `PolyShape`, interactive editor tool `DrawPolyShapeTool` / `PolyShapeTool`, and custom inspector `PolyShapeEditor`.

1. Component Architecture & Data Model:
- Class `PolyShape : MonoBehaviour` is decorated with `[AddComponentMenu("")]`, `[DisallowMultipleComponent]`, `[ExcludeFromPreset, ExcludeFromObjectFactory]`, `[Icon(k_IconPath)]`, and `[ProGridsConditionalSnap]`.
- State enum `PolyShape.PolyEditMode`: defines lifecycle modes `None` (idle/finalized), `Path` (initial point placement), `Height` (interactive extrusion dragging), and `Edit` (modifying points on an existing shape).
- Serialized fields: `m_Points` (`List<Vector3>`, serialized as `points`), `m_Extrude` (`float`, default `0f`), `m_EditMode` (`PolyEditMode`), `m_FlipNormals` (`bool`), and `isOnGrid` (`bool`, default `true`).
- Public properties: `controlPoints` (`ReadOnlyCollection<Vector3>`), `extrude` (`float`), `flipNormals` (`bool`), and `mesh` (`ProBuilderMesh`, lazily fetched via `GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>()`). Method `SetControlPoints(IList<Vector3> points)` populates `m_Points`.

2. Tool Activation & Initialization UX:
- Menu item `Tools/ProBuilder/Editors/Create PolyShape` invokes `ToolManager.SetActiveTool<DrawPolyShapeTool>()` and sends analytics event `ProBuilderAnalytics.SendActionEvent("New PolyShape", nameof(DrawPolyShapeTool))`.
- In `DrawPolyShapeTool.OnActivated()`, selection is cleared via `MeshSelection.SetSelection((GameObject)null)`, active context is set to `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`, and base initialization establishes undo group `m_UndoGroup = Undo.GetCurrentGroup()`.
- Tool lifecycle method `TryCreatePolyShape()` checks `CanCreateNewPolyShape()` (verifying all inspector windows are unlocked), creates a temporary GameObject `go = new GameObject("PolyShape")` with `HideFlags.HideAndDontSave | HideFlags.HideInInspector`, adds `PolyShape` and `ProBuilderMesh` components via `Undo.AddComponent`, executes initial `pb.CreateShapeFromPolygon(m_PolyShape.m_Points, m_PolyShape.extrude, m_PolyShape.flipNormals)`, sets `polyEditMode = PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Path`, and positions the GameObject at the active ProGrids pivot if snapping or grid display is active.

3. Input Plane Resolution (`SetupInputPlane`):
- When placing the first point, `SetupInputPlane(Vector2 mousePosition)` calls `EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlane(mousePosition)` to establish drawing plane `m_Plane` (`UnityEngine.Plane`). Priority sequence: (1) raycasting against picked meshes in scene via `GetPlaneFromPickedObject`, (2) ProGrids active grid axis via `GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`, (3) SceneView camera view plane via `GetPlaneFromSceneView()`.
- Grid alignment verification: if `Math.IsCardinalAxis(plane.normal)`, checks whether plane center `plane.normal * -plane.distance` aligns with `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` within tolerance `epsilon = .00001f`, setting `polygon.isOnGrid = !offGrid`.

4. Point Placement UX Loop (`DoPointPlacement` in `PolyEditMode.Path`):
- Cursor states: `MouseCursor.ArrowPlus` when hovering over the input plane ready to place points, `MouseCursor.MoveArrow` while actively dragging or holding hot controls.
- Mouse click handling: on `EventType.MouseDown` (button 0):
  - First point: sets GameObject transform position `polygon.transform.position = GetPointFromHit(hit)`. Calculates camera-facing normal `cameraFacingPlaneNormal = plane.normal` (inverted if `Vector3.Dot(cameraFacingPlaneNormal, camera.forward) > 0f`), and sets rotation `polygon.transform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(cameraFacingPlaneNormal) * Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(90f, 0f, 0f))`.
  - Subsequent points: projects world hit into local space via `GetPointInLocalSpace(hit)`, applying `ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(plane.normal)` and `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` when `polygon.isOnGrid` is enabled.
  - Appends coordinate to `polygon.m_Points.Add(point)`, activates dragging state `m_PlacingPoint = true`, sets selected index `m_SelectedIndex = polygon.m_Points.Count - 1`, and triggers mesh rebuild `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(polygon)`.
  - While dragging (`EventType.MouseDrag` with `m_PlacingPoint == true`), continually raycasts against `plane` to update `polygon.m_Points[m_SelectedIndex]` and repaints SceneView.
- Dynamic preview rendering: `DoExistingLinesGUI()` calls `DrawPolyLine()` to render blue lines (`k_LineColor = Color(0f, 55f / 255f, 1f, 1f)`) between placed points, and `DrawGuideLine()` to render dotted line `Handles.DrawDottedLine` (`k_DrawingLineColor = Color(0.01f, .9f, 0.3f, 1f)`) from last placed point to current cursor position `m_CurrentPosition`.

5. Closing Polygon & Advancing Mode:
- Loop closing condition: if cursor clicks near point 0 (`Math.Approx3(polygon.m_Points[0], point)` or hovers control `m_ControlId0` when `polygon.m_Points.Count > 2`), sets `m_NextMouseUpAdvancesMode = true`. Alternatively, pressing `KeyCode.Return` or `KeyCode.Space` advances the mode if `m_Points.Count > 2`.
- Upon mouse up, `OnToolGUI` consumes event and calls `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Height)`.

6. Extrusion Height Adjustment UX (`PolyEditMode.Height`):
- Entering Height mode initializes mouse offset: calculates origin `origin = polygon.transform.TransformPoint(Math.Average(polygon.m_Points))`. Checks `SceneCameraIsAlignedWithPolyUp()` (`Mathf.Abs(Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(camera.forward, polygon.transform.up)) - 1f) < .01f`). If camera is looking directly along up vector, sets `s_HeightMouseOffset = polygon.extrude` and finalizes immediately to prevent coplanar raycasting degeneracies.
- Otherwise, projects mouse ray against extrusion line using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(origin, up, r.origin, r.direction)`, computing `s_HeightMouseOffset = polygon.extrude - EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(extrude)`.
- In `DoExistingPointsGUI()` for `Height` mode: on `EventType.MouseMove`, evaluates ray-ray intersection point `p`, computing `extrude = EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(s_HeightMouseOffset + Vector3.Distance(origin, p) * Mathf.Sign(Vector3.Dot(p - origin, up)))`.
- Renders handle visualization: bottom dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `origin` (`k_HandleColor`), vertical line `Handles.DrawLine(origin, extrudePoint)` (`k_HandleColorGreen`), and top cap dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `extrudePoint` (`k_HandleColorGreen`).
- Finalizing shape: on MouseUp (button 0), Return, or Space key, calls `TryFinalizeShape()`: records `Undo.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(polygon.gameObject, "Finalize Draw PolyShape")`, clears `HideFlags.None`, collapses undo operations via `Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(m_UndoGroup)`, and sets `polygon = null`.

7. Normal Computation for Non-Planar Point Sets:
- When a polygon's vertices are not strictly coplanar, face normal calculation is handled during triangulation and mesh rebuilding by `Math.Normal(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face face)` and `Projection.FindBestPlane(IList<Vector3> points, IList<int> indexes)`.
- For polygons with more than 6 index entries (> 2 triangles), `Math.Normal` computes the Newell plane normal using covariance analysis in `Projection.FindBestPlane`.
- Algorithm: computes 3D centroid `c = sum(points) / len`, centered offsets `r = point - c`, and covariance matrix components: `xx = sum(r.x^2)`, `xy = sum(r.x * r.y)`, `xz = sum(r.x * r.z)`, `yy = sum(r.y^2)`, `yz = sum(r.y * r.z)`, `zz = sum(r.z^2)`.
- Evaluates principal determinants: `det_x = yy * zz - yz * yz`, `det_y = xx * zz - xz * xz`, `det_z = xx * yy - xy * xy`.
- Extracts dominant eigenvector: if `det_x` is greatest, `n = Vector3(1f, (xz * yz - xy * zz) / det_x, (xy * yz - xz * yy) / det_x)`; if `det_y` is greatest, `n = Vector3((yz * xz - xy * zz) / det_y, 1f, (xy * xz - yz * xx) / det_y)`; otherwise `n = Vector3((yz * xy - xz * yy) / det_z, (xz * xy - yz * xx) / det_z, 1f)`. Normalizes `n.Normalize()` and returns `new Plane(n, c)`.
- Normal orientation check: if `Vector3.Dot(nrm, prj.normal) < 0f`, flips normal `nrm = -prj.normal` to maintain consistency with vertex winding.

        public static Plane FindBestPlane(IList<Vector3> points, IList<int> indexes = null)
        {
            float   xx = 0f, xy = 0f, xz = 0f,
                    yy = 0f, yz = 0f, zz = 0f;

            if (points == null)
                throw new System.ArgumentNullException("points");

            bool ind = indexes != null && indexes.Count > 0;
            int len = ind ? indexes.Count : points.Count;

            Vector3 c = Vector3.zero, n = Vector3.zero;

            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
            {
                c.x += points[ind ? indexes[i] : i].x;
                c.y += points[ind ? indexes[i] : i].y;
                c.z += points[ind ? indexes[i] : i].z;
            }

            c.x /= (float)len;
            c.y /= (float)len;
            c.z /= (float)len;

            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
            {
                Vector3 r = points[ind ? indexes[i] : i] - c;

                xx += r.x * r.x;
                xy += r.x * r.y;
                xz += r.x * r.z;
                yy += r.y * r.y;
                yz += r.y * r.z;
                zz += r.z * r.z;
            }

            float det_x = yy * zz - yz * yz;
            float det_y = xx * zz - xz * xz;
            float det_z = xx * yy - xy * xy;

            if (det_x > det_y && det_x > det_z)
            {
                n.x = 1f;
                n.y = (xz * yz - xy * zz) / det_x;
                n.z = (xy * yz - xz * yy) / det_x;
            }
            else if (det_y > det_z)
            {
                n.x = (yz * xz - xy * zz) / det_y;
                n.y = 1f;
                n.z = (xy * xz - yz * xx) / det_y;
            }

### POLYSHAPE EDIT

Editing an existing PolyShape allows moving vertex knots in 2D local space, inserting new points along perimeter edges, deleting selected points, and adjusting extrusion height via center handles.

1. Entering Edit Mode:
- From Inspector (`PolyShapeEditor`), clicking 'Edit Poly Shape' activates `ToolManager.SetActiveTool<PolyShapeTool>()`.
- From Menu, `Tools/ProBuilder/Edit/Edit PolyShape` activates `PolyShapeTool` if any selected GameObject contains a `PolyShape` component.
- Method `UpdateTarget()` sets `polygon = psComp` and executes `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Edit)`.
- When transitioning from `PolyEditMode.None` to `PolyEditMode.Edit` with `m_Points.Count > 2`, `SetPolyEditMode` clears element selection in `ProBuilderEditor` and registers undo state via `Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(polygon, "Edit Polygon Shape")` and `Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(polygon.mesh, "Edit Polygon Shape mesh")`.

2. Moving Existing Points (`DoExistingPointsGUI` in Edit Mode):
- Iterates through all control points `polygon.m_Points` (count `len`).
- Converts each local coordinate to world space `point = trs.TransformPoint(polygon.m_Points[ii])`.
- Calculates handle size `size = HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(point) * k_HandleSize` (where `k_HandleSize = 0.05f`).
- Allocates unique control ID `id = GUIUtility.GetControlID(FocusType.Passive)`. If `ii == 0`, records `m_ControlId0 = id`.
- Sets handle color: `k_HandleSelectedColor` (`Color(.01f, .8f, .98f, 1f)`) if `ii == m_SelectedIndex || HandleUtility.nearestControl == id`, otherwise `k_HandleColor` (`Color(.8f, .8f, .8f, 1f)`).
- Renders planar manipulation handle: `point = Handles.Slider2D(id, point, up, right, forward, size, Handles.DotHandleCap, Vector2.zero, true)`.
- When dragged (`EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()`):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Move Polygon Shape Point")`.
  - Converts world point to local space via `GetPointInLocalSpace(point)` (applying snapping mask `ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(plane.normal)` and `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` when `polygon.isOnGrid` is true).
  - Updates coordinate `polygon.m_Points[ii] = GetPointInLocalSpace(point)`.
  - Invokes `OnBeginVertexMovement()` (setting `m_IsModifyingVertices = true`) and rebuilds mesh via `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(false)`.

3. Inserting Points Along Perimeter Edges (`DoPointPlacement` in `PolyEditMode.Edit`):
- Validates minimum point count: if `polygon.m_Points.Count < 3`, automatically sets `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Path)`.
- Verifies cursor distance from height handle exceeds threshold `m_DistanceFromHeightHandle > PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` (10 pixels).
- Raycasts mouse ray against `plane` to obtain hit point `point = GetPointInLocalSpace(hit)`.
- Calls `EditorHandleUtility.ClosestPointToPolyLine(polygon.m_Points, out index, out distToLineInGUI, true, polygon.transform)`.
- Computes segment interpolation ratio along edge segment between vertex `index - 1` and `index % polyCount`:
  `Vector3 aToPoint = point - polygon.m_Points[index - 1]`
  `Vector3 aToB = polygon.m_Points[index % polyCount] - polygon.m_Points[index - 1]`
  `float ratio = Vector3.Dot(aToPoint, aToB.normalized) / aToB.magnitude`
  `Vector3 wp = polygon.transform.TransformPoint(Vector3.Lerp(polygon.m_Points[index - 1], polygon.m_Points[index % polyCount], ratio))`.
- Validates insertion criteria: checks that GUI distance to endpoints `distanceToVertex > PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` and distance to edge line `distToLineInGUI < PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl`.
- Visual feedback: sets cursor `m_MouseCursor = MouseCursor.ArrowPlus` and renders green dot handle `Handles.DotHandleCap(-1, wp, Quaternion.identity, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(wp) * k_HandleSize, evt.type)` with `Handles.color = Color.green`.
- Insertion execution on `EventType.MouseDown` (button 0):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Insert Point")`.
  - Inserts point into list: `polygon.m_Points.Insert(index, point)`.
  - Updates state: `m_SelectedIndex = index`, `m_PlacingPoint = true`, triggers `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(true)` and `OnBeginVertexMovement()`.

4. Deleting Points & Keyboard Navigation (`HandleKeyEvent`):
- Key `KeyCode.Backspace` (macOS Delete): if `m_SelectedIndex > -1`, records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Delete Selected Points")`, deletes vertex `polygon.m_Points.RemoveAt(m_SelectedIndex)`, resets `m_SelectedIndex = -1`, rebuilds mesh `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(polygon)`, and consumes event `evt.Use()`.
- Key `KeyCode.Space` or `KeyCode.Return`: finalizes edit mode and exits tool via `LeaveTool()`.
- Key `KeyCode.Escape`: aborts editing and restores previous persistent tool via `LeaveTool()`.

5. Height Handle in Edit Mode (`DoExistingPointsGUI`):
- Computes average center `center = average(polygon.m_Points)` in world space.
- Computes top extrusion handle position `extrude = center + (up * polygon.extrude)`.
- Records GUI distance `m_DistanceFromHeightHandle = Vector2.Distance(HandleUtility.WorldToGUIPoint(extrude), evt.mousePosition)`.
- When `m_DrawHeightHandles == true`: draws base dot at `center` (`k_HandleColor`), vertical line `Handles.DrawLine(center, extrude)`, and 1D slider handle along `up` axis `extrude = Handles.Slider(extrude, up, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(extrude) * k_HandleSize, Handles.DotHandleCap, 0f)` in green (`k_HandleColorGreen`).
- When dragged: records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Set Polygon Shape Height")`, updates `polygon.extrude = EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(Vector3.Distance(extrude, center) * Mathf.Sign(Vector3.Dot(up, extrude - center)))`, invokes `OnBeginVertexMovement()`, and calls `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(false)`.

### POLYSHAPE EXTRUSION

The conversion from a 2D polyline path into a solid 3D manifold mesh is executed by `AppendElements.CreateShapeFromPolygon(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<Vector3> points, float extrude, bool flipNormals, IList<IList<Vector3>> holePoints)`.

1. Input Validation & Preparation:
- Verifies `mesh != null`. If `points == null || points.Count < 3`, clears geometry via `ClearAndRefreshMesh(mesh)` and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points")`.
- Validates optional hole definitions in `holePoints`: if any hole has fewer than 3 points, returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points in hole " + i)`.
- Flattens vertex coordinates: `vertices = points.ToArray()`. If holes exist, concatenates outer vertices and hole vertices into `combinedVertices`.

2. 2D Planar Triangulation (`Triangulation.TriangulateVertices`):
- Invokes `Triangulation.TriangulateVertices(vertices, out triangles, holeVertices)`.
- Validates surface area: checks `Math.PolygonArea(combinedVertices, indexes) >= Mathf.Epsilon`. If area is below epsilon, clears mesh and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Failure, "Polygon Area < Epsilon")`.
- Creates base Face: `mesh.positionsInternal = combinedVertices`, `mesh.facesInternal = new[] { new Face(indexes) }`, and builds shared vertex table `mesh.sharedVerticesInternal = SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions(combinedVertices)`.
- Validates vertex inclusion: verifies that all input vertices are referenced in triangulation `newFace.distinctIndexesInternal.Length == combinedVertices.Length`. If any vertices are dropped (indicating self-intersections or degenerate topology), clears mesh and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Failure, "Triangulation missing points")`.

3. Normal Alignment & `flipNormals` Handling:
- Computes geometric normal of the triangulated base face: `Vector3 nrm = Math.Normal(mesh, mesh.facesInternal[0])`, and transforms it to world space: `nrm = mesh.gameObject.transform.TransformDirection(nrm)`.
- Compares against local GameObject up vector `mesh.gameObject.transform.up`:
  `if ((flipNormals ? Vector3.Dot(mesh.gameObject.transform.up, nrm) > 0f : Vector3.Dot(mesh.gameObject.transform.up, nrm) < 0f))`
  `    mesh.facesInternal[0].Reverse();`
- Behavior: when `flipNormals == false`, base cap normal is oriented to point opposite to `transform.up` (facing downwards as the bottom cap). When `flipNormals == true`, the winding is inverted so the base faces upwards (interior orientation).

4. 3D Volume Extrusion Algorithm:
- If `extrude == 0.0f`: mesh remains a 2D planar face (1 face).
- If `extrude != 0.0f`:
  1. Duplicates and flips the base face: `mesh.DuplicateAndFlip(mesh.facesInternal)`. This produces face 0 (bottom cap) and face 1 (top cap, facing in reverse direction).
  2. Extrudes the target cap face: selects cap `(flipNormals ? mesh.facesInternal[1] : mesh.facesInternal[0])` and executes `mesh.Extrude(new Face[] { targetCap }, ExtrudeMethod.IndividualFaces, extrude)`.
  3. `Extrude` translates the vertices of the selected cap along its normal by distance `extrude`, automatically generating quad side faces bridging corresponding perimeter edges.
  4. Parity winding inversion: checks `if ((extrude < 0f && !flipNormals) || (extrude > 0f && flipNormals))` and calls `face.Reverse()` on every face in `mesh.facesInternal` to preserve correct outward/inward facing winding under negative heights or inverted normals.
- Calls `mesh.ToMesh()` and `mesh.Refresh()` to rebuild Unity Mesh buffers, computing normals, tangents, and UVs.

5. Error Handling & Visual Fallback:
- If `CreateShapeFromPolygon` returns `ActionResult.Status.Failure` (e.g. self-intersecting polygon path), `PolyShapeTool.RebuildPolyShapeMesh` sets line color `m_CurrentLineColor = k_InvalidLineColor` (`Color.red`), disables height handle rendering `m_DrawHeightHandles = false`, and transitions edit mode out of Height to `PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Edit`.

        public static ActionResult CreateShapeFromPolygon(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<Vector3> points,
            float extrude, bool flipNormals, IList<IList<Vector3>> holePoints)
        {
            if (mesh == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException("mesh");

            if (points == null || points.Count < 3)
            {
                ClearAndRefreshMesh(mesh);
                return new ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points");
            }

            Vector3[] vertices = points.ToArray();

            Vector3[][] holeVertices = null;
            if (holePoints != null && holePoints.Count > 0)
            {
                holeVertices = new Vector3[holePoints.Count][];
                for (int i = 0; i < holePoints.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (holePoints[i] == null || holePoints[i].Count < 3)
                    {
                        ClearAndRefreshMesh(mesh);
                        return new ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points in hole " + i);
                    }

                    holeVertices[i] = holePoints[i].ToArray();
                }
            }

            List<int> triangles;

            Log.PushLogLevel(LogLevel.Error);

            if (Triangulation.TriangulateVertices(vertices, out triangles, holeVertices))
            {
                Vector3[] combinedVertices = null;
                if (holeVertices != null)
                {
                    combinedVertices = new Vector3[vertices.Length + holeVertices.Sum(arr => arr.Length)];
                    Array.Copy(vertices, combinedVertices, vertices.Length);
                    int destinationIndex = vertices.Length;
