> **Godot Note:** In Godot, 2D polygon triangulation is available via `Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon` or `Geometry2D.triangulate_delaunay`. Extrusion can generate top and bottom caps with `ArrayMesh` surfaces, connecting corresponding perimeter vertices into quad strips with `Vector3` normals calculated per face.

### BEZIER SHAPE

The BezierShape subsystem provides 3D pipe and tube mesh generation by tessellating a 3D spline of Bezier knots and sweeping circular cross-section vertex rings along the curve path. Implemented in runtime classes `BezierShape`, `BezierPoint`, `Spline`, and editor `BezierShapeEditor`.

1. Component Architecture & Data Model:
- Class `BezierShape : MonoBehaviour`: decorated with `[AddComponentMenu("")]`, `[DisallowMultipleComponent, ExcludeFromPreset, ExcludeFromObjectFactory]`, and `[RequireComponent(typeof(ProBuilderMesh))]`.
- Fields and properties: `points` (`List<BezierPoint>`), `closeLoop` (`bool`, default `false`), `radius` (`float`, default `0.5f`, minimum `0.001f`), `rows` (`int`, default `8`, range `[3, 512]`), `columns` (`int`, default `16`, range `[3, 512]`), `smooth` (`bool`, default `true`), and `isEditing` (`bool`). Property `mesh` provides lazy retrieval and initialization of `ProBuilderMesh`.
- Struct `BezierPoint`: serialized value type representing a knot:
  - Fields: `position` (`Vector3`), `tangentIn` (`Vector3`), `tangentOut` (`Vector3`), `rotation` (`Quaternion`).
  - Constructor: `BezierPoint(Vector3 position, Vector3 tangentIn, Vector3 tangentOut, Quaternion rotation)`.

2. Tangent Handle Modes (`BezierTangentMode` & `BezierTangentDirection`):
- Enums `BezierTangentMode { Free, Aligned, Mirrored }` and `BezierTangentDirection { In, Out }`.
- Method `EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection master, BezierTangentMode mode)` enforces geometric constraints:
  - `Free`: no handle linking. Moving one tangent leaves the opposite untouched.
  - `Aligned`: maintains collinearity while preserving individual tangent lengths. If `master == In`, sets `tangentOut = position + (tangentOut - position).normalized * (tangentIn - position).magnitude`; if `master == Out`, sets `tangentIn = position + (tangentIn - position).normalized * (tangentOut - position).magnitude`.
  - `Mirrored`: locks tangent handles in exact opposite collinear directions of identical magnitude. If `master == In`, sets `tangentOut = position - (tangentIn - position)`; if `master == Out`, sets `tangentIn = position - (tangentOut - position)`.

3. Default Initialization (`BezierShape.Init()`):
- Initial knot set: adds 2 default control points:
  - Knot 0 at `Vector3.zero` with `tangentIn = (0f, 0f, -2f)`, `tangentOut = (0f, 0f, 2f)`, and `rotation = Quaternion.identity`.
  - Knot 1 at `(3f, 0f, 0f)` with `tangentIn = (3f, 0f, 2f)`, `tangentOut = (3f, 0f, -2f)`, and `rotation = Quaternion.identity`.

4. Spline Tessellation (`Spline.GetControlPoints`):
- Converts discrete Bezier knots into dense interpolated centerline positions and orientations.
- Segment subdivision count `columns` (`subdivisionsPerSegment`): keyframe count is `c` if `closeLoop` else `c - 1` (where `c = bezierPoints.Count`).
- Evaluates cubic Bernstein polynomial via `BezierPoint.CubicPosition(BezierPoint a, BezierPoint b, float t)`:
  `t = Mathf.Clamp01(t); float oneMinusT = 1f - t;`
  `return oneMinusT * oneMinusT * oneMinusT * a.position + 3f * oneMinusT * oneMinusT * t * a.tangentOut + 3f * oneMinusT * t * t * b.tangentIn + t * t * t * b.position;`
- Rotation interpolation: evaluates `Quaternion.Slerp(bezierPoints[i].rotation, bezierPoints[(i + 1) % c].rotation, n / (float)(segments_per_keyframe - 1))`.

5. 3D Surface Sweeping Algorithm (`Spline.Extrude`):
- Extrudes cylindrical tube mesh from tessellated centerline points `points`:
  - Number of circular segments: `int rows = System.Math.Max(3, radiusRows)`. Sets `rowsPlus1 = rows + 1` and `rowsPlus1Times2 = rows * 2`.
  - Total vertex allocation: `vertexCount = ((closeLoop ? cnt : cnt - 1) * 2) * rowsPlus1Times2`.
  - Face allocation: `faceCount = (closeLoop ? cnt : cnt - 1) * rows`.
- Ring Orientation & Miter Evaluation (`GetRingRotation`):
  - For interior or closed-loop points: computes incoming direction `coming = (points[b] - points[a]).normalized` and outgoing direction `leaving = (points[c] - points[b]).normalized`.
  - Average tangent direction: `dir = ((coming + leaving) * .5f).normalized`.
  - Miter factor: `secant = Math.Secant(Vector3.Angle(coming, dir) * Mathf.Deg2Rad)`.
  - Returns `Quaternion.LookRotation(dir)`.
  - Point rotation combining: `rotation_a = rotation_a * pointRotations[i]`.
- Ring Vertex Generation (`VertexRing`):
  - Sweeps circle around orientation frame: for `i` from `0` to `segments - 1` (where `segments = rows + 1`):
    `float rad0 = (i / (float)(segments - 1)) * 360f * Mathf.Deg2Rad;`
    `int n = (i + 1) % segments;`
    `float rad1 = (n / (float)(segments - 1)) * 360f * Mathf.Deg2Rad;`
    `v[i * 2] = offset + (orientation * new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(rad0) * radius, Mathf.Sin(rad0) * radius, 0f));`
    `v[i * 2 + 1] = offset + (orientation * new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(rad1) * radius, Mathf.Sin(rad1) * radius, 0f));`
- Quad Face Construction:
  - Connects Ring A and Ring B vertices: for `n = 0` to `rowsPlus1Times2 - 2` step 2:
    `faces[faceIndex] = new Face(new int[6] { triangleIndex, triangleIndex + 1, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2, triangleIndex + 1, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2 + 1 });`
  - Soft normals: if `smooth == true`, assigns `faces[faceIndex].smoothingGroup = 2`.
  - Advances `faceIndex++` and `triangleIndex += 2`.
- Mesh Construction: calls `target.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(positions, faces)` to populate ProBuilderMesh buffers.

```csharp
    struct BezierPoint
    {
        public Vector3 position;
        public Vector3 tangentIn;
        public Vector3 tangentOut;
        public Quaternion rotation;

        public BezierPoint(Vector3 position, Vector3 tangentIn, Vector3 tangentOut, Quaternion rotation)
        {
            this.position = position;
            this.tangentIn = tangentIn;
            this.tangentOut = tangentOut;
            this.rotation = rotation;
        }

        public void EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection master, BezierTangentMode mode)
        {
            if (mode == BezierTangentMode.Aligned)
            {
                if (master == BezierTangentDirection.In)
                    tangentOut = position + (tangentOut - position).normalized * (tangentIn - position).magnitude;
                else
                    tangentIn = position + (tangentIn - position).normalized * (tangentOut - position).magnitude;
            }
            else if (mode == BezierTangentMode.Mirrored)
            {
                if (master == BezierTangentDirection.In)
                    tangentOut = position - (tangentIn - position);
                else
                    tangentIn = position - (tangentOut - position);
            }
        }
```

```csharp
        internal static List<Vector3> GetControlPoints(IList<BezierPoint> bezierPoints, int subdivisionsPerSegment, bool closeLoop, List<Quaternion> rotations)
        {
            int cols = subdivisionsPerSegment;
            int c = bezierPoints.Count;
            List<Vector3> positions = new List<Vector3>(cols * c);

            if (rotations != null)
            {
                rotations.Clear();
                rotations.Capacity = cols * c;
            }

            int keyframes = (closeLoop ? c : c - 1);

            for (int i = 0; i < keyframes; i++)
            {
                int segments_per_keyframe = ((!closeLoop && i >= c - 2) ? cols + 1 : cols);

                for (int n = 0; n < segments_per_keyframe; n++)
                {
                    float s = cols;

                    positions.Add(BezierPoint.CubicPosition(bezierPoints[i], bezierPoints[(i + 1) % c], n / s));

                    if (rotations != null)
                        rotations.Add(Quaternion.Slerp(bezierPoints[i].rotation, bezierPoints[(i + 1) % c].rotation, n / (float)(segments_per_keyframe - 1)));
                }
            }

            return positions;
        }
```

```csharp
        static Quaternion GetRingRotation(IList<Vector3> points, int i, bool closeLoop, out float secant)
        {
            int cnt = points.Count;
            Vector3 dir;

            if (closeLoop || (i > 0 && i < cnt - 1))
            {
                int a = i < 1 ? cnt - 1 : i - 1;
                int b = i;
                int c = (i + 1) % cnt;

                Vector3 coming = (points[b] - points[a]).normalized;
                Vector3 leaving = (points[c] - points[b]).normalized;

                dir = (coming + leaving) * .5f;

                secant = Math.Secant(Vector3.Angle(coming, dir) * Mathf.Deg2Rad);
            }
            else
            {
                if (i < 1)
                    dir = points[i + 1] - points[i];
                else
                    dir = points[i] - points[i - 1];

                secant = 1f;
            }

            dir.Normalize();

            if (Math.Approx3(dir, Vector3.up) || Math.Approx3(dir, Vector3.zero))
                return Quaternion.identity;

            return Quaternion.LookRotation(dir);
        }
```

### BEZIER EDITING

Interactive editing of Bezier shapes is managed by `BezierShapeEditor : Editor`, which provides SceneView handles for knot positions, tangent handles, axial rotation, and interactive point insertion/deletion.

1. Handle Selection & Internal State (`BezierHandle`):
- Struct `BezierHandle`: serialized handle identifier containing `int index`, `bool isTangent`, and `BezierTangentDirection tangent` (`In` or `Out`). Includes implicit conversions to/from integer index and tangent direction.
- Active handle stored in `m_currentHandle = new BezierHandle(-1, false)`.
- Tangent mode toolbar in Inspector toggles `m_TangentMode` (`Free`, `Aligned`, `Mirrored`) with custom icons `s_TangentModeIcons`.
- Spline curve visualization: `Handles.DrawBezier(m_Points[index].position, m_Points[(index + 1) % count].position, m_Points[index].tangentOut, m_Points[(index + 1) % count].tangentIn, Color.green, EditorGUIUtility.whiteTexture, 1f)`.

2. Moving Knots vs Tangent Handles (`OnSceneGUI`):
- When knot is selected (`m_currentHandle == index && !m_currentHandle.isTangent`):
  - Position Handle: renders 3D translation gizmo `prev = Handles.PositionHandle(prev, Quaternion.identity)`.
  - Rigid Tangent Translation: when knot position moves by delta `dir = prev - point.position`, translates both tangents simultaneously: `point.position = prev; point.tangentIn += dir; point.tangentOut += dir;`.
  - Axial Spline Rotation: computes look direction `Vector3 rd = BezierPoint.GetLookDirection(m_Points, index, prev_index, next_index)` where `prev_index` and `next_index` account for `m_CloseLoop`. Sets handle matrix `Handles.matrix = pm * Matrix4x4.TRS(point.position, Quaternion.LookRotation(rd), Vector3.one)` and renders rotation disc `point.rotation = Handles.Disc(point.rotation, Vector3.zero, Vector3.forward, size, false, 0f)`.
- When tangent handle is selected (`m_currentHandle == index && m_currentHandle.isTangent`):
  - Tangent In: renders `Handles.PositionHandle(point.tangentIn, Quaternion.identity)`. Dragging snaps via `EditorSnapping.MoveSnap` and enforces tangent mode: `point.EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection.In, m_TangentMode)`. Draws blue line `Handles.DrawLine(point.position, point.tangentIn)`.
  - Tangent Out: renders `Handles.PositionHandle(point.tangentOut, Quaternion.identity)`. Dragging snaps via `EditorSnapping.MoveSnap` and enforces tangent mode: `point.EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection.Out, m_TangentMode)`. Draws red line `Handles.DrawLine(point.position, point.tangentOut)`.
- Unselected Knots & Tangents: rendered with `FreeMoveHandle` using `Handles.DotHandleCap` (`bezierPositionHandleColor = Color(.01f, .8f, .99f, 1f)` for knots, `bezierTangentHandleColor = Color(.6f, .6f, .6f, .8f)` for tangents). Clicking any unselected handle selects it and sets `m_currentHandle`.

3. Inserting Control Points Along Spline Curve (`OnSceneGUI`):
- Real-time mouse hover test against dense interpolated control points `m_ControlPoints`:
  `Vector3 p = EditorHandleUtility.ClosestPointToPolyLine(m_ControlPoints, out index, out distanceToLine, false, null);`
- Validates hover: checks `!IsHoveringHandlePoint(e.mousePosition)` (distance to existing knot/tangent GUI points >= `k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl`) and `distanceToLine < PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` (10 pixels).
- Visual feedback: draws green dot handle `Handles.DotHandleCap(-1, p, Quaternion.identity, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(p) * .05f, e.type)`.
- Insertion on click (`EventType.MouseDown` with `button == 0`):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(m_Target, "Add Point")`.
  - Computes tangent direction from neighbouring interpolated points: `dir = m_ControlPoints[(index + 1) % count] - m_ControlPoints[index]`.
  - Computes knot insertion index: `int insertIndex = (index / m_Columns) + 1`.
  - Inserts new knot: `m_Points.Insert(insertIndex, new BezierPoint(p, p - dir, p + dir, Quaternion.identity))`.
  - Rebuilds geometry via `UpdateMesh(true)`.

4. Adding and Deleting Control Points via UI & Keyboard:
- Inspector 'Add Point' Button: appends duplicate of last knot `m_Points.Add(new BezierPoint(last.position, last.tangentIn, last.tangentOut, Quaternion.identity))` or calls `m_Target.Init()` if empty, setting `m_currentHandle = (BezierHandle)(m_Points.Count - 1)`.
- Inspector 'Clear Points' Button: records undo and clears all knots via `m_Points.Clear()`, calling `UpdateMesh(true)`.
- Keyboard Deletion: pressing `KeyCode.Backspace` (macOS Delete) in SceneView with valid `m_currentHandle` records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(m_Target, "Delete Bezier Point")`, deletes knot `m_Points.RemoveAt(m_currentHandle)`, and updates mesh.
- Inspector Coordinate Editing (`DoBezierPointGUI`): displays Vector3 fields for `Position`, `Tan. In` (annotated with blue dot label), `Tan. Out` (annotated with red dot label), and Euler `Rotation`. Modifications invoke `SetPosition`, `SetTangentIn`, and `SetTangentOut` with `m_TangentMode`.

5. Vertex Modification Lifecycle & Lightmapping Optimization:
- When handle dragging begins, `OnBeginVertexModification()` sets `m_IsMoving = true`, records undo `"Modify Bezier Spline"`, and pauses continuous lightmapping via `Lightmapping.PushGIWorkflowMode()`.
- When dragging ends (`EventType.MouseUp` or `EventType.Ignore`), `OnFinishVertexModification()` sets `m_IsMoving = false`, restores GI via `Lightmapping.PopGIWorkflowMode()`, optimizes ProBuilderMesh via `m_CurrentObject.Optimize()`, and refreshes editor via `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

# Selection & Picking

## E01: Selection picker rendering and raycasting

### COLOR ENCODING PICKING

ProBuilder implements offscreen GPU element picking by rendering unique color-encoded identifiers for faces, vertices, and edges into an offscreen `RenderTexture` (lookup texture), reading back pixel buffers to the CPU, and decoding the pixel colors into references to specific mesh elements.

1. Color Encoding and Decoding Algorithms:
- Element identifiers are 32-bit unsigned integers (`uint`), where the lower 24 bits store the unique index and the highest byte is reserved. Encoded colors are stored in 32-bit RGBA structures (`Color32`) with alpha fixed to 255 (`0xFF`).
- Bit-packing considers host architecture endianness via `System.BitConverter.IsLittleEndian`:
  - Little-Endian Encoding (`EncodeRGBA`):
    - Red: `(byte)(hash >> 16 & 0xFF)`
    - Green: `(byte)(hash >> 8 & 0xFF)`
    - Blue: `(byte)(hash & 0xFF)`
    - Alpha: `255`
  - Big-Endian Encoding (`EncodeRGBA`):
    - Red: `(byte)(hash >> 24 & 0xFF)`
    - Green: `(byte)(hash >> 16 & 0xFF)`
    - Blue: `(byte)(hash >> 8 & 0xFF)`
    - Alpha: `255`
  - Little-Endian Decoding (`DecodeRGBA`):
    - `return (uint)color.r << 16 | (uint)color.g << 8 | (uint)color.b;`
  - Big-Endian Decoding (`DecodeRGBA`):
    - `return (uint)color.r << 24 | (uint)color.g << 16 | (uint)color.b << 8;`
- Reserved Hash Values in `SelectionPickerRenderer`:
  - `k_PickerHashNone = 0x00`: Indicates no hit / background clear color / black occlusion mask.
  - `k_PickerHashMin = 0x1`: Lowest valid hash index.
  - `k_PickerHashMax = 0x00FFFFFF`: Background clear white color (`0xFFFFFF`).
  - `k_MinEdgePixelsForValidSelection = 1`: Minimum threshold of edge pixels required to register an edge selection.

2. Face Picking Geometry Generation (`GenerateFacePickingObjects`):
- Takes `IList<ProBuilderMesh> selection` and allocates `GameObject[] pickerObjects` and `Dictionary<uint, (ProBuilderMesh, Face)> map`.
- Index starts at `uint index = 0`.
- For each `ProBuilderMesh pb` in `selection`:
  - Instantiates temporary `Mesh m`.
  - Sets `m.vertices = pb.positionsInternal` and `m.triangles = pb.facesInternal.SelectMany(x => x.indexesInternal).ToArray()`.
  - Allocates `Color32[] colors = new Color32[m.vertexCount]`.
  - For each `Face f` in `pb.facesInternal`:
    - Computes `Color32 color = EncodeRGBA(index++)`.
    - Adds lookup entry mapping `DecodeRGBA(color)` to pair `(pb, f)` in `map`.
    - Assigns `colors[f.distinctIndexesInternal[n]] = color` for all distinct indices in the face.
  - Assigns `m.colors32 = colors`.
  - Creates a temporary `GameObject` via `InternalUtility.MeshGameObjectWithTransform(pb.name + " (Face Depth Test)", pb.transform, m, BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial, true)`.
  - Sets `BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial.SetColor("_Tint", Color.white)` (`k_Whitef`).

3. Vertex Picking Geometry Generation (`GenerateVertexPickingObjects` and `BuildVertexMesh`):
- Vertex picking uses screen-facing billboard quads for each shared vertex group.
- Index starts at `uint index = 0x02` to avoid `0x00` (black occlusion mask) and `0x01`.
- Length is clamped to `Math.Min(pb.sharedVerticesInternal.Length, ushort.MaxValue / 4 - 1)` (maximum 16382 quads) due to 16-bit mesh index limits.
- For each shared vertex index `i`:
  - Position `v = pb.positionsInternal[pb.sharedVerticesInternal[i][0]]`.
  - 4 vertices placed at `v` in `t_billboards`.
  - Quad UVs: `(0,0)`, `(1,0)`, `(0,1)`, `(1,1)` in `t_uvs`.
  - Billboard vertex offsets: `-up - right`, `-up + right`, `up - right`, `up + right` in `t_uv2`.
  - Triangles: two triangles `(0,1,2)` and `(1,3,2)` per quad in `t_tris`.
  - Encodes `Color32 color = EncodeRGBA(index)` and registers mapping of `index++` to `(pb, i)` in `map`.
  - Assigns `color` to all 4 quad vertices in `t_col`.
- Creates temporary `GameObject` with `BuiltinMaterials.vertexPickerMaterial`.
- When `doDepthTest == true`, instantiates duplicate depth mask GameObjects with `pb.mesh` and `BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial` with `_Tint` set to `Color.black` (`k_Blackf`).

4. Edge Picking Geometry Generation (`GenerateEdgePickingObjects` and `BuildEdgeMesh`):
- Line mesh generation starts at `uint index = 0x2`.
- Counts total edges across faces, clamped to `Math.Min(edgeCount, ushort.MaxValue / 2 - 1)`.
- Allocates `Vector3[] positions` and `Color32[] color` of length `elementCount * 2`.
- For each edge in each face:
  - `positions[positionIndex + 0] = pb.positionsInternal[edge.a]`
  - `positions[positionIndex + 1] = pb.positionsInternal[edge.b]`
  - Encodes `Color32 c = EncodeRGBA(index)` and registers mapping of `index++` to `(pb, edge)` in `map`.
  - `color[positionIndex + 0] = c` and `color[positionIndex + 1] = c`.
  - `tris[positionIndex + 0] = positionIndex + 0` and `tris[positionIndex + 1] = positionIndex + 1`.
- Sets mesh topology to `MeshTopology.Lines` via `mesh.SetIndices(tris, MeshTopology.Lines, 0)`.
- Creates temporary `GameObject` with `BuiltinMaterials.edgePickerMaterial`.
- If `doDepthTest == true`, also creates depth mask GameObjects with `BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial` and `_Tint = Color.black`.

5. Offscreen Render and Cleanup Lifecycle:
- `pickerRenderer.RenderLookupTexture(camera, BuiltinMaterials.selectionPickerShader, "ProBuilderPicker", width, height)` executes rendering.
- All generated temporary GameObjects and shared meshes are destroyed via `UObject.DestroyImmediate`.

```csharp
        public static uint DecodeRGBA(Color32 color)
        {
            uint r = (uint)color.r;
            uint g = (uint)color.g;
            uint b = (uint)color.b;

            if (System.BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
                return r << 16 | g << 8 | b;
            else
                return r << 24 | g << 16 | b << 8;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Encodes the low 24 bits of a 32-bit unsigned int to Color32.RGB values, using 255 for the alpha.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="hash"></param>
        /// <returns>Color32 containing the encoded values.</returns>
        public static Color32 EncodeRGBA(uint hash)
        {
            // skip using BitConverter.GetBytes since this is super simple
            // bit math, and allocating arrays for each conversion is expensive
            if (System.BitConverter.IsLittleEndian)
                return new Color32(
                    (byte)(hash >> 16 & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(hash >>  8 & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(hash       & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(255));
            else
                return new Color32(
                    (byte)(hash >> 24 & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(hash >> 16 & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(hash >>  8 & 0xFF),
                    (byte)(255));
        }
```

```csharp
        static GameObject[] GenerateFacePickingObjects(
            IList<ProBuilderMesh> selection,
            out Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Face>> map)
        {
            int selectionCount = selection.Count;
            GameObject[] pickerObjects = new GameObject[selectionCount];
            map = new Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Face>>();

            uint index = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < selectionCount; i++)
            {
                var pb = selection[i];

                Mesh m = new Mesh();
                m.vertices = pb.positionsInternal;
                m.triangles = pb.facesInternal.SelectMany(x => x.indexesInternal).ToArray();
                Color32[] colors = new Color32[m.vertexCount];

                foreach (Face f in pb.facesInternal)
                {
                    Color32 color = EncodeRGBA(index++);
                    map.Add(DecodeRGBA(color), new SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Face>(pb, f));

                    for (int n = 0; n < f.distinctIndexesInternal.Length; n++)
                        colors[f.distinctIndexesInternal[n]] = color;
                }

                m.colors32 = colors;

                GameObject go = InternalUtility.MeshGameObjectWithTransform(pb.name + " (Face Depth Test)", pb.transform, m,
                    BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial, true);

                pickerObjects[i] = go;
            }

            return pickerObjects;
        }
```

```csharp
        static Mesh BuildVertexMesh(ProBuilderMesh pb, Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, int>> map, ref uint index)
        {
            int length = System.Math.Min(pb.sharedVerticesInternal.Length, ushort.MaxValue / 4 - 1);

            Vector3[]   t_billboards        = new Vector3[length * 4];
            Vector2[]   t_uvs               = new Vector2[length * 4];
            Vector2[]   t_uv2               = new Vector2[length * 4];
            Color[]     t_col               = new Color[length * 4];
            int[]       t_tris              = new int[length * 6];

            int n = 0;
            int t = 0;

            Vector3 up = Vector3.up;
            Vector3 right = Vector3.right;

            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
            {
                Vector3 v = pb.positionsInternal[pb.sharedVerticesInternal[i][0]];

                t_billboards[t + 0] = v;
                t_billboards[t + 1] = v;
                t_billboards[t + 2] = v;
                t_billboards[t + 3] = v;

                t_uvs[t + 0] = Vector3.zero;
                t_uvs[t + 1] = Vector3.right;
                t_uvs[t + 2] = Vector3.up;
                t_uvs[t + 3] = Vector3.one;

                t_uv2[t + 0] = -up - right;
                t_uv2[t + 1] = -up + right;
                t_uv2[t + 2] =  up - right;
                t_uv2[t + 3] =  up + right;

                t_tris[n + 0] = t + 0;
                t_tris[n + 1] = t + 1;
                t_tris[n + 2] = t + 2;
                t_tris[n + 3] = t + 1;
                t_tris[n + 4] = t + 3;
                t_tris[n + 5] = t + 2;

                Color32 color = EncodeRGBA(index);
                map.Add(index++, new SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, int>(pb, i));

                t_col[t + 0] = color;
                t_col[t + 1] = color;
                t_col[t + 2] = color;
                t_col[t + 3] = color;

                t += 4;
                n += 6;
            }

            Mesh mesh = new Mesh();
            mesh.name = "Vertex Billboard";
            mesh.vertices = t_billboards;
            mesh.uv = t_uvs;
            mesh.uv2 = t_uv2;
            mesh.colors = t_col;
            mesh.triangles = t_tris;

            return mesh;
        }
```

```csharp
        static Mesh BuildEdgeMesh(ProBuilderMesh pb, Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Edge>> map, ref uint index)
        {
            int edgeCount = 0;
            int faceCount = pb.faceCount;

            for (int i = 0; i < faceCount; i++)
                edgeCount += pb.facesInternal[i].edgesInternal.Length;

            int elementCount = System.Math.Min(edgeCount, ushort.MaxValue / 2 - 1);

            Vector3[] positions = new Vector3[elementCount * 2];
            Color32[] color = new Color32[elementCount * 2];
            int[] tris = new int[elementCount * 2];

            int edgeIndex = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < faceCount && edgeIndex < elementCount; i++)
            {
                for (int n = 0; n < pb.facesInternal[i].edgesInternal.Length && edgeIndex < elementCount; n++)
                {
                    var edge = pb.facesInternal[i].edgesInternal[n];

                    Vector3 a = pb.positionsInternal[edge.a];
                    Vector3 b = pb.positionsInternal[edge.b];
                    int positionIndex = edgeIndex * 2;

                    positions[positionIndex + 0] = a;
                    positions[positionIndex + 1] = b;

                    Color32 c = EncodeRGBA(index);

                    map.Add(index++, new SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Edge>(pb, edge));

                    color[positionIndex + 0] = c;
                    color[positionIndex + 1] = c;

                    tris[positionIndex + 0] = positionIndex + 0;
                    tris[positionIndex + 1] = positionIndex + 1;

                    edgeIndex++;
                }
            }

            Mesh mesh = new Mesh();
            mesh.name = "Edge Billboard";
            mesh.vertices = positions;
            mesh.colors32 = color;
            mesh.subMeshCount = 1;
            mesh.SetIndices(tris, MeshTopology.Lines, 0);

            return mesh;
        }
```

> **Godot Note:** In Godot 4, color-encoded picking can be implemented using a dedicated SubViewport set to UPDATE_ONCE with an integer color format (RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R32_UINT or RenderingDevice.DATA_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) or an unshaded spatial shader writing encoded index IDs to ALBEDO. Alternatively, CPU-side GPU compute dispatch with RenderingDevice can read back the buffer without stalling the main rendering thread.

### RECT SELECTION

ProBuilder supports box/drag selection of vertices, faces, and edges through `SelectionPicker` and `SelectionPickerRenderer`. Selection behavior is configured via `PickerOptions`, which contains `depthTest` (`bool`) and `rectSelectMode` (`RectSelectMode.Partial` versus `RectSelectMode.Complete`).

1. Coordinate Space Transformation:
- `rect` is supplied in GUI space coordinates where `(0, 0)` is the top-left corner of the camera viewport and coordinates span `[0..width, 0..height]`.
- When reading pixels from the bottom-left origin texture buffer, `SelectionPickerRenderer` transforms the bounds:
  - `int ox = Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.x));`
  - `int oy = Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt((tex.height - pickerRect.y) - pickerRect.height));`
  - `int width = Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.width);`
  - `int height = Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.height);`

2. Face Rectangle Selection (`SelectionPicker.PickFacesInRect`):
- Partial Mode with Depth Testing (`options.depthTest == true && options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Partial`):
  - Delegates to `SelectionPickerRenderer.PickFacesInRect(cam, rect, selectable, width, height)`.
  - Renders face color lookup texture.
  - Retrieves raw pixel array `Color32[] pix = tex.GetPixels32()`.
  - Iterates rows `y` from `oy` to `Min(oy + height, imageHeight)` and columns `x` from `ox` to `Min(ox + width, imageWidth)`.
  - Decodes `uint v = SelectionPickerRenderer.DecodeRGBA(pix[y * imageWidth + x])`.
  - Maintains `HashSet<uint> used` to ensure unique lookups: if `used.Add(v)` and `map.TryGetValue(v, out hit)` succeed, appends `hit.item2` (`Face`) to `selected[hit.item1]`.
- Complete Mode or No Depth Testing:
  - Transforms all vertex positions to GUI space: `screenPoints[nn] = cam.ScreenToGuiPoint(cam.WorldToScreenPoint(trs.TransformPoint(positions[nn])), pixelsPerPoint)`.
  - Complete Mode (`options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Complete`):
    - Evaluates near clip clipping: `if (screenPoints[face.indexesInternal[0]].z < cam.nearClipPlane) continue;`.
    - Evaluates if first index is inside: `if (rect.Contains(screenPoints[face.indexesInternal[0]]))`.
    - Iterates remaining distinct indices `q = 1..face.distinctIndexesInternal.Length - 1`. If any index is behind `nearClipPlane` or outside `rect`, rejects the face.
    - If all vertices are enclosed, evaluates occlusion: `if (!options.depthTest || !HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded(cam, pb, trs.TransformPoint(Math.Average(positions, face.distinctIndexesInternal)))) selectedFaces.Add(face);`.
  - Partial Mode without Depth Testing (`options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Partial && !options.depthTest`):
    - Computes 2D bounding box `Bounds2D poly = new Bounds2D(screenPoints, face.edgesInternal)`.
    - If `poly.Intersects(rect)`:
      - Check A: If `rect` contains any polygon vertex with `p.z > cam.nearClipPlane`, marks `overlaps = true`.
      - Check B: If not, checks if the polygon contains any of the 4 `rect` corners (`tl`, `tr`, `bl`, `br`) using `Math.PointInPolygon(screenPoints, poly, face.edgesInternal, corner)`.
      - Check C: If not, tests 2D line segment intersection between all face edges and the 4 rectangle boundary segments using `Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect`.
      - If `overlaps == true`, adds face to selection.

3. Edge Rectangle Selection (`SelectionPicker.PickEdgesInRect`):
- Partial Mode with Depth Testing (`options.depthTest == true && options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Partial`):
  - Delegates to `SelectionPickerRenderer.PickEdgesInRect(cam, rect, selectable, true, width, height)`.
  - Renders edge line mesh and depth mask.
  - Accumulates hit counts per color identifier in `Dictionary<uint, uint> pixelCount`.
  - Requires `kvp.Value > k_MinEdgePixelsForValidSelection` (`k_MinEdgePixelsForValidSelection = 1`, requiring strictly 2 or more pixels) to reject subpixel edge false positives.
- Complete Mode or No Depth Testing:
  - Evaluates both edge endpoints `a` and `b` in GUI coordinates.
  - Complete Mode: skips if `a.z < cam.nearClipPlane || b.z < cam.nearClipPlane`. Verifies `rect.Contains(a) && rect.Contains(b)`. If `options.depthTest == true`, checks occlusion at the midpoint: `!HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded(cam, pb, (posA + posB) * 0.5f)`.
  - Partial Mode: tests 2D line clipping via `Math.RectIntersectsLineSegment(rect, a, b)`.

4. Vertex Rectangle Selection (`SelectionPicker.PickVerticesInRect`):
- Depth Testing (`options.depthTest == true`):
  - Delegates to `SelectionPickerRenderer.PickVerticesInRect`.
  - Scans pixels in `pickerRect`, decodes IDs, maps to `(ProBuilderMesh, int sharedIndex)`.
  - Post-processing for coincident vertices: iterates selected shared vertex indices, computes `VectorHash.GetHashCode(positions[sharedVertices[x][0]])`, and selects all shared vertices in the mesh sharing identical spatial coordinates.
- No Depth Testing (`options.depthTest == false`):
  - Bypasses GPU rendering for speed. Iterates `pb.sharedVerticesInternal`, transforms `positions[sharedIndexes[n][0]]` to screen coordinates, clips `p.z < cam.nearClipPlane`, scales by `pixelsPerPoint`, and tests `rect.Contains(p)`.

**../probuilder-ref/Runtime/Core/SelectionPicker.cs:87-216**
```csharp
        public static Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Face>> PickFacesInRect(
            Camera cam,
            Rect rect,
            IList<ProBuilderMesh> selectable,
            PickerOptions options,
            float pixelsPerPoint = 1f)
        {
            if (options.depthTest && options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Partial)
            {
                return SelectionPickerRenderer.PickFacesInRect(
                    cam,
                    rect,
                    selectable,
                    (int)(cam.pixelWidth / pixelsPerPoint),
                    (int)(cam.pixelHeight / pixelsPerPoint));
            }

            var selected = new Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Face>>();

            foreach (var pb in selectable)
            {
                if (!pb.selectable)
                    continue;

                HashSet<Face> selectedFaces = new HashSet<Face>();
                Transform trs = pb.transform;
                Vector3[] positions = pb.positionsInternal;
                Vector3[] screenPoints = new Vector3[pb.vertexCount];

                for (int nn = 0; nn < pb.vertexCount; nn++)
                    screenPoints[nn] = cam.ScreenToGuiPoint(cam.WorldToScreenPoint(trs.TransformPoint(positions[nn])), pixelsPerPoint);

                for (int n = 0; n < pb.facesInternal.Length; n++)
                {
                    Face face = pb.facesInternal[n];

                    // rect select = complete
                    if (options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Complete)
                    {
                        // face is behind the camera
                        if (screenPoints[face.indexesInternal[0]].z < cam.nearClipPlane)
                            continue;

                        // only check the first index per quad, and if it checks out, then check every other point
                        if (rect.Contains(screenPoints[face.indexesInternal[0]]))
                        {
                            bool nope = false;

                            for (int q = 1; q < face.distinctIndexesInternal.Length; q++)
                            {
                                int index = face.distinctIndexesInternal[q];

                                if (screenPoints[index].z < cam.nearClipPlane || !rect.Contains(screenPoints[index]))
                                {
                                    nope = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }

                            if (!nope)
                            {
                                if (!options.depthTest ||
                                    !HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded(cam, pb, trs.TransformPoint(Math.Average(positions, face.distinctIndexesInternal))))
                                {
                                    selectedFaces.Add(face);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // rect select = partial
                    else
                    {
                        Bounds2D poly = new Bounds2D(screenPoints, face.edgesInternal);
                        bool overlaps = false;

                        if (poly.Intersects(rect))
                        {
                            // if rect contains one point of polygon, it overlaps
                            for (int nn = 0; nn < face.distinctIndexesInternal.Length && !overlaps; nn++)
                            {
                                Vector3 p = screenPoints[face.distinctIndexesInternal[nn]];
                                overlaps = p.z > cam.nearClipPlane && rect.Contains(p);
                            }

                            // if polygon contains one point of rect, it overlaps. otherwise check for edge intersections
                            if (!overlaps)
                            {
                                Vector2 tl = new Vector2(rect.xMin, rect.yMax);
                                Vector2 tr = new Vector2(rect.xMax, rect.yMax);
                                Vector2 bl = new Vector2(rect.xMin, rect.yMin);
                                Vector2 br = new Vector2(rect.xMax, rect.yMin);

                                overlaps = Math.PointInPolygon(screenPoints, poly, face.edgesInternal, tl);
                                if (!overlaps) overlaps = Math.PointInPolygon(screenPoints, poly, face.edgesInternal, tr);
                                if (!overlaps) overlaps = Math.PointInPolygon(screenPoints, poly, face.edgesInternal, br);
                                if (!overlaps) overlaps = Math.PointInPolygon(screenPoints, poly, face.edgesInternal, bl);

                                // if any polygon edge intersects rect
                                for (int nn = 0; nn < face.edgesInternal.Length && !overlaps; nn++)
                                {
                                    if (Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect(tr, tl, screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].a], screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].b]))
                                        overlaps = true;
                                    else if (Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect(tl, bl, screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].a], screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].b]))
                                        overlaps = true;
                                    else if (Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect(bl, br, screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].a], screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].b]))
                                        overlaps = true;
                                    else if (Math.GetLineSegmentIntersect(br, tl, screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].a], screenPoints[face.edgesInternal[nn].b]))
                                        overlaps = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // don't test occlusion since that case is handled special
                        if (overlaps)
                            selectedFaces.Add(face);
                    }
                }

                selected.Add(pb, selectedFaces);
            }

            return selected;
        }

        /// Picks the <see cref="Edge" /> objects contained within a rect (rectangular selection).
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cam">Use this camera to evaluate whether any edge object(s) are inside the `rect`.</param>
        /// <param name="rect">Rect is in GUI space, where 0,0 is the top left of the screen, and `width = cam.pixelWidth / pointsPerPixel`.</param>
        /// <param name="selectable">The collection of objects to check for selectability. ProBuilder verifies whether these objects fall inside the `rect`.</param>
```

**../probuilder-ref/Runtime/Core/SelectionPicker.cs:222-300**
```csharp
        public static Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Edge>> PickEdgesInRect(
            Camera cam,
            Rect rect,
            IList<ProBuilderMesh> selectable,
            PickerOptions options,
            float pixelsPerPoint = 1f)
        {
            if (options.depthTest && options.rectSelectMode == RectSelectMode.Partial)
            {
                return SelectionPickerRenderer.PickEdgesInRect(
                    cam,
                    rect,
                    selectable,
                    true,
                    (int)(cam.pixelWidth / pixelsPerPoint),
                    (int)(cam.pixelHeight / pixelsPerPoint));
            }

            var selected = new Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Edge>>();

            foreach (var pb in selectable)
            {
                if (!pb.selectable)
                    continue;

                Transform trs = pb.transform;
                var selectedEdges = new HashSet<Edge>();

                for (int i = 0, fc = pb.faceCount; i < fc; i++)
                {
                    var edges = pb.facesInternal[i].edgesInternal;

                    for (int n = 0, ec = edges.Length; n < ec; n++)
                    {
                        var edge = edges[n];

                        var posA = trs.TransformPoint(pb.positionsInternal[edge.a]);
                        var posB = trs.TransformPoint(pb.positionsInternal[edge.b]);

                        Vector3 a = cam.ScreenToGuiPoint(cam.WorldToScreenPoint(posA), pixelsPerPoint);
                        Vector3 b = cam.ScreenToGuiPoint(cam.WorldToScreenPoint(posB), pixelsPerPoint);

                        switch (options.rectSelectMode)
                        {
                            case RectSelectMode.Complete:
                            {
                                // if either of the positions are clipped by the camera we cannot possibly select both, skip it
                                if ((a.z < cam.nearClipPlane || b.z < cam.nearClipPlane))
                                    continue;

                                if (rect.Contains(a) && rect.Contains(b))
                                {
                                    if (!options.depthTest || !HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded(cam, pb, (posA + posB) * .5f))
                                        selectedEdges.Add(edge);
                                }

                                break;
                            }

                            case RectSelectMode.Partial:
                            {
                                // partial + depth test is covered earlier
                                if (Math.RectIntersectsLineSegment(rect, a, b))
                                    selectedEdges.Add(edge);

                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                selected.Add(pb, selectedEdges);
            }

            return selected;
        }

        /// Returns the first face on a ProBuilder mesh that collides with the ray cast by ProBuilder, given a specific screen position and camera.
```

```csharp
        public static Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Face>> PickFacesInRect(
            Camera camera,
            Rect pickerRect,
            IList<ProBuilderMesh> selection,
            int renderTextureWidth = -1,
            int renderTextureHeight = -1)
        {
            Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Face>> map;
            Texture2D tex = RenderSelectionPickerTexture(camera, selection, out map, renderTextureWidth, renderTextureHeight);

            Color32[] pix = tex.GetPixels32();

            int ox = System.Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.x));
            int oy = System.Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt((tex.height - pickerRect.y) - pickerRect.height));
            int imageWidth = tex.width;
            int imageHeight = tex.height;
            int width = Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.width);
            int height = Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.height);
            UObject.DestroyImmediate(tex);

            Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Face>> selected = new Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<Face>>();
            SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, Face> hit;
            HashSet<Face> faces = null;
            HashSet<uint> used = new HashSet<uint>();

#if PB_RENDER_PICKER_TEXTURE
            List<Color> rectImg = new List<Color>();
#endif

            for (int y = oy; y < System.Math.Min(oy + height, imageHeight); y++)
            {
                for (int x = ox; x < System.Math.Min(ox + width, imageWidth); x++)
                {
#if PB_RENDER_PICKER_TEXTURE
                    rectImg.Add(pix[y * imageWidth + x]);
#endif

                    uint v = SelectionPickerRenderer.DecodeRGBA(pix[y * imageWidth + x]);

                    if (used.Add(v) && map.TryGetValue(v, out hit))
                    {
                        if (selected.TryGetValue(hit.item1, out faces))
                            faces.Add(hit.item2);
                        else
                            selected.Add(hit.item1, new HashSet<Face>() { hit.item2 });
                    }
                }
            }

#if PB_RENDER_PICKER_TEXTURE
            if (width > 0 && height > 0)
            {
//              Debug.Log("used: \n" + used.Select(x => string.Format("{0} ({1})", x, EncodeRGBA(x))).ToString("\n"));
                Texture2D img = new Texture2D(width, height);
                img.SetPixels(rectImg.ToArray());
                img.Apply();

                System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes("Assets/rect.png", bytes);
#if UNITY_EDITOR
                UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.Refresh();
#endif
                UObject.DestroyImmediate(img);
            }
#endif

            return selected;
```

### CLICK SELECTION

Single-click element selection in ProBuilder is performed via direct geometric raycasting using `SelectionPicker.PickFace` and `HandleUtility.FaceRaycast`.

1. Single Click Face Picking (`SelectionPicker.PickFace`):
- Constructs a world ray from the screen click position: `Ray ray = camera.ScreenPointToRay(mousePosition)`.
- Calls `HandleUtility.FaceRaycast(ray, pickable, out hit, Mathf.Infinity, CullingMode.Back)`.
- If the ray hits a face, retrieves and returns `pickable.facesInternal[hit.face]`; otherwise returns `null`.

2. RaycastHit Data Structure (`RaycastHit`):
- `float distance`: Ray distance from origin to intersection point in model units.
- `Vector3 point`: Hit coordinate in model space.
- `Vector3 normal`: Surface normal vector of the intersected triangle.
- `int face`: Zero-based index of the hit `Face` in `ProBuilderMesh.facesInternal`.

3. Raycast Algorithm (`HandleUtility.FaceRaycast`):
- Step 1: Transforms world ray into mesh model space:
  - `worldRay.origin -= mesh.transform.position;`
  - `worldRay.origin = mesh.transform.worldToLocalMatrix * worldRay.origin;`
  - `worldRay.direction = mesh.transform.worldToLocalMatrix * worldRay.direction;`
- Step 2: Iterates over all faces `i = 0..faces.Length - 1` (skipping any face in `HashSet<Face> ignore`).
- Step 3: Iterates triangle triplets `j = 0; j < indexes.Length; j += 3`:
  - `a = positions[indexes[j + 0]]`, `b = positions[indexes[j + 1]]`, `c = positions[indexes[j + 2]]`.
  - Computes unnormalized surface normal: `Vector3 nrm = Vector3.Cross(b - a, c - a)`.
  - Computes dot product with ray direction: `float dot = Vector3.Dot(worldRay.direction, nrm)`.
  - Culling check:
    - `CullingMode.Front`: Skip if `dot < 0f` (culled front-facing).
    - `CullingMode.Back`: Skip if `dot > 0f` (culled back-facing).
    - `CullingMode.None`: Do not skip.
  - Tests ray-triangle intersection via `Math.RayIntersectsTriangle(worldRay, a, b, c, out dist, out point)` (Möller-Trumbore algorithm calculating determinant `det = Vector3.Dot(e1, Vector3.Cross(dir, e2))` and barycentric coordinates `u` and `v`).
  - If hit occurs and `dist < OutHitPoint` and `dist <= distance`:
    - Updates `OutHitPoint = dist`, `OutHitFace = i`, `OutNrm = nrm`.
- Step 4: Instantiates `hit = new RaycastHit(OutHitPoint, worldRay.GetPoint(OutHitPoint), OutNrm, OutHitFace)` and returns `OutHitFace > -1`.

4. Dual Cull Mode Raycasting (`HandleUtility.FaceRaycastBothCullModes`):
- Raycasts against both front-facing (`CullingMode.Back`) and back-facing (`CullingMode.Front`) triangles simultaneously.
- Stores separate hits in `ref (Face, Vector3) back` and `ref (Face, Vector3) front`, allowing tools to prefer the surface nearest the camera or navigate interior geometry.

5. Distance Calculations and Point Occlusion (`HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded`):
- Tests whether a 3D point is occluded by mesh geometry when viewed from `cam`:
  - `Vector3 dir = (cam.transform.position - worldPoint).normalized;`
  - `Ray ray = new Ray(worldPoint + dir * .0001f, dir);` (nudged by 0.0001 units towards camera to avoid self-intersection).
  - `return FaceRaycast(ray, pb, out hit, Vector3.Distance(cam.transform.position, worldPoint), CullingMode.Front);`.
  - If any front-facing triangle is struck between the point and the camera position, returns `true` (occluded).

6. Scene Selection Data Structures (`SelectionPickerSettings.cs`):
- `SceneSelection`: Encapsulates selection state for a single `GameObject` and `ProBuilderMesh`, maintaining `List<int> m_Vertices`, `List<Edge> m_Edges`, and `List<Face> m_Faces` with properties `vertexes`, `edges`, `faces`, and mutation methods `SetSingleFace`, `SetSingleVertex`, `SetSingleEdge`, and `Clear()`.
- `VertexPickerEntry`: Value type struct storing `ProBuilderMesh mesh`, `int vertex`, `float screenDistance`, and `Vector3 worldPosition` for sorting nearest vertices to a mouse click.

```csharp
        public static Face PickFace(Camera camera, Vector3 mousePosition, ProBuilderMesh pickable)
        {
            Ray ray = camera.ScreenPointToRay(mousePosition);

            if (HandleUtility.FaceRaycast(ray, pickable, out hit, Mathf.Infinity, CullingMode.Back))
                return pickable.facesInternal[hit.face];

            return null;
```

### DEPTH TESTING

Depth testing governs whether mesh elements obscured by other geometry can be picked. The setting is exposed via `PickerOptions.depthTest` (corresponding to the editor's "Select Hidden" preference toggle).

1. Behavior Modes:
- `depthTest == true` ("Select Hidden" OFF): Only elements directly visible from the camera viewpoint are selectable. Occluded elements are discarded.
- `depthTest == false` ("Select Hidden" ON): All elements falling within the selection boundary are picked regardless of visibility or occlusion by foreground geometry (x-ray picking mode).

2. GPU Offscreen Depth Testing Mechanisms:
- Face Picking Depth Testing:
  - The face picking shader (`BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial` using `Hidden/ProBuilder/FacePicker` or `Hidden/ProBuilder/FacePickerURP`) is configured with `ZTest LEqual`, `ZWrite On`, and `Cull Back`.
  - When rendered to the 16-bit depth buffer (`depthBufferBits = 16`), standard GPU depth buffering discards occluded back/hidden faces.
- Vertex and Edge Depth Testing via Depth Masks:
  - Vertex billboards and edge lines are overlay primitives rendered on top of surfaces.
  - To prevent occluded vertices and edges behind the mesh from rendering into the pick buffer, `GenerateVertexPickingObjects` and `GenerateEdgePickingObjects` generate an auxiliary array of `depthObjects`.
  - For each selected `ProBuilderMesh`, a GameObject named `pb.name + " (Depth Mask)"` is created using the mesh's full triangle geometry `pb.mesh` and `BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial` with uniform `_Tint` set to `Color.black` (`k_Blackf`).
  - The depth mask mesh writes to the Z-buffer with `ZTest LEqual` and `ZWrite On`.
  - Vertex and edge billboards are rendered using `ZTest LEqual`. Elements behind the mesh geometry fail the Z-test against the depth mask and are discarded, or write black pixels (`0x00`).
  - Because valid vertex and edge hash IDs start at `index = 0x02`, black pixels (`k_PickerHashNone = 0x00`) are ignored during CPU decoding.
  - When `depthTest == false`, `depthObjects` is set to `null` and no depth mask GameObjects are instantiated, allowing all vertex billboards and edge lines to render unoccluded.

3. CPU Screen-Space Occlusion Testing:
- For Complete rectangle selection mode, ProBuilder evaluates occlusion on CPU using raycasts via `HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded`:
  - Faces: Occlusion is tested at the arithmetic center of all distinct face vertices: `trs.TransformPoint(Math.Average(positions, face.distinctIndexesInternal))`.
  - Edges: Occlusion is tested at the edge midpoint: `(posA + posB) * 0.5f`.
  - Vertices: When `depthTest == false`, `SelectionPicker.PickVerticesInRect` skips GPU rendering completely and accepts any vertex where `p.z >= cam.nearClipPlane && rect.Contains(p)`.

```csharp
        internal static Texture2D RenderSelectionPickerTexture(
            Camera camera,
            IList<ProBuilderMesh> selection,
            bool doDepthTest,
            out Dictionary<uint, SimpleTuple<ProBuilderMesh, int>> map,
            int width = -1,
            int height = -1)
        {
            GameObject[] depthObjects, pickerObjects;

            GenerateVertexPickingObjects(selection, doDepthTest, out map, out depthObjects, out pickerObjects);

            BuiltinMaterials.facePickerMaterial.SetColor(k_FacePickerOcclusionTintUniform, k_Blackf);

            Texture2D tex = pickerRenderer.RenderLookupTexture(camera, BuiltinMaterials.selectionPickerShader, "ProBuilderPicker", width, height);

            for (int i = 0, c = pickerObjects.Length; i < c; i++)
            {
                UObject.DestroyImmediate(pickerObjects[i].GetComponent<MeshFilter>().sharedMesh);
                UObject.DestroyImmediate(pickerObjects[i]);
            }

            if (doDepthTest)
            {
                for (int i = 0, c = depthObjects.Length; i < c; i++)
                {
                    UObject.DestroyImmediate(depthObjects[i]);
                }
            }

            return tex;
        }
```

### PERFORMANCE

ProBuilder optimizes picking performance through resolution scaling, temporary texture pooling, bounding-box pixel traversal, and CPU geometric bypass paths.

1. Pick Texture Resolution and Scaling:
- Default resolution matches the camera pixel dimensions: `(int)camera.pixelRect.width` and `(int)camera.pixelRect.height`.
- Support for High-DPI (Retina) scaling via `pixelsPerPoint` (e.g. `EditorGUIUtility.pixelsPerPoint`):
  - `renderTextureWidth = (int)(cam.pixelWidth / pixelsPerPoint)`
  - `renderTextureHeight = (int)(cam.pixelHeight / pixelsPerPoint)`
- Scaling down the render texture reduces fill rate and GPU-to-CPU readback bandwidth by `pixelsPerPoint^2`.

2. RenderTexture Descriptor Configuration:
- Format selection checks supported render texture formats in priority order: `RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32` followed by `RenderTextureFormat.ARGBFloat`.
- `RenderTextureDescriptor` settings:
  - `depthBufferBits = 16`: 16-bit depth buffer.
  - `autoGenerateMips = false` and `useMipMap = false`: Disables mipmap generation.
  - `msaaSamples = 1`, `allowMSAA = false`, `allowHDR = false`: Prevents antialiasing blur and tone-mapping from altering exact integer color encodings.
  - `sRGB = false`: Linear color space ensures exact 8-bit channel bit preservation.
  - `memoryless = RenderTextureMemoryless.None`.

3. Readback and Resource Lifecycle:
- Allocates temporary texture via `RenderTexture.GetTemporary(descriptor)`.
- CPU transfer executes via `Texture2D.ReadPixels(new Rect(0, 0, _width, _height), 0, 0)`.
- `RenderTexture.ReleaseTemporary(rt)` is called immediately after `ReadPixels` to return GPU memory to Unity's pool.
- Extracts pixel array `Color32[] pix = tex.GetPixels32()` and immediately calls `UObject.DestroyImmediate(tex)` to free texture memory.

4. Rect Pixel Scanning Complexity:
- Reading the color buffer does not iterate the entire screen; it bounds iteration strictly to the selection rectangle:
  - `int ox = Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt(pickerRect.x));`
  - `int oy = Math.Max(0, Mathf.FloorToInt((tex.height - pickerRect.y) - pickerRect.height));`
  - `for (int y = oy; y < Min(oy + height, imageHeight); y++)`
  - `  for (int x = ox; x < Min(ox + width, imageWidth); x++)`
- Processing time scales with the area of the selection rectangle (O(W_rect * H_rect)) rather than screen size.
- `HashSet<uint> used` caches encountered IDs, ensuring `Dictionary.TryGetValue` is executed at most once per unique element in the selection rectangle.

5. Edge Selection Threshold Filtering:
- Edge picking tallies hit counts in `Dictionary<uint, uint> pixelCount`.
- Valid selections require `kvp.Value > k_MinEdgePixelsForValidSelection` (`k_MinEdgePixelsForValidSelection = 1`, meaning at least 2 pixels), eliminating accidental single-pixel hits from line rasterization.

6. CPU Fast-Path Geometric Bypass:
- When `options.depthTest == false` in `PickVerticesInRect`, ProBuilder bypasses offscreen rendering, texture allocation, and CPU readback entirely. It executes direct CPU vertex-in-rect tests, eliminating GPU overhead.

### RENDER PIPELINE DIFFERENCES

ProBuilder abstracts render pipeline differences behind the internal interface `SelectionPickerRenderer.ISelectionPickerRenderer`, which specifies `Texture2D RenderLookupTexture(Camera camera, Shader shader, string tag, int width, int height)`. The active implementation is instantiated based on preprocessor symbols and active pipeline checks.

1. Pipeline Detection and Selection (`SelectionPickerRenderer.pickerRenderer`):
- HDRP check: `ShouldUseHDRP()` returns `true` when `HDRP_7_1_0_OR_NEWER` is defined, returning an instance of `SelectionPickerRendererHDRP`.
- URP check: `ShouldUseURP()` returns `true` when `PB_URP_MODE` is defined, returning an instance of `SelectionPickerRendererURP`.
- Built-in Fallback: Otherwise instantiates `SelectionPickerRendererStandard`.

2. Built-in Standard Pipeline (`SelectionPickerRendererStandard`):
- Mechanism: Uses legacy replacement shader rendering via `Camera.RenderWithShader`.
- Camera Configuration:
  - Creates a temporary `GameObject` and attaches `Camera renderCam = go.AddComponent<Camera>()`.
  - Copies camera properties: `renderCam.CopyFrom(camera)`.
  - Sets `renderCam.renderingPath = RenderingPath.Forward`, `renderCam.enabled = false`, `renderCam.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.SolidColor`, `renderCam.backgroundColor = Color.white`, `renderCam.allowHDR = false`, `renderCam.allowMSAA = false`, `renderCam.forceIntoRenderTexture = true`.
- Pipeline Suppression: Temporarily sets `GraphicsSettings.defaultRenderPipeline = null` and `QualitySettings.renderPipeline = null` to force forward rendering, invokes `renderCam.RenderWithShader(shader, tag)` with tag `"ProBuilderPicker"`, and immediately restores previous pipeline references.
- Reads back pixels into linear `Texture2D` and destroys the temporary camera GameObject.

3. High Definition Render Pipeline (`SelectionPickerRendererHDRP`):
- Mechanism: Uses HDRP custom render callbacks and `HDAdditionalCameraData`.
- Camera Setup:
  - Copies settings to temporary camera GameObject.
  - Attaches `HDAdditionalCameraData hdCamData = go.AddComponent<HDAdditionalCameraData>()`.
  - Sets `hdCamData.flipYMode = HDAdditionalCameraData.FlipYMode.ForceFlipY`.
  - Subscribes `hdCamData.customRender += CustomRenderPass`.
- Custom Render Pass (`CustomRenderPass`):
  - Calls `ctx.SetupCameraProperties(camera.camera)`.
  - Allocates `CommandBuffer cb = new CommandBuffer()` and clears render target: `cb.ClearRenderTarget(true, true, Color.white)`.
  - Retrieves culling parameters via `camera.camera.TryGetCullingParameters(out ScriptableCullingParameters cullParams)`.
  - Performs culling: `CullingResults cullResults = ctx.Cull(ref cullParams)`.
  - Builds `RendererListParams` using `DrawingSettings(new ShaderTagId("Always"), new SortingSettings(camera.camera))` and `FilteringSettings.defaultValue`.
  - Creates renderer list `var list = ctx.CreateRendererList(ref listParams)` and draws via `cb.DrawRendererList(list)`.
  - Submits command buffer: `ctx.ExecuteCommandBuffer(cb); ctx.Submit();`.

4. Universal Render Pipeline (`SelectionPickerRendererURP` and `URPSelectionPickerPass`):
- Mechanism: Uses URP Render Graph API and `ScriptableRenderPass`.
- Request Submission:
  - Allocates temporary `RenderTexture rt`.
  - Prepares `StandardRequest request = new StandardRequest() { destination = rt }`.
  - Subscribes `RenderPipelineManager.beginCameraRendering += CustomRenderPass`.
  - Executes `RenderPipeline.SubmitRenderRequest<StandardRequest>(camera, request)`.
- Custom Pass Enqueueing:
  - In `CustomRenderPass`, creates `URPSelectionPickerPass customPass = new URPSelectionPickerPass(-1)` with `renderPassEvent = RenderPassEvent.AfterRendering`.
  - Enqueues into URP renderer: `camera.GetUniversalAdditionalCameraData().scriptableRenderer.EnqueuePass(customPass)`.
- Render Graph Recording (`URPSelectionPickerPass.RecordRenderGraph`):
  - Adds raster pass: `builder = renderGraph.AddRasterRenderPass<PassData>("ProBuilder Selection Picker Pass", out var passData)`.
  - Configures drawing settings with shader tag `ShaderTagId("ProBuilderPickerA")`.
  - Sets render attachments: `builder.SetRenderAttachment(resourceData.activeColorTexture, 0)` and `builder.SetRenderAttachmentDepth(resourceData.activeDepthTexture, AccessFlags.Write)`.
  - In `ExecutePass`: clears target `context.cmd.ClearRenderTarget(RTClearFlags.Color, Color.white, 1, 0)` and executes `context.cmd.DrawRendererList(data.rendererListHandle)`.
  - Unsubscribes callback upon completion.

```csharp
            passData.rendererListHandle = renderGraph.CreateRendererList(param);

        // This static method is used to execute the pass and passed as the RenderFunc delegate to the RenderGraph render pass.
        static void ExecutePass(PassData data, RasterGraphContext context)
        {
            context.cmd.ClearRenderTarget(RTClearFlags.Color, Color.white, 1, 0);

            context.cmd.DrawRendererList(data.rendererListHandle);
        }

        // This is where the renderGraph handle can be accessed.
        // Each ScriptableRenderPass can use the RenderGraph handle to add multiple render passes to the render graph.
        public override void RecordRenderGraph(RenderGraph renderGraph, ContextContainer frameData)
        {
            string passName = "ProBuilder Selection Picker Pass";

            // This simple pass clears the current active color texture, then renders the scene geometry associated to the m_LayerMask layer.
            // Add scene geometry to your own custom layers and experiment switching the layer mask in the render feature UI.
            // You can use the frame debugger to inspect the pass output.

            // add a raster render pass to the render graph, specifying the name and the data type that will be passed to the ExecutePass function
            using (var builder = renderGraph.AddRasterRenderPass<PassData>(passName, out var passData))
            {
                // UniversalResourceData contains all the texture handles used by the renderer, including the active color and depth textures
                // The active color and depth textures are the main color and depth buffers that the camera renders into.
                UniversalResourceData resourceData = frameData.Get<UniversalResourceData>();

                // Fill up the passData with the data needed by the pass.
                InitRendererLists(frameData, ref passData, renderGraph);

                // Optional check to make sure the rendererList is valid. If it isn't, the pass will not execute (instead of the render graph possibly throwing an error).
                if (!passData.rendererListHandle.IsValid())
                    return;

                // We declare the RendererList we just created as an input dependency to this pass, via UseRendererList().
                builder.UseRendererList(passData.rendererListHandle);

                // Setup as a render target via UseTextureFragment and UseTextureFragmentDepth, which are the equivalent of using the old cmd.SetRenderTarget(color,depth)
                builder.SetRenderAttachment(resourceData.activeColorTexture, 0);
                builder.SetRenderAttachmentDepth(resourceData.activeDepthTexture, AccessFlags.Write);

                // Assign the ExecutePass function to the render pass delegate, which will be called by the render graph when executing the pass.
                builder.SetRenderFunc(static (PassData data, RasterGraphContext context) => ExecutePass(data, context));
            }
        }
    }
```

> **Godot Note:** In Godot 4, the rendering architecture uses a unified RenderingServer backend with Forward+, Mobile, and Compatibility rendering methods. A single custom shader or Viewport pass can be used across all renderers without needing separate pipeline-specific implementations like Unity's Builtin/URP/HDRP.

**Cross References:**
- A01: ProBuilderMesh core data structures, positionsInternal, facesInternal, sharedVerticesInternal used for geometry extraction
- A02: Face, Edge, and SharedVertex representations picked by the renderer
- E02: EditorSceneViewPicker and MeshSelection interact with SelectionPicker for user mouse events and selection state updates
- E03: Selection modifiers (grow, shrink, loop, ring) operate on element sets returned by SelectionPicker
- G01: Overlay and wireframe shaders render visual highlights for picked elements

## E02: Scene view picking, selection utilities, element selection algorithms

### SCENE VIEW PICKER

The `EditorSceneViewPicker` class (`UnityEditor.ProBuilder.EditorSceneViewPicker`) coordinates scene view user interactions, processing single-click raycasts, hover path highlights, and rectangular marquee drag selections across ProBuilder mesh components.

1. Mouse Click Event Processing (`DoMouseClick`):
- Signature: `public static ProBuilderMesh DoMouseClick(Event evt, SelectMode selectionMode, ScenePickerPreferences pickerPreferences)`.
- Modifier Evaluation: Queries modifier flags via `EditorHandleUtility` helper methods:
  - `appendModifier`: Evaluated via `EditorHandleUtility.IsAppendModifier(evt.modifiers)` (returns True if Shift, Ctrl, Alt, or Command is active).
  - `addToSelectionModifier`: Evaluated via `EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAddModifier(evt.modifiers)` (returns True if Shift is active).
  - `addOrRemoveIfPresentFromSelectionModifier`: Evaluated via `EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAppendOrRemoveIfPresentModifier(evt.modifiers)` (returns True if Command on macOS or Control on Windows/Linux is active).
- Mode-Specific Raycasting: Dispatches picking according to `selectionMode` flags:
  - Edge Selection (`SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.TextureEdge`): Invokes `EdgeRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection)`.
  - Vertex Selection (`SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.TextureVertex`): Invokes `VertexRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection)`.
  - Face Selection (`SelectMode.Face` | `SelectMode.TextureFace`): Invokes `FaceRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection, evt.clickCount > 1 ? -1 : 0, false)`.
- Event Consumption: Executes `evt.Use()`. Verifies whether picked object contains a component via `isProBuilderMesh = s_Selection.gameObject != null && s_Selection.gameObject.GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>() != null`.
- Non-Append Clearing: If `!appendModifier`, clears selection on `s_Selection.mesh.ClearSelection()`. When `s_Selection.gameObject == null` or `!isProBuilderMesh`, invokes `MeshSelection.ClearElementSelection()`, otherwise invokes `MeshSelection.SetSelection((GameObject)null)`.
- Pointer Distance Threshold: Compares `pickedElementDistance` against `ScenePickerPreferences.maxPointerDistance` (constant `20f` screen pixels). If the distance exceeds 20 pixels:
  - If `appendModifier` and the object is already present in `Selection.gameObjects`: removes it using `MeshSelection.RemoveFromSelection(s_Selection.gameObject)`.
  - If not present: adds it using `MeshSelection.AddToSelection(s_Selection.gameObject)`.
  - Returns `null` without selecting submesh elements.
- Submesh Element Selection Mutation:
  - Face Mode: Computes face index `ind = Array.IndexOf<Face>(faces, face)` and selection index `sel = mesh.selectedFaceIndexes.IndexOf(ind)`. If `sel > -1`, removes the face when `!appendModifier || addOrRemoveIfPresentFromSelectionModifier || (addToSelectionModifier && face == mesh.GetActiveFace() && !activeObjectSelectionChanged)` via `mesh.RemoveFromFaceSelectionAtIndex(sel)`. If removal leaves `mesh.selectedFaceCount == 0`, iterates backward through `MeshSelection.topInternal` to assign the next mesh with selected faces as `candidateNewActiveObject`. If not removing, re-orders index `ind` to the end of `selectedFaceIndicesInternal` to establish active face priority. If `sel == -1`, calls `mesh.AddToFaceSelection(ind)`.
  - Edge Mode: Finds edge index `ind = mesh.IndexOf(mesh.selectedEdges, edge)`. If `ind > -1`, removes edge via `mesh.SetSelectedEdges(mesh.selectedEdges.ToArray().RemoveAt(ind))` when toggling/removing, or re-orders edge to the end. If `ind == -1`, appends edge via `mesh.SetSelectedEdges(mesh.selectedEdges.ToArray().Add(edge))`.
  - Vertex Mode: Retrieves universal shared group index `sharedIndex = mesh.sharedVertexLookup[vertex]` and shared array `sharedVertex = mesh.sharedVerticesInternal[sharedIndex]`. Finds all coincident vertices in `mesh.selectedIndexesInternal`, populates `s_IndexBuffer`, and sorts them. If selected (`ind > -1`), removes coincident indices using `mesh.selectedIndexesInternal.SortedRemoveAt(s_IndexBuffer)` or moves active vertex to the end. If not selected, appends index via `mesh.SetSelectedVertices(mesh.selectedIndexesInternal.Add(vertex))`.
- Active Object Synchronization: If `activeObjectSelectionChanged`, calls `MeshSelection.MakeActiveObject(candidateNewActiveObject)`, else calls `MeshSelection.AddToSelection(candidateNewActiveObject)`.

2. Marquee Drag Selection Processing (`DoMouseDrag`):
- Signature: `public static void DoMouseDrag(Rect mouseDragRect, SelectMode selectionMode, ScenePickerPreferences scenePickerPreferences)`.
- Setup: Constructs `PickerOptions` with `depthTest = scenePickerPreferences.cullMode == CullingMode.Back` and `rectSelectMode = scenePickerPreferences.rectSelectMode`. Registers undo state with `UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Drag Select")`.
- Modifier Evaluation: Computes `isSelectionAddModifier` and `isSelectionRemoveModifier`. When neither is active (`!isAppendModifier`), calls `MeshSelection.ClearElementSelection()`.
- Gizmo Suppression: Disables `lastSceneView.drawGizmos = false` during pixel buffer extraction to avoid gizmo occlusion in the color-coded selection buffer.
- Mode-Specific Rectangle Picking:
  - Vertex: Queries `SelectionPicker.PickVerticesInRect(...)`. For append modifier, performs `common.UnionWith(kvp.Value)` (for Shift addition) or `common.RemoveWhere(x => kvp.Value.Contains(x))` (for Ctrl/Cmd removal) on shared vertex handles, then applies `mesh.SetSelectedVertices(common.SelectMany(x => sharedIndexes[x]))`.
  - Face: Queries `SelectionPicker.PickFacesInRect(...)`. Applies `current.UnionWith(kvp.Value)` or `current.RemoveWhere(x => kvp.Value.Contains(x))`, updating the mesh via `kvp.Key.SetSelectedFaces(current)`.
  - Edge: Queries `SelectionPicker.PickEdgesInRect(...)`. Translates edges to `EdgeLookup`, applies `current.UnionWith(selectedEdges)` or `current.RemoveWhere(x => selectedEdges.Contains(x))`, and applies `mesh.SetSelectedEdges(current.Select(x => x.local))`.
- UI Refresh: Triggers `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()` and `SceneView.RepaintAll()`.

3. Raycasting Implementation Details:
- `FaceRaycast`: Collects candidate GameObjects via `EditorHandleUtility.GetAllOverlapping` (or `EditorHandleUtility.GetHovered` during hover/modifiers). Tests ray-face intersections with `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.HandleUtility.FaceRaycast`. Implements deep-click cycling: tracks `s_DeepSelectionPrevious`. On consecutive clicks at the same coordinate, advances index `chosenIndex = (currentSelectionIndex + (1 + deepClickOffset)) % s_PbHits.Count`.
- `VertexRaycast`: Finds candidate vertices using `GetNearestVertices` within threshold `maxDistance = 400f` sqr pixels (`ScenePickerPreferences.maxPointerDistance` squared). Applies `ScenePickerPreferences.offPointerMultiplier` (`1.2f`) to non-hovered meshes. Sorts entries by screen distance and checks occlusion with `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.HandleUtility.PointIsOccluded`.
- `EdgeRaycast`: Prioritizes hovered edge highlights from `ProBuilderEditor.instance.hovering.edges`. If not found, calls `GetNearestEdgeOnMesh` which runs dual-cull raycasting via `PHandleUtility.FaceRaycastBothCullModes` to extract the closest edge on front and back faces. Projects edge line segments to screen space with near-plane clipping via `ClipPointToNearPlane`, measuring distance with `HandleUtility.DistancePointLine`. Disambiguates co-linear or stacked edges using `GetClosestEdgeToCamera` by evaluating camera distance to points offset along the edge vector `(b - a).normalized * 0.01f`.

```csharp
        public static ProBuilderMesh DoMouseClick(Event evt, SelectMode selectionMode, ScenePickerPreferences pickerPreferences)
        {
            bool appendModifier = EditorHandleUtility.IsAppendModifier(evt.modifiers);
            bool addToSelectionModifier = EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAddModifier(evt.modifiers);
            bool addOrRemoveIfPresentFromSelectionModifier = EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAppendOrRemoveIfPresentModifier(evt.modifiers);

            float pickedElementDistance;

            if (selectionMode.ContainsFlag(SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.TextureEdge))
                pickedElementDistance = EdgeRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection);
            else if (selectionMode.ContainsFlag(SelectMode.Vertex | SelectMode.TextureVertex))
                pickedElementDistance = VertexRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection);
            else
                pickedElementDistance = FaceRaycast(evt.mousePosition, pickerPreferences, k_AllowUnselected, s_Selection, evt.clickCount > 1 ? -1 : 0, false);

            evt.Use();

            var isProBuilderMesh = s_Selection.gameObject != null && s_Selection.gameObject.GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>() != null;

            if (!appendModifier)
            {
                if(s_Selection.mesh != null)
                    s_Selection.mesh.ClearSelection();
                if (s_Selection.gameObject == null || !isProBuilderMesh)
                {
                    // Don't clear object selection if we are in the PB Context, just clear sub-elements selection
                    MeshSelection.ClearElementSelection();
                }
                else
                    MeshSelection.SetSelection((GameObject)null);
            }

            if (!isProBuilderMesh)
                return null;
```

```csharp
        public static void DoMouseDrag(Rect mouseDragRect, SelectMode selectionMode, ScenePickerPreferences scenePickerPreferences)
        {
            var pickingOptions = new PickerOptions()
            {
                depthTest = scenePickerPreferences.cullMode == CullingMode.Back,
                rectSelectMode = scenePickerPreferences.rectSelectMode
            };

            UndoUtility.RecordSelection("Drag Select");
            bool isSelectionAddModifier = EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAddModifier(Event.current.modifiers);
            bool isSelectionRemoveModifier = EditorHandleUtility.IsSelectionAppendOrRemoveIfPresentModifier(Event.current.modifiers);
            bool isAppendModifier = isSelectionAddModifier || isSelectionRemoveModifier;

            if (!isAppendModifier)
                MeshSelection.ClearElementSelection();

            bool elementsInDragRect = false;

            switch (selectionMode)
            {
                case SelectMode.Vertex:
                case SelectMode.TextureVertex:
                {
                    var lastSceneView = SceneView.lastActiveSceneView;
                    var isDrawingGizmos = lastSceneView.drawGizmos;
                    lastSceneView.drawGizmos = false;
                    Dictionary<ProBuilderMesh, HashSet<int>> selected = SelectionPicker.PickVerticesInRect(
                            lastSceneView.camera,
                            mouseDragRect,
                            MeshSelection.topInternal,
                            pickingOptions,
                            EditorGUIUtility.pixelsPerPoint);
                    lastSceneView.drawGizmos = isDrawingGizmos;

                    foreach (var kvp in selected)
                    {
                        var mesh = kvp.Key;
                        SharedVertex[] sharedIndexes = mesh.sharedVerticesInternal;
                        HashSet<int> common;

                        if (isAppendModifier)
                        {
                            common = mesh.GetSharedVertexHandles(mesh.selectedIndexesInternal);

                            if(isSelectionAddModifier)
                                common.UnionWith(kvp.Value);
                            else if(isSelectionRemoveModifier)
                                common.RemoveWhere(x => kvp.Value.Contains(x));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            common = kvp.Value;
                        }

                        elementsInDragRect |= kvp.Value.Count > 0;
                        mesh.SetSelectedVertices(common.SelectMany(x => sharedIndexes[x]));
```
