# UI & Overlays

## H01: ProBuilder overlays, actions toolbar, scene info

### ACTIONS OVERLAY

The ProBuilder Actions Overlay (`ProBuilderActionsOverlay`) is a SceneView overlay that exposes ProBuilder menu actions as an interactive UI panel or toolbar. It is registered via Unity overlay system attributes `[Overlay(typeof(SceneView), overlayId, k_DisplayName, minHeight = 150f, maxHeight = 500f, minWidth = 200f, maxWidth = 600f, defaultDisplay = false)]` and `[Icon("Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditMeshContext.png")]`, and implements `Overlay`, `ICreateHorizontalToolbar`, and `ICreateVerticalToolbar`.

1. Action Button Element Architecture:
- Each button is an instance of `ProBuilderActionButton : VisualElement` loaded from the UXML template `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor/Overlays/UXML/ActionButton.uxml"` via `VisualTreeAsset s_ButtonAsset`.
- Visual hierarchy contains: `m_Button` (`Button`), `m_Label` (`Label`), `m_Color` (`VisualElement` named `"ActionColor"`), and `m_Icon` (`Image` named `"ActionIcon"`).
- Icon resolution order: `action.icon` -> `IconUtility.GetIcon("Tools/EditShape")` fallback.
- Clicking an action button executes `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(action, HasPreview(action)))`, opening the settings overlay with live preview enabled for all actions except `DetachFaces` and `DuplicateFaces`.
- Visual grouping and color-coding: `m_Color.style.backgroundColor` is populated using `ToolbarGroupUtility.GetColor(m_Action.group)`:
  - `ToolbarGroup.Tool`: `Color(0.6666f, 0.4f, 0.2f, 1f)` (orange/brown)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Selection`: `Color(0.1411f, 0.4941f, 0.6392f, 1f)` (blue)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Object` and `ToolbarGroup.Entity`: `Color(0.4f, 0.6f, 0.1333f, 1f)` (green)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`: `Color(0.7333f, 0.1333f, 0.2f, 1f)` (red)
  - Default fallback: `Color.white`.

2. Display Modes and User Preferences:
- Persisted via `s_CurrentMode = new Pref<DisplayMode>("pb_overlay.displaymode", DisplayMode.Full, SettingsScope.User)`.
- `DisplayMode.Icon`: `m_Icon` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Label` hidden (`DisplayStyle.None`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = 40f`.
- `DisplayMode.Text`: `m_Icon` hidden (`DisplayStyle.None`), `m_Label` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = fullWidth` (viewport width minus 10px clamped between 0f and 180f).
- `DisplayMode.Full`: both `m_Icon` and `m_Label` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = fullWidth`.
- Action filtering preferences:
  - `s_DisplayEditors = new Pref<bool>("pb_overlay.displayeditors", true, SettingsScope.User)`: controls display of `ToolbarGroup.Tool` editor launcher actions.
  - `s_DisplaySelection = new Pref<bool>("pb_overlay.displayselection", false, SettingsScope.User)`: controls display of `ToolbarGroup.Selection` selection actions.

3. Per-Edit-Mode Population Algorithm (`RefreshAvailableActions()`):
- Action collection is obtained via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`.
- Exclusions:
  - Blacklisted types in `k_ContextMenuBlacklist`: `ToggleHandleOrientation`, `ToggleDragRectMode`, `ToggleSelectBackFaces`, `NewBezierShape`.
  - Entity group actions: `action.group == ToolbarGroup.Entity`.
- Contextual visibility filtering:
  - Determines context state: `isGOContext = EditorToolManager.activeToolContext is GameObjectToolContext`.
  - Evaluates `action.hidden`, which tests `action.validSelectModes` against `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode` (`SelectMode.Vertex`, `SelectMode.Edge`, `SelectMode.Face`, `SelectMode.TextureFace`).
  - Applies contextual override: `hidden |= shouldDisplayAsEditor || (action.group == ToolbarGroup.Object) ? !isGOContext : isGOContext;`.
  - When in `GameObjectToolContext` (`isGOContext == true`), `ToolbarGroup.Object` actions (`MergeObjects`, `MirrorObjects`, `FlipObjectNormals`, `SubdivideObject`, `FreezeTransform`, `CenterPivot`, `ConformObjectNormals`, `TriangulateObject`, `GenerateUV2`, `ProBuilderize`, `Export`) are visible, while geometry actions are hidden.
  - When in `PositionToolContext` (`isGOContext == false`), object actions are hidden, and geometry actions matching the active `SelectMode` (`CollapseVertices`, `BevelEdges`, `ExtrudeFaces`, `CutToolAction`) are visible.
  - Populates `m_AvailableActions` list and sets button visibility (`style.display = DisplayStyle.Flex` or `DisplayStyle.None`).

4. Panel and Toolbar Presentation:
- In Panel layout (`CreatePanelContent()`): builds a `GridView` (`itemsSource = m_AvailableActions`, `MakeItem = () => new ProBuilderActionButton()`, `BindItem = (el, idx) => el.Bind(m_AvailableActions[idx])`). A `ContextualMenuManipulator(BuildContextMenu)` provides right-click toggles for Icon/Text/Full display modes and editor/selection visibility.
- In Toolbar layout (`CreateHorizontalToolbarContent()` / `CreateVerticalToolbarContent()`): builds an `OverlayToolbar`, assigns CSS classes `toolbarHorizontalMode` or `toolbarVerticalMode`, and adds all enabled action buttons.
- Event bindings: subscribes to `Selection.selectionChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated`, `ToolManager.activeContextChanged`, `GeometryChangedEvent`, `layoutChanged`, `floatingChanged`, and `dockingCompleted` to refresh and rebuild items.

### ACTION SETTINGS

Per-action option panels provide modal or floating parameter configuration for mesh operations (such as Extrude, Bevel, Connect, Subdivide, Offset, Mirror) with optional interactive live previews.

1. Invocation and Debouncing Flow:
- Invoked when a user triggers an action that supports settings, wrapping execution inside `MenuActionSettings : EditorAction`.
- Debounce protection: `s_CanTriggerNewAction` static flag ensures actions are invoked once per selection batch rather than per individual selected GameObject. Reset asynchronously via `EditorApplication.delayCall += () => { s_CanTriggerNewAction = true; };`.
- Executes `PreviewActionManager.DoAction(action, hasPreview)`.

2. PreviewActionManager Lifecycle and State Machine:
- `PreviewActionManager` is a singleton instance managing live preview execution and the active settings overlay.
- In `Init(MenuAction action, bool preview)`:
  - Stores `m_CurrentAction = action` and `m_HasPreview = preview`.
  - When `preview == true`, initiates preview recording via `UndoUtility.StartPreview()` and performs the initial operation `m_CurrentAction.PerformAction()`.
  - Instantiates `MenuActionSettingsOverlay` and attaches it to the viewport via `SceneView.AddOverlayToActiveView(m_Overlay)`.
  - Subscribes to editor state change events: `Selection.selectionChanged`, `ToolManager.activeContextChanged`, `ToolManager.activeToolChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged`. Any selection or tool transition automatically validates and commits the pending preview.

3. Overlay Structure (`MenuActionSettingsOverlay`):
- Displays title `PreviewActionManager.actionName` and tooltip `PreviewActionManager.actionTooltip`.
- Root container layout: `flexDirection = FlexDirection.Column`, fixed width `minWidth = maxWidth = 300`.
- Injects custom action parameter UI obtained from `m_CurrentAction.CreateSettingsContent()` via `PreviewActionManager.GetContent()`.
- Live preview toggle: when `PreviewActionManager.hasPreview` is true, appends a `Toggle("Live Preview")` bound to `s_AutoUpdatePreview` (`Pref<bool>("editor.autoUpdatePreview", false, SettingsScope.Project)`). When disabled, `delayedPreview` is true, suppressing continuous mesh recalculation on expensive selections.
- Confirmation footer row (`FlexDirection.Row`):
  - Confirm button (`"Confirm"`): triggers `PreviewActionManager.Validate()`, which invokes `Dispose()` and `UndoUtility.ExitAndValidatePreview()` (or `PerformAction()` if not running with preview).
  - Cancel button (`"Cancel"`): triggers `PreviewActionManager.Cancel()`, which invokes `Dispose()` and reverts state via `UndoUtility.UndoPreview()`.

4. Dynamic Preview Updates (`UpdatePreviewInternal()`):
- When action parameters change in the settings UI, `PreviewActionManager.UpdatePreview()` is called.
- Temporarily unregisters event listeners (`ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated -= OnSelectionUpdated; Selection.selectionChanged -= ObjectSelectionChanged;`) to prevent recursive refresh loops caused by undo/mesh rebuild events, executes `UndoUtility.StartPreview()` and `m_CurrentAction.PerformAction()`, and then re-registers listeners.

```csharp
        void Init(MenuAction action, bool preview)
        {
            m_CurrentAction = action;
            m_HasPreview = preview;

            if (preview)
            {
                UndoUtility.StartPreview();
                m_CurrentAction.PerformAction();
            }

            // Changing selection/tool/context should apply the preview and exit the current action
            Selection.selectionChanged += ObjectSelectionChanged;
            ToolManager.activeContextChanged += Validate;
            ToolManager.activeToolChanged += Validate;
            ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated += OnSelectionUpdated;
            ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged += SelectModeChanged;

            SceneView.AddOverlayToActiveView(m_Overlay = new MenuActionSettingsOverlay());
            // Hack to ensure that the overlay is displayed in the sceneview even when the overlay was already displayed before
            // Doing only displayed = true is not adding the overlay as it should in the view, only changing the display status is
            m_Overlay.displayed = false;
            m_Overlay.displayed = true;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            s_Instance = null;
            SceneView.RemoveOverlayFromActiveView(m_Overlay);

            ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated -= OnSelectionUpdated;
            ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged -= SelectModeChanged;
            ToolManager.activeContextChanged -= Validate;
            ToolManager.activeToolChanged -= Validate;
            Selection.selectionChanged -= ObjectSelectionChanged;

            UndoUtility.ExitAndValidatePreview();

        internal static void UpdatePreview()
        {
            s_Instance?.UpdatePreviewInternal();
        }

        internal void UpdatePreviewInternal()
        {
            //Undo action might be triggering a refresh of the mesh and of the selection, so we need to temporarily unregister to these events
            ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated -= OnSelectionUpdated;
            Selection.selectionChanged -= ObjectSelectionChanged;
            UndoUtility.StartPreview();
            m_CurrentAction.PerformAction();
            ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated += OnSelectionUpdated;
            Selection.selectionChanged += ObjectSelectionChanged;

        public MenuActionSettings(MenuAction action, bool hasPreview = false)
        {
            if (!s_CanTriggerNewAction)
            {
                Finish(EditorActionResult.Canceled);
                return;
            }

            s_CanTriggerNewAction = false;
            PreviewActionManager.DoAction(action, hasPreview);

            // Ensure we are not calling the action again in the same frame
            // Needed because Menu Items are called once per selected object while PB actions are acting on the entire selection at once
            EditorApplication.delayCall += () => { s_CanTriggerNewAction = true; };

            Finish(EditorActionResult.Success);

Live preview operations clone the target ArrayMesh or operate on duplicate staging data, committing to the UndoRedo history only on confirmation, and reverting geometry when cancelled or when the active node selection changes.

### SELECTION SETTINGS

ProBuilder selection settings control element picking behavior, transform gizmo orientation, drag selection geometry tests, and occluded element visibility. These settings are exposed via toolbar elements and persisted through `Pref<T>` settings.

1. Select Mode Button Strip (`SelectModeToolbar`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Select Mode")]` inheriting `VisualElement`.
- Instantiates three `SelectModeToggle : EditorToolbarToggle` buttons initialized with `SelectMode.Vertex` (`"Modes/Mode_Vertex"`), `SelectMode.Edge` (`"Modes/Mode_Edge"`), and `SelectMode.Face` (`"Modes/Mode_Face"`).
- Formatted as a cohesive segmented control using `EditorToolbarUtility.SetupChildrenAsButtonStrip(this)`.
- Mutual exclusivity and non-empty enforcement: `RegisterValueChangedCallback` sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = m_Mode` when checked, and calls `SetValueWithoutNotify(true)` if unchecked, ensuring edit mode cannot be toggled off directly without selecting another mode.

2. Drag Rect Mode Toggle (`DragRectModeToggle`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Drag Rect Mode")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarToggle`.
- Backed by `ToggleDragRectMode : MenuAction` with icons `"Toolbar/DragSelect_Off"` (Intersect / Partial) and `"Toolbar/DragSelect_On"` (Complete).
- Values: `RectSelectMode.Partial` (default, selects elements intersecting the drag rectangle) and `RectSelectMode.Complete` (requires element vertices/edges/faces to be fully enclosed within the rectangle).
- Persistence: stored in `ProBuilderEditor.s_DragSelectRectMode = new Pref<RectSelectMode>("editor.dragSelectRectMode", RectSelectMode.Partial)`.
- Modifying the toggle updates `ProBuilderEditor.rectSelectMode`, setting `m_ScenePickerPreferences.rectSelectMode` and firing `ProBuilderEditor.rectSelectModeChanged`.
- Visible in Edge, Face, and TextureFace selection modes; hidden in Vertex mode via `validSelectModes = SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.

3. Select Back Faces Toggle (`SelectBackFacesToggle`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Select Back Faces")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarToggle`.
- Backed by `ToggleSelectBackFaces : MenuAction` with icons `"Toolbar/Selection_SelectHidden-OFF"` and `"Toolbar/Selection_SelectHidden-ON"`.
- State determines backface culling during raycast and box picking: `true` enables selecting occluded/back-facing geometry (`CullingMode.None`), `false` culls backfaces (`CullingMode.Back`).
- Persistence: stored in `ProBuilderEditor.s_BackfaceSelectEnabled = new Pref<bool>("editor.backFaceSelectEnabled", false)`.
- Setting `ProBuilderEditor.backfaceSelectionEnabled` updates `m_ScenePickerPreferences.cullMode = value ? CullingMode.None : CullingMode.Back` and fires `ProBuilderEditor.backfaceSelectionEnabledChanged`.

4. Handle Orientation Dropdown (`HandleOrientationDropdown`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Handle Orientation")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarDropdown`.
- Backed by `ToggleHandleOrientation : MenuAction`.
- Supported orientations (`HandleOrientation` enum):
  - `HandleOrientation.World` (0): fixed world coordinate axes, icon `"ToolHandleGlobal"`.
  - `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject` (1): aligned with active GameObject transform rotation, icon `"ToolHandleLocal"`.
  - `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement` (2): aligned with normal/tangent space of selected vertex/edge/face, icon `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/Modes/ToolHandleElement.png"`.
- Persistence: stored in `VertexManipulationTool.s_HandleOrientation = new Pref<HandleOrientation>("editor.handleOrientation", HandleOrientation.World, SettingsScope.User)`.
- Clicking opens a `GenericMenu` via `menu.DropDown(worldBound)`. Setting `m_MenuAction.handleOrientation = handleOrientation` updates `VertexManipulationTool.handleOrientation`, notifies `VertexManipulationTool.handleOrientationChanged`, and invokes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)`.

5. X-Ray View Toggle (`ToggleXRay`):
- `ToggleXRay : MenuAction` has `hidden => true` (excluded from standard toolbar strip, accessible via menu shortcut `Alt+Shift+X` or preferences).
- Persistence: stored in `EditorHandleDrawing.s_XRayView = new Pref<bool>("graphics.xRayView", true, SettingsScope.User)`.
- Property `EditorHandleDrawing.xRay` toggles `s_XRayView.value` and triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`. When active, occluded vertices, edges, and faces are rendered in scene handle passes with depth comparison `CompareFunction.Greater` and dimmed tint `k_OccludedTint`.

### SCENE INFORMATION

The Scene Information overlay (`SceneInformationOverlay : Overlay`) presents real-time geometric and selection metrics for selected ProBuilder meshes directly inside the SceneView.

1. Registration and Activation:
- Display title: `"ProBuilder Information"`.
- Controlled by user preference `ProBuilderEditor.s_ShowSceneInfo = new Pref<bool>("editor.showSceneInfo", false)` registered under `[UserSetting("General", "Show Scene Info", "Toggle the display of information about selected meshes in the Scene View.")]`.
- Dynamically added and removed from the active SceneView by `PositionToolContext.UpdateSceneInfoOverlay()` via `SceneView.AddOverlayToActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)` and `SceneView.RemoveOverlayFromActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)` when the ProBuilder tool context is active and `s_ShowSceneInfo` is enabled.

2. Statistics Metrics Displayed:
- The panel constructs a vertical list (`FlexDirection.Column`) containing 6 formatted rows separated by a 10px vertical spacer:
  - 1. Total Faces: `m_FaceCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalFaceCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.faceCount` across all selected ProBuilder meshes.
  - 2. Total Triangles: `m_TriCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalTriangleCountCompiled.ToString()` — compiled render primitive count calculated from `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshUtility.GetPrimitiveCount(mesh.mesh)`.
  - 3. Total Vertices: `m_VertCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalCommonVertexCount + " (" + MeshSelection.totalVertexCountOptimized + ")"` — count of unique shared geometric vertices (`mesh.sharedVerticesInternal.Length`) followed in parentheses by total compiled/split vertex count (`mesh.mesh.vertexCount`).
  - Spacer: `VisualElement` with `style.height = 10`.
  - 4. Selected Faces: `m_SelectedFaceCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.selectedFaceCount` across selected objects.
  - 5. Selected Edges: `m_SelectedEdgeCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.selectedEdgeCount` across selected objects.
  - 6. Selected Vertices: `m_SelectedVertCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedSharedVertexCount + " (" + MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount + ")"` — count of selected unique shared vertex indices (`mesh.selectedSharedVerticesCount`) followed in parentheses by total selected split vertex indices (`mesh.selectedIndexesInternal.Length`).

3. Update Frequency and Event Triggers:
- Attached to panel event listeners (`OnAttachedToPanel`):
  - `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated += OnSelectionUpdated` — updates whenever element selection (vertices, edges, faces) changes.
  - `MeshSelection.objectSelectionChanged += UpdateSceneInfo` — updates when GameObject selection changes in the scene hierarchy.
  - `ProBuilderMesh.versionChanged += OnMeshVersionChanged` — updates when mesh topology, vertex positions, or normals are modified.
- Also refreshed synchronously when `CreatePanelContent()` builds the visual tree.
- Backing calculation caching: `MeshSelection.CacheElementCounts()` evaluates a dirty flag `s_ElementCountsDirty`, which is invalidated by `objectSelectionChanged`, `selectionUpdated`, `EditorMeshUtility.meshOptimized`, and `PrefabUtility.prefabInstanceReverted`.

### TOOL CONTEXTS

ProBuilder integrates into the Unity Editor as a custom tool context (`PositionToolContext` and `TextureToolContext`), providing standard transform tool overriding, context menu injection, SceneView GUI dispatching, and overlay lifecycle synchronization.

1. Custom Tool Context Registration:
- `PositionToolContext : EditorToolContext` is decorated with `[EditorToolContext("ProBuilder", typeof(ProBuilderMesh))]` and `[Icon("Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditMeshContext.png")]`.
- When a GameObject with a `ProBuilderMesh` component is selected, Unity automatically activates the ProBuilder tool context in the SceneView context bar.
- `TextureToolContext : EditorToolContext` is defined for UV and texture manipulation.

2. Transform Tool Redirection (`GetEditorToolType(Tool tool)`):
- In `PositionToolContext`, standard transform tools are intercepted and replaced with ProBuilder custom element tools:
  - `Tool.Move` -> `typeof(ProbuilderMoveTool)`
  - `Tool.Rotate` -> `typeof(ProbuilderRotateTool)`
  - `Tool.Scale` -> `typeof(ProbuilderScaleTool)`
- In `TextureToolContext`, transform tools are mapped to texture element tools:
  - `Tool.Move` -> `typeof(TextureMoveTool)`
  - `Tool.Rotate` -> `typeof(TextureRotateTool)`
  - `Tool.Scale` -> `typeof(TextureScaleTool)`

3. Lifecycle and Overlay Coordination:
- `OnActivated()`:
  - Instantiates `m_Editor = new ProBuilderEditor()`.
  - Subscribes to `ProBuilderSettings.instance.afterSettingsSaved += UpdateSceneInfoOverlay`.
  - Invokes `UpdateSceneInfoOverlay()`, which creates and adds `SceneInformationOverlay` to the active SceneView if `ProBuilderEditor.s_ShowSceneInfo` is enabled.
  - Registers shortcut handling context: `ShortcutManager.RegisterContext(m_ShortcutContext ??= new ProBuilderShortcutContext())`, where `ProBuilderShortcutContext : IShortcutContext` is active when `EditorWindow.focusedWindow is SceneView && ProBuilderEditor.instance != null`.
- `OnWillBeDeactivated()`:
  - Disposes `m_Editor.Dispose()`.
  - Unsubscribes from settings events.
  - Removes `m_SceneInfoOverlay` from active SceneView: `SceneView.RemoveOverlayFromActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)`.
  - Unregisters shortcut context: `ShortcutManager.UnregisterContext(m_ShortcutContext)`.
- `OnToolGUI(EditorWindow window)`: forwards SceneView GUI repaint and interaction events to `editor.OnSceneGUI(view)`.

4. Right-Click SceneView Context Menu Injection (`PopulateMenu(DropdownMenu menu)`):
- Injects standard selection commands: `"Edit/Select All"` -> `"Select/Select All"`, `"Edit/Deselect All"` -> `"Select/Deselect All"`, `"Edit/Invert Selection"` -> `"Select/Invert Selection"`.
- Iterates through `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`, skipping blacklisted types (`k_ContextMenuBlacklist`) and groups (`ToolbarGroup.Entity`, `ToolbarGroup.Object`, `ToolbarGroup.Tool`).
- Inserts visual separators across group boundaries.
- Rebrands `ToolbarGroup.Selection` title to `"ProBuilder Select"`.
- Dispatches action execution: if `action.hasFileMenuEntry`, routes to file menu path; if `action.optionsEnabled`, triggers `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(action, HasPreview(action)))`; otherwise executes `action.PerformAction()` directly.
- If non-ProBuilder `MeshFilter` components are selected alongside ProBuilder meshes, appends standard Mesh Filter context menu items.

5. Inspector CONTEXT Menu Items:
- Context menu entries on `ProBuilderMesh` component inspector (`[MenuItem("CONTEXT/ProBuilderMesh/...")]`):
  - Operations: `Conform Normals`, `Export`, `Triangulate`, `Center Pivot`, `Flip Normals`, `Subdivide Object`, `Mirror Objects`, `Merge Objects`, `Freeze Transform`, `Set Trigger`, `Set Collider`.
  - Debouncing latch: uses `s_ActionAlreadyTriggered` boolean flag and `EditorApplication.delayCall` to prevent multi-object selections from executing the action multiple times for a single user click.

## H02: ProBuilder editor core, settings, menu system

### PROBUILDER EDITOR

The `ProBuilderEditor` sealed class (`IDisposable`) serves as the central runtime hub coordinating Scene view GUI rendering, element picking, mouse dragging, keyboard shortcuts, handle drawing, mesh selection state, and external tool integration.

1. State Fields and Constants:
- `k_MouseDragThreshold = 6f`: Distance threshold in screen pixels required before a mouse down-drag transition is classified as an active box/marquee drag rather than a single click.
- `s_Instance` (`ProBuilderEditor`): Internal singleton instance reference exposed via public static property `instance`.
- `s_ShowSceneInfo` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.showSceneInfo"` (default `false`), toggles Scene view mesh info overlays.
- `s_AllowNonManifoldActions` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.allowNonManifoldActions"` (default `false`), enables non-manifold topology actions.
- `s_BackfaceSelectEnabled` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.backFaceSelectEnabled"` (default `false`), controls culling mode (`CullingMode.None` vs `CullingMode.Back`).
- `s_DragSelectRectMode` (`Pref<RectSelectMode>`): Backed by key `"editor.dragSelectRectMode"` (default `RectSelectMode.Partial`).
- `s_ShowHoverHighlight` (`Pref<bool>`): Backed by key `"editor.showPreselectionHighlight"` (default `true`), enables preselection raycasting.
- `s_SelectMode` (`Pref<SelectMode>`): Backed by key `"s_SelectMode"` (default `SelectMode.Face`), tracks current selection mode (`Vertex`, `Edge`, `Face`, `TextureFace`, or `None`).
- `m_DefaultControl` (`int`): Passive control ID allocated per frame via `GUIUtility.GetControlID(FocusType.Passive)` and passed to `HandleUtility.AddDefaultControl` to suppress Unity default scene object picking.
- `m_Hovering` / `m_HoveringPrevious` (`SceneSelection`): Stores hovered element references for preselection rendering.
- `m_ScenePickerPreferences` (`ScenePickerPreferences`): Caches active cull mode and rect select mode.
- `m_InitialMousePosition` (`Vector2`): Screen position recorded at initial `MouseDown`.
- `m_MouseDragRect` (`Rect`): Computed bounding rectangle of active drag selection.
- `m_IsDragging` (`bool`): Active marquee drag status flag.
- `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag` (`bool`): Guard flag preventing errant drag processing without prior mouse down.
- `m_WasDoubleClick` (`bool`): Prevents `MouseUp` selection clearing following double-click loop/ring actions.
- `m_wasSelectingPath` (`bool`): Tracks previous state of path selection modifier keys.

2. Lifecycle and Event Coordination:
- Constructor: Disposes any existing instance, subscribes `SceneView.duringSceneGui += OnSceneGUI`, `ProGridsInterface.SubscribePushToGridEvent(PushToGrid)`, `MeshSelection.objectSelectionChanged += OnObjectSelectionChanged`, `selectModeChanged += OnSelectModeChanged`, `VertexManipulationTool.beforeMeshModification += BeforeMeshModification`, and `VertexManipulationTool.afterMeshModification += AfterMeshModification`. Initializes GUI styles, calls `LoadSettings()`, `UpdateMeshHandles()`, `SetOverrideWireframe(true)`, and schedules `UpdateSelection()` via `EditorApplication.delayCall`.
- `Dispose()`: Unsubscribes from all scene and tool events, restores wireframe state via `SetOverrideWireframe(false)`, invokes `OnSelectModeChanged(SelectMode.None)`, triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`, and clears `s_Instance`.
- `Refresh(bool vertexCountChanged = true)`: Rebuilds selection handles and triggers `selectionUpdated` event across listeners.

3. `OnSceneGUI(SceneView sceneView)` Event Pipeline:
- Step 1: Validates active override tool: `if (!EditorToolUtility.IsBuiltinOverride(EditorToolManager.activeTool)) return;`.
- Step 2: Initializes GUI styles via `SceneStyles.Init()` (sets up `s_SelectionRect` GUIStyle with icon `"Scene/SelectionRect"` and border offset `(1, 1, 1, 1)`).
- Step 3: Renders mesh handles via `EditorHandleDrawing.DrawSceneHandles(SceneDragAndDropListener.isDragging ? SelectMode.None : selectMode)`.
- Step 4: Invokes `DrawHandleGUI(sceneView)`: during `EventType.Repaint`, if not dragging and `GUIUtility.hotControl == 0`, draws hover highlights via `EditorHandleDrawing.DrawSceneSelection(m_Hovering)`; if dragging, computes normalized screen rectangle `m_MouseDragRect` between `m_InitialMousePosition` and `m_CurrentEvent.mousePosition` and draws `SceneStyles.selectionRect.Draw(m_MouseDragRect, false, false, false, false)`.
- Step 5: Key down handling: if `keyCode == KeyCode.Escape`, `activeOverride == null`, and context is `PositionToolContext`, cancels drag state and exits to GameObject context via `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`.
- Step 6: Preselection raycasting: on `MouseMove` or modifier changes when `s_ShowHoverHighlight` and `selectMode.IsMeshElementMode()` are active, copies hovering state, executes `EditorSceneViewPicker.MouseRayHitTest(m_CurrentEvent.mousePosition, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences, m_Hovering)`, clears `m_Hovering` if distance exceeds `ScenePickerPreferences.maxPointerDistance`, and runs `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseHover(m_Hovering)` if path selection modifier active.
- Step 7: Returns if `Tools.current == Tool.View` (camera navigation).
- Step 8: Command dispatch: responds to `"SelectAll"`, `"DeselectAll"`, and `"InvertSelection"` commands on `EventType.ValidateCommand` and `EventType.ExecuteCommand`.
- Step 9: Checks `EditorHandleUtility.SceneViewInUse(m_CurrentEvent)` to clear drag and reset `hotControl`.
- Step 10: Allocates default passive control `m_DefaultControl` on `EventType.Layout` and routes to `HandleMouseEvent(sceneView, m_DefaultControl)`.

4. Mouse Event Handling (`HandleMouseEvent`):
- Ignores events when `Alt` key is held without an active drag session to enable standard Scene view orbit/pan navigation.
- `MouseDown` (left button, `nearestControl == controlID`): detects double click (`clickCount > 1`) and routes to `DoubleClick(m_CurrentEvent)`. Caches `m_InitialMousePosition`, sets `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = true`, and sets `GUIUtility.hotControl = controlID`.
- `MouseDrag`: when `Vector2.Distance(mousePosition, m_InitialMousePosition) > k_MouseDragThreshold`, sets `m_IsDragging = true` and requests scene repaint.
- `EventType.Ignore`: if dragging was aborted, executes `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseDrag(m_MouseDragRect, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and resets `m_IsDragging = false`, `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = false`, and `GUIUtility.hotControl = 0`.
- `MouseUp`: releases `GUIUtility.hotControl = 0`. If `m_WasDoubleClick` is set, resets flag. If not dragging, executes single element pick via `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseClick(m_CurrentEvent, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and calls `UpdateSelection()`. If dragging, completes rectangle selection via `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseDrag(m_MouseDragRect, selectMode, m_ScenePickerPreferences)` and resets drag flags. Resets `UVEditor.instance.ResetUserPivot()` if UV editor is open.

5. Double-Click Dispatch (`DoubleClick`):
- Invokes `EditorSceneViewPicker.DoMouseClick` to obtain targeted mesh.
- If in Edge mode: `Shift` executes `SelectEdgeRing.PerformAction()`; default executes `SelectEdgeLoop.PerformAction()`.
- If in Face mode: `Ctrl + Shift` executes `SelectFaceRing.MenuRingAndLoopFaces()`; `Ctrl` executes `SelectFaceRing.PerformAction()`; `Shift` executes `SelectFaceLoop.PerformAction()`; default selects all faces on mesh via `mesh.SetSelectedFaces(mesh.facesInternal)`.
- Other modes: selects all faces on mesh.
- Updates selection and sets `m_WasDoubleClick = true`.

6. Selection Commands (`SelectAll`, `DeselectAll`, `InvertSelection`):
- `SelectAll()`: In Vertex mode, collects first vertex index of every shared vertex cluster `sharedVerticesInternal[i][0]`. In Face mode, passes `mesh.facesInternal`. In Edge mode, builds universal edges via `mesh.GetSharedVertexHandleEdges()` and populates `Edge` array mapping `sharedVerticesInternal[universal.a][0]` to `sharedVerticesInternal[universal.b][0]`.
- `DeselectAll()`: Sets selected vertices, faces, or edges to null or empty collections.
- `InvertSelection()`: Reverses selection masks for vertices, faces, and universal shared edges.

7. Wireframe Override and Grid Snapping:
- `SetOverrideWireframe(bool overrideWireframe)`: Queries mesh renderers and applies `EditorUtility.SetSelectionRenderState(mesh.renderer, overrideWireframe ? (Highlight | Wireframe) & ~Wireframe : (Highlight | Wireframe))`, stripping Unity built-in wireframe so ProBuilder custom geometry handles render without visual clash.
- `PushToGrid(float snapVal)`: Iterates selected meshes, resolves coincident vertices using `mesh.GetCoincidentVertices(mesh.selectedIndexesInternal)`, executes `ProBuilderSnapping.SnapVertices(mesh, indexes, Vector3.one * snapVal)`, and re-optimizes mesh through `mesh.ToMesh()`, `mesh.Refresh()`, and `mesh.Optimize()`.

        void PushToGrid(float snapVal)
        {
            UndoUtility.RecordSelection(selection.ToArray(), "Push elements to Grid");

### SETTINGS

ProBuilder manages user and project preferences through a unified Settings Management architecture encapsulated in `ProBuilderSettings`, `Pref<T>`, `ProBuilderSettingsProvider`, and the backward-compatible `PreferencesInternal` utility.

1. Settings Architecture:
- `ProBuilderSettings`: Static wrapper over Unity SettingsManager using package identifier `"com.unity.probuilder"`. Automatic migration detects legacy `"ProjectSettings/ProBuilderSettings.json"` and relocates it to `PackageSettingsRepository.GetSettingsPath("com.unity.probuilder")`. Registers `EditorApplication.quitting += Save` on initialization. Core APIs include `Save()`, `Set<T>(key, value, scope)`, `Get<T>(key, scope, fallback)`, `ContainsKey<T>(key, scope)`, and `Delete<T>(key, scope)`.
- `Pref<T> : UserSetting<T>`: Generic type binding a preference key, default value, and `SettingsScope` (`SettingsScope.Project` or `SettingsScope.User`). Provides implicit cast operator `public static implicit operator T(Pref<T> pref) => pref.value`.
- `ProBuilderSettingsProvider`: Registers settings UI under `"Preferences/ProBuilder"` via `[SettingsProvider]` and `UserSettingsProvider`. Connects to `ProBuilderSettings.instance.afterSettingsSaved` to invoke `ProBuilderEditor.ReloadSettings()` and `Experimental.AfterSettingsSaved()`.
- `PreferencesInternal`: Legacy obsolete storage bridge maintaining cached dictionary defaults and falling back between project local assets (`"ProBuilderPreferences.asset"`) and global `EditorPrefs`.

### MENU ACTION BASE CLASS

The `MenuAction` abstract base class provides the execution contract, validation rules, category grouping, UI presentation metadata, and lifecycle events for all operations exposed on the ProBuilder toolbar and menu hierarchy.

1. Enums and Constants:
- `MenuActionState` (`[Flags]` enum):
  - `Hidden = 0x0`: Action is not visible on the toolbar.
  - `Visible = 0x1`: Action button is visible in the toolbar.
  - `Enabled = 0x2`: Action is valid given the current selection and mode.
  - `VisibleAndEnabled = 0x3`: Action is both visible and clickable.
- Menu Paths & Shortcuts Constants:
  - `probuilderMenuPath = "Tools/ProBuilder/"`: Base root path for generated Unity top-level menus.
  - `keyCommandSuper = PreferenceKeys.CMD_SUPER` (`'\u2318'`): Command/Control symbol.
  - `keyCommandShift = PreferenceKeys.CMD_SHIFT` (`'\u21E7'`): Shift symbol.
  - `keyCommandOption = PreferenceKeys.CMD_OPTION` (`'\u2325'`): Option symbol.
  - `keyCommandAlt = PreferenceKeys.CMD_ALT` (`'\u2387'`): Alt symbol.
  - `keyCommandDelete = PreferenceKeys.CMD_DELETE` (`'\u232B'`): Delete symbol.

2. Abstract and Virtual Properties:
- `group` (`ToolbarGroup`, abstract): Categorizes the action (`Tool`, `Selection`, `Object`, `Face`, `Edge`, `Vertex`, `Math`, `Entity`, `Export`, `Debug`).
- `toolbarPriority` (`int`, virtual, default `-1`): Layout ordering priority modifier (0 = first, 1 = second, -1 = no preference, mapped to `int.MaxValue` in sorting comparator).
- `icon` (`Texture2D`, abstract): Icon texture rendered in Context Menu and button.
- `iconPath` (`string`, abstract): Local path to icon resource.
- `tooltip` (`TooltipContent`, abstract): Detailed multi-line tooltip definition.
- `menuTitle` (`string`, virtual): Title displayed on text buttons, defaults to `tooltip.title`.
- `hasFileMenuEntry` (`bool`, protected internal virtual, default `true`): Dictates whether a static `[MenuItem]` wrapper is generated for the Unity main menu.
- `validSelectModes` (`SelectMode`, virtual, default `SelectMode.Any`): Bitmask specifying the modes (`Vertex`, `Edge`, `Face`, or `Object`) where the action is applicable.
- `enabled` (`bool`, virtual): Evaluated dynamically as `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(validSelectModes) && !ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(SelectMode.InputTool)`.
- `hidden` (`bool`, virtual): Evaluated as `!ProBuilderEditor.selectMode.ContainsFlag(validSelectModes)`.
- `menuActionState` (`MenuActionState`, property): Combines `hidden` and `enabled` to yield `MenuActionState.Hidden`, `MenuActionState.Visible`, or `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled`.
- `optionsMenuState` (`MenuActionState`, protected virtual, default `MenuActionState.Hidden`): Controls options indicator display.

3. Action Execution & Event Pattern:
- `public static Action<MenuAction> onPerformAction`: Global event raised whenever any toolbar action executes.
- `public event Action changed`: Instance event raised when action properties or contents change.
- Execution Sequence (`PerformAction()`):
  1. Fires `onPerformAction?.Invoke(this)`.
  2. Calls `PerformActionImplementation()` (protected abstract returning `ActionResult`).
  3. Invokes `ContentsChanged()`, which fires the instance `changed` event.
  4. Returns `ActionResult` (containing `ActionResult.Status` and descriptive message).
- Deprecation bridge: `DoAction()` is marked `[Obsolete]` and forwards directly to `PerformAction()`.
- Secondary Settings Action: `PerformAltAction()` calls `DoAlternateAction()`, which opens the modal popup window `MenuOption.Show(OnSettingsGUI, OnSettingsEnable, OnSettingsDisable)`.
- Modern UI Overlay integration: `CreateSettingsContent()` returns a `VisualElement` root containing action parameters for Unity 2023.2+ overlay panels.
- Scene GUI hook: `DoSceneGUI(SceneView sceneView)` allows active actions to render handles or gizmos during scene interaction.

4. Tool Toggling via `MenuToolToggle`:
- `MenuToolToggle : MenuAction` specializes `MenuAction` to manage an `EditorTool` instance stored in protected field `EditorTool m_Tool`.
- `PerformActionImplementation()` inspects `m_Tool`. If active via `ToolManager.IsActiveTool(m_Tool)`, it invokes `ToolManager.RestorePreviousTool()`; otherwise, it calls `ToolManager.SetActiveTool(m_Tool)` and returns `ActionResult.Success`.

5. Action Sorting Comparator:
- `CompareActionsByGroupAndPriority(MenuAction left, MenuAction right)`: Sorts actions by integer enum value of `group`. For actions within the same group, compares `toolbarPriority`, treating negative values as `int.MaxValue` to place unprioritized actions at the end.

        /// <summary>

            else

### MENU SYSTEM

The ProBuilder menu system populates Unity top-level menu bar (`"Tools/ProBuilder/"`) and context menus by dynamically discovering and registering `MenuAction` implementations.

1. Menu Action Discovery (`EditorToolbarLoader`):
- Pre-seeded built-in action registry: `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions(bool forceReload)` maintains a cached list `s_LoadedMenuActions`. On first execution or forced reload, it populates built-in instances across categories: Tools (`NewBezierShape`, `OpenMaterialEditor`, `OpenUVEditor`, `OpenVertexColorEditor`, `OpenSmoothingEditor`, `ToggleSelectBackFaces`, `ToggleHandleOrientation`, `ToggleDragRectMode`, `ToggleXRay`), Selection (`GrowSelection`, `ShrinkSelection`, `SelectEdgeLoop`, `SelectEdgeRing`, `SelectFaceLoop`, `SelectFaceRing`, `SelectHole`, `SelectVertexColor`, `SelectMaterial`, `SelectSmoothingGroup`), Object (`MergeObjects`, `MirrorObjects`, `FlipObjectNormals`, `SubdivideObject`, `FreezeTransform`, `CenterPivot`, `ConformObjectNormals`, `TriangulateObject`, `GenerateUV2`, `ProBuilderize`, `Export`, `ExportObj`, `ExportAsset`, `ExportPly`, `ExportStlAscii`, `ExportStlBinary`), All elements (`SetPivotToSelection`, `OffsetElements`, `CutToolAction`), Faces (`DeleteFaces`, `DetachFaces`, `DuplicateFaces`, `ExtrudeFaces`, `ConformFaceNormals`, `FlipFaceEdge`, `FlipFaceNormals`, `MergeFaces`, `SubdivideFaces`, `TriangulateFaces`), Edges (`BridgeEdges`, `BevelEdges`, `ConnectEdges`, `ExtrudeEdges`, `InsertEdgeLoop`, `SubdivideEdges`), Vertices (`CollapseVertices`, `WeldVertices`, `ConnectVertices`, `FillHole`, `SplitVertices`), and Entities (`SetTrigger`, `SetCollider`).
- Reflection-based Plugin Discovery: `SearchForMenuAttributes(List<MenuAction> list)` scans all assemblies in `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()` (or `CurrentAssemblies.GetLoadedAssemblies()` in Unity 6+). Finds types matching:
  - Derived from `MenuAction` (`typeof(MenuAction).IsAssignableFrom(x)`).
  - Concrete class (`!x.IsAbstract`).
  - Decorated with `[ProBuilderMenuActionAttribute]`.
  - Validates parameterless constructor exists via reflection flags `BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public`.
  - Instantiates via `Activator.CreateInstance(x)` and adds to `s_LoadedMenuActions`.
- Post-discovery sorting: Calls `s_LoadedMenuActions.Sort(MenuAction.CompareActionsByGroupAndPriority)`.
- Type-safe instance retrieval: `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()` performs fast LINQ lookup `GetActions().FirstOrDefault(x => x is T)` and instantiates on demand if missing.

2. Generated Menu Items Architecture (`EditorToolbarMenuItems`):
- Generated static class `EditorToolbarMenuItem` binds menu actions to the Unity menu hierarchy using `[MenuItem(path, isValidateFunction, priority)]` attributes.
- Menu categories and priority baseline constants from `PreferenceKeys`:
  - `menuEditor = 100`: Editors (`Create Bezier Shape`, `Open UV Editor`, or `Open Material Editor`).
  - `menuSelection = 200`: Selection modifications (`Grow Selection &G`, `Select Loop &L`, `Select Ring &R`, `Select Hole`).
  - `menuGeometry = 200`: Object and element geometry operations (`Bevel Edges`, `Extrude %E`, `Merge Faces`, `Bridge Edges`, or `Collapse Vertices`).
  - `menuActions = 300`: Action items.
  - `menuMaterialColors = 400` / `menuVertexColors = 400`: Palette operations.
  - `menuRepair = 600` / `menuMisc = 600`: Mesh diagnosis and repair utilities.
  - `menuExport = 800`: Export formats (`Export Asset`, `Export Obj`, `Export Ply`, `Export Stl Ascii`, `Export Stl Binary`).
- Validation Pattern (`MenuVerify_*`):
  - Verifies context: `if (ToolManager.activeContextType != typeof(PositionToolContext)) return false;` (for geometry actions).
  - Retrieves action instance via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()`.
  - Updates visual checkmark state via `Menu.SetChecked(menuPath, instance.IsMenuItemChecked())`.
  - Returns `instance != null && instance.enabled`.
- Execution Pattern (`MenuPerform_*`):
  - Retrieves action instance via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetInstance<T>()`.
  - Checks `if (instance != null && instance.enabled)`.
  - Clears active preview via `PreviewActionManager.EndPreview()` or launches interactive settings mode via `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(instance, showSettingsOnStart))`.
  - Invokes `instance.PerformAction()` and logs telemetry with `ProBuilderAnalytics.SendActionEvent(instance)`.

3. Dedicated Vertex Color Preset Menus (`MenuItems`):
- `MenuItems` registers 10 shortcut menu items under `"Tools/ProBuilder/Vertex Colors/Set Selected Faces to Preset [0-9] &#0-9"`.
- Unified validation method `VerifyApplyVertexColor()` checks `ProBuilderEditor.instance != null && MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount > 0`.
- Perform methods route to `VertexColorPalette.SetFaceColors(presetIndex)`.

            foreach (var assembly in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())
#endif

                                || x.IsAbstract
                                || !Attribute.IsDefined(x, typeof(ProBuilderMenuActionAttribute)))
                                return false;

                            var constructors = x.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public);

                            if (!constructors.Any(y => y.GetParameters().Length < 1))
                            {
                                Log.Error("{0} type does not contain a parameterless constructor. Only parameterless constructors are invoked with creating MenuItem instances.", x.ToString());
                                return false;
                            }

                            if (constructors.Any(z => z.GetParameters().Length > 0))
                                Log.Warning("{0} type contains a non-parameterless constructor. Only parameterless constructors are invoked with creating MenuItem instances.", x.ToString());

                            return true;
                        });

                    list.AddRange(menuActionTypes.Select(x => (MenuAction)Activator.CreateInstance(x)));

> **Godot Note:** In Godot, menu population is accomplished via `EditorPlugin.add_tool_menu_item(name, callable)` or by building a `PopupMenu` inside the 3D viewport header. Action discovery can inspect registered classes via `ClassDB` or search exported GDExtension / C# assemblies for custom `[ProBuilderMenuAction]` attributes.

### TOOLBAR

The ProBuilder toolbar is built dynamically from the sorted list of `MenuAction` objects obtained through `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`, combining icon loading, caching, layout grouping, and rich floating tooltips.

1. Toolbar Construction and Grouping:
- The toolbar queries `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()` to assemble actions grouped by `ToolbarGroup`.
- Action buttons dynamically query `action.menuActionState` on GUI render:
  - If `MenuActionState.Hidden` (or `action.hidden` is true), the button is omitted from layout.
  - If `MenuActionState.Visible`, the button is drawn disabled/grayed out.
  - If `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled` (or `action.enabled` is true), the button is active and clickable.
- Secondary Options: Actions with `optionsVisible` display an adjacent options trigger icon. Left-clicking options or Alt-clicking text buttons calls `action.PerformAltAction()`, displaying modal settings via `MenuOption.Show`.

2. Icon Asset Loading (`IconUtility`):
- Base Resource Path: `s_IconFolderPath = "Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/"`.
- Cache: `static Dictionary<string, Texture2D> s_Icons` caches all loaded icon textures in memory. `[InitializeOnEnterPlayMode]` triggers `s_Icons.Clear()`.
- Resolution Algorithm (`GetIcon(string iconName)`):
  1. Checks cache `s_Icons.TryGetValue(iconName, out icon)`. Returns immediately if cached.
  2. Appends `".png"` extension if not already present in `iconName`.
  3. Combines path with `s_IconFolderPath` and loads asset via `EditorGUIUtility.LoadIcon(fullPath)`.
  4. Stores loaded texture in `s_Icons` dictionary and returns the asset.
- Skin Handling: Dark skin icons use prefix `"d_"` in filenames, while light skin uses unmodified filenames.

3. Tooltip Architecture (`TooltipContent` and `TooltipEditor`):
- `TooltipContent` Structure:
  - Properties: `title` (`string`), `summary` (`string`), `shortcut` (`string`).
  - Constructor key formatting: Converts array of `char` shortcut definitions into formatted text strings using `InternalUtility.ControlKeyString` (e.g. converting `CMD_SUPER` to `"Ctrl"` on Windows/Linux or command symbol on macOS, appending `" + "` separators).
  - Style Initialization (`InitStyles()`):
    - `_titleStyle`: Font size 14, bold, richText enabled, textColor `Color.white` (Pro skin) or `Color.black` (Light skin), margin `(4, 4, 4, 4)`, padding `(4, 4, 4, 4)`.
    - `_shortcutStyle`: Font size 14, normal weight, textColor `Color(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 1f)` (Pro skin) or `Color(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f, 1f)` (Light skin).
  - Dimension Calculation (`CalcSize()`):
    - Minimum width: `k_MinWidth = 128`, maximum width: `k_MaxWidth = 330`, minimum height: `k_MinHeight = 0`, padding: `pad = 8`.
    - Computes title size via `TitleStyle.CalcSize(TempContent(title))`, adds shortcut width from `EditorStyles.boldLabel.CalcSize(TempContent(shortcut)) + pad`, and clamps to `Mathf.Max(ns.x, 256)`.
    - Computes summary height via `EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel.CalcHeight(TempContent(summary), total.x)`.
    - Adds separator gap (`16px`) when both title and summary are present, returning final `Vector2` dimensions.
  - Drawing (`Draw()`):
    - Title and shortcut layout in horizontal group separated by `GUILayout.FlexibleSpace()`.
    - Draws horizontal separator line with thickness 1 and color `separatorColor = Color(0.65f, 0.65f, 0.65f, 0.5f)`.
    - Draws word-wrapped summary label via `EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel`.
- Floating Tooltip Window (`TooltipEditor : EditorWindow`):
  - Singleton window accessed via `TooltipEditor.instance()`, configured with `minSize = Vector2.zero`, `maxSize = Vector2.zero`, `hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave`, and displayed via `ShowTooltip()`.
  - Display logic (`ShowInternal(Rect rect, TooltipContent content)`):
    - Calculates content size via `content.CalcSize()`.
    - Calculates screen DPI ratio `dpiRatio = Screen.dpi / 96f` and effective screen width `Screen.currentResolution.width / dpiRatio`.
    - Positions tooltip to the right of the button with offset `k_PositionPadding = 4`: `p = Vector2(rect.x + rect.width + k_PositionPadding, rect.y)`.
    - Screen boundary clamping: if `p.x + size.x > screenWidth`, repositions tooltip to the left side of the button: `p.x = rect.x - k_PositionPadding - size.x`.
    - Sets window `position = Rect(p.x, p.y, size.x, size.y)` and updates `s_WindowRect`.
    - Background styling when not in Pro skin (`!EditorGUIUtility.isProSkin`) sets `GUI.backgroundColor = new Color(0.87f, 0.87f, 0.87f, 1f)` before drawing `GUI.Box(s_WindowRect, "")`.

```csharp
    static class IconUtility
    {
        static Dictionary<string, Texture2D> s_Icons = new Dictionary<string, Texture2D>();

        static string s_IconFolderPath = "Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/";

        [InitializeOnEnterPlayMode]
        static void ResetStaticsOnLoad()
        {
            s_Icons.Clear();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load an icon from icons folder located in the package's 'Editor Default Resources'.
        /// Naming convention is: "path/to/iconName" (without extension). Use the 'd_' prefix for dark skin  icons.
        /// No prefix or suffit for light skin icons. This method assumes the file is .png.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="iconName">Relative path to the icon without the file extension in the filename.</param>
        /// <returns>A valid icon texture. Otherwise null is returned.</returns>
        public static Texture2D GetIcon(string iconName)
        {
            Texture2D icon = null;

            if (!s_Icons.TryGetValue(iconName, out icon))
            {
                string fullPath = Path.Combine(s_IconFolderPath, iconName + (Path.HasExtension(iconName)? string.Empty: ".png"));

                icon = EditorGUIUtility.LoadIcon(fullPath);
                if(icon != null)
                    s_Icons.Add(iconName, icon);
            }
            return icon;
        }
    }

> **Godot Note:** In Godot, toolbar buttons are implemented as `Button` nodes inside an `HBoxContainer` or `GridContainer` in an editor dock or 3D viewport overlay panel. `IconUtility` maps to loading SVG/PNG textures via `ResourceLoader.load("res://addons/probuilder/icons/...")`. Tooltips map to custom `Control` tooltip instances created via `Control._make_custom_tooltip(for_text)`.

### SHORTCUTS

ProBuilder registers, dispatches, and validates keyboard shortcuts across three distinct layers: Unity Shortcut Management API, MenuItem attribute key sequences, and hardcoded Scene view event intercepts in `ProBuilderEditor`.

1. Shortcut Management Attributes (`ProBuilderEditorShortcuts`):
- Registered shortcuts target specific context types so that hotkeys only trigger when the user is operating within valid editing states:
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Vertices", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Vertex()`, validates via `CheckAndEnterPBContextIfNeeded()`, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Vertex`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Edges", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Edge()`, validates context, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Edge`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Edit Faces", typeof(SceneViewMotion.SceneViewContext))]`: Calls `SetSelectMode_Faces()`, validates context, and sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = SelectMode.Face`.
  - `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Toggle Edit Mode", typeof(PositionToolContext.ProBuilderShortcutContext), KeyCode.H)]`: Invokes `Toggle_SelectMode()`, calling `ProBuilderEditor.instance.ToggleSelectionMode()` which cycles `Vertex` -> `Edge` -> `Face` -> `Vertex`.
  - Context validation helper: `CheckAndEnterPBContextIfNeeded()` checks `if (ToolManager.activeContextType != typeof(PositionToolContext))`. If `EditorToolManager.GetComponentContext(typeof(PositionToolContext), true) != null`, it switches context via `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<PositionToolContext>()`.

2. Additional Context-Specific Shortcuts:
- Path Selection: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Selection/Select Path", typeof(PositionToolContext.ProBuilderShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Action)]`.
- Quick Material: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Apply Quick Material", typeof(MaterialShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse2, ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Control)]`.
- Dimensions Overlay: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Dimensions Overlay/Toggle Overlay", typeof(SceneView))]`.
- UV Editor Reset: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/UV Editor/Reset Canvas", typeof(UVEditor), KeyCode.Alpha0)]`.
- UV Auto-stitch: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Auto-stitch UV", typeof(UVEditorShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Action | ShortcutModifiers.Shift | ShortcutModifiers.Alt)]`.
- UV Copy Settings: `[Shortcut("ProBuilder/Editor/Copy UV Settings", typeof(UVEditorShortcutContext), KeyCode.Mouse0, ShortcutModifiers.Action | ShortcutModifiers.Alt)]`.

3. MenuItem Key Binding Syntax (`EditorToolbarMenuItems` & `MenuItems`):
- Unity MenuItem attributes define key sequences using syntax modifiers:
  - `%`: Control on Windows/Linux, Command on macOS.
  - `#`: Shift key.
  - `&`: Alt on Windows/Linux, Option on macOS.
  - `_`: Single key without modifiers.
- Standard Menu Shortcuts Registered:
  - Extrude: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Extrude %E"` (Ctrl+E) -> triggers `ExtrudeEdges` in Edge mode or `ExtrudeFaces` in Face mode.
  - Flip Face Normals: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Flip Face Normals &N"` (Alt+N).
  - Insert Edge Loop: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Insert Edge Loop &U"` (Alt+U).
  - Smart Connect: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Smart Connect &E"` (Alt+E).
  - Smart Subdivide: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Smart Subdivide &S"` (Alt+S) -> executes `SubdivideEdges` in Edge mode or `SubdivideFaces` in other modes.
  - Split Vertices: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Split Vertices &X"` (Alt+X).
  - Weld Vertices: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Weld Vertices &V"` (Alt+V).
  - Grow Selection: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Grow Selection &G"` (Alt+G).
  - Shrink Selection: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Shrink Selection &#G"` (Alt+Shift+G).
  - Select Loop: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Select Loop &L"` (Alt+L).
  - Select Ring: `k_MenuPrefix + "Selection/Select Ring &R"` (Alt+R).
  - Toggle X-Ray: `k_MenuPrefix + "Interaction/Toggle X Ray &#X"` (Alt+Shift+X).
  - Delete Faces: `k_MenuPrefix + "Geometry/Delete Faces _BACKSPACE"` (Backspace key).
  - Vertex Color Presets 0-9: `"Tools/ProBuilder/Vertex Colors/Set Selected Faces to Preset [0-9] &#0-9"` (Alt+Shift+0 through Alt+Shift+9).

4. Hardcoded Scene GUI Intercepts (`ProBuilderEditor.OnSceneGUI`):
- Escape Key: When `m_CurrentEvent.type == EventType.KeyDown && m_CurrentEvent.keyCode == KeyCode.Escape`, if `EditorToolManager.activeOverride == null` and active context is `PositionToolContext`, executes `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`, resets `m_IsDragging = false`, `m_IsReadyForMouseDrag = false`, and consumes the event via `m_CurrentEvent.Use()`.
- Double-Click Modifiers: `Shift` triggers Edge/Face Loop, `Ctrl` triggers Face Ring, and `Ctrl + Shift` triggers concurrent Face Ring and Loop selection.

# Object Operations

## I01: Object-level actions: merge, mirror, export, probuilderize

### MERGE OBJECTS

The `MergeObjects` action (located in `Editor/MenuActions/Object/MergeObjects.cs`) combines multiple selected `ProBuilderMesh` objects into a single mesh hierarchy item. It belongs to `ToolbarGroup.Object`, utilizes the icon asset path `Toolbar/Object_Merge` retrieved via `IconUtility.GetIcon()`, and defines the tooltip `TooltipContent` titled 'Merge Objects' with description 'Merges all selected ProBuilder objects to a single mesh.'.

1. Selection Validation and Enabling Rules:
- Property `enabled` returns `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount > 1 && MeshSelection.activeMesh != null`.
- `PerformActionImplementation()` performs a defensive check: if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 2`, it aborts and returns `new ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Canceled, "Must Select 2+ Objects")`. Otherwise, it executes `DoMergeObjectsAction()` and returns `new ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Success, "Merged Objects")`.

2. Merge Execution Pipeline (`DoMergeObjectsAction()`):
- Captures donor array: `var selected = MeshSelection.top.ToArray()`.
- Designates target: `ProBuilderMesh currentMesh = MeshSelection.activeMesh`.
- Registers undo for the active mesh target via `UndoUtility.RecordObject(currentMesh, "Merge Objects")`.
- Delegates core mesh combination to `CombineMeshes.Combine(MeshSelection.topInternal, currentMesh)`, returning `List<ProBuilderMesh> res`.

3. Post-Merge Consolidation and Cleanup:
- For each resulting mesh in `res`:
  - Invokes `mesh.Optimize()` to clean up vertex buffers and collapse coincident geometry.
  - If the resulting mesh is not `currentMesh` (meaning vertex count overflowed `ProBuilderMesh.maxVertexCount` and required a newly allocated GameObject), renames the GameObject to `Selection.activeGameObject.name + "-Merged"`, registers creation undo with `UndoUtility.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(mesh.gameObject, "Merge Objects")`, and updates `Selection.objects = res.Select(x => x.gameObject).ToArray()`.
  - Checks for parametric shape components: if `mesh.gameObject.GetComponent<PolyShape>()` is non-null, destroys it immediately using `UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(polyShapeComp)`; if `mesh.gameObject.GetComponent<ProBuilderShape>()` is non-null, destroys it using `UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(proBuilderShape)` to prevent stale parametric regeneration from overwriting merged vertex data.
- Destroys donor GameObjects: iterates `selected` array from `0` to `selected.Length - 1`; for each donor where `selected[i] != null && res.Contains(selected[i]) == false`, destroys the GameObject via `UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(selected[i].gameObject)`.

```csharp

        internal List<ProBuilderMesh> DoMergeObjectsAction()
        {
            var selected = MeshSelection.top.ToArray();
            ProBuilderMesh currentMesh = MeshSelection.activeMesh;
            UndoUtility.RecordObject(currentMesh, "Merge Objects");
            List<ProBuilderMesh> res = CombineMeshes.Combine(MeshSelection.topInternal, currentMesh);

            if (res != null)
            {
                foreach (var mesh in res)
                {
                    mesh.Optimize();
                    if (mesh != currentMesh)
                    {
                        mesh.gameObject.name = Selection.activeGameObject.name + "-Merged";
                        UndoUtility.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(mesh.gameObject, "Merge Objects");
                        
                        Selection.objects = res.Select(x => x.gameObject).ToArray();
                    }
                    
                    // Remove PolyShape and ProBuilderShape components if any are present post-merge
                    var polyShapeComp = mesh.gameObject.GetComponent<PolyShape>();
                    if (polyShapeComp != null )
                        UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(polyShapeComp);
                    
                    var proBuilderShape = mesh.gameObject.GetComponent<ProBuilderShape>();
                    if (proBuilderShape != null )
                        UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(proBuilderShape);
                }

                // Delete donor objects if they are not part of the result
                for (int i = 0; i < selected.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (selected[i] != null && res.Contains(selected[i]) == false)
                        UndoUtility.DestroyImmediate(selected[i].gameObject);
                }
            }

            return res;
        }

### COMBINE MESHES

The static class `CombineMeshes` (in `Runtime/MeshOperations/CombineMeshes.cs`) contains the geometric and topological algorithms for combining multiple `ProBuilderMesh` objects into as few resulting meshes as possible, respecting Unity's 16-bit vertex index limit of 65535 (`ProBuilderMesh.maxVertexCount`).

1. Target Combination Algorithm (`Combine(IEnumerable<ProBuilderMesh> meshes, ProBuilderMesh meshTarget)`):
- Step 1: Input Validation: Throws `ArgumentNullException` if `meshes` or `meshTarget` is null. Returns null if `!meshes.Any() || meshes.Count() < 2` or if `!meshes.Contains(meshTarget)`.
- Step 2: Target Data Initialization:
  - `var vertices = new List<Vertex>(meshTarget.GetVertices());`
  - `var faces = new List<Face>(meshTarget.facesInternal);`
  - `var sharedVertices = new List<SharedVertex>(meshTarget.sharedVertices);`
  - `var sharedTextures = new List<SharedVertex>(meshTarget.sharedTextures);`
  - `int offset = meshTarget.vertexCount;`
  - `var materialMap = new List<Material>(meshTarget.renderer.sharedMaterials);`
  - `var targetTransform = meshTarget.transform;`
- Step 3: Vertex Count Partitioning:
  - Iterates `meshes`. If `mesh != meshTarget`:
    - If `currentMeshVertexCount + mesh.vertexCount < ProBuilderMesh.maxVertexCount`, adds `mesh` to `firstMeshContributors` and adds `mesh.vertexCount` to `currentMeshVertexCount`.
    - Otherwise, adds `mesh` to `remainderMeshContributors`.
- Step 4: Accumulating Contributor Meshes (`AccumulateMeshesInfo`):
  - Invokes `AccumulateMeshesInfo(firstMeshContributors, offset, ref vertices, ref faces, ref autoUvFaces, ref sharedVertices, ref sharedTextures, ref materialMap, targetTransform)`.
- Step 5: Applying and Validating Target:
  - Reassigns target mesh buffers: `meshTarget.SetVertices(vertices)`, `meshTarget.faces = faces`, `meshTarget.sharedVertices = sharedVertices`, `meshTarget.sharedTextures = sharedTextures != null ? sharedTextures.ToArray() : null`, `meshTarget.renderer.sharedMaterials = materialMap.ToArray()`.
  - Rebuilds mesh components: `meshTarget.ToMesh()`, `meshTarget.Refresh()`.
  - Preserves UV alignments: calls `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoAndAlignUnwrapParamsToUVs(meshTarget, autoUvFaces)`.
  - Enforces topology validity: calls `MeshValidation.EnsureMeshIsValid(meshTarget, out int removedVertices)`.
- Step 6: Handling Remainder Contributors:
  - Initializes return list: `var returnedMesh = new List<ProBuilderMesh>() { meshTarget };`.
  - If `remainderMeshContributors.Count > 1`, combines them into new mesh instances via `CombineToNewMeshes(remainderMeshContributors)`, validates each with `MeshValidation.EnsureMeshIsValid`, and appends them to `returnedMesh`.
  - If `remainderMeshContributors.Count == 1`, appends the single donor mesh directly.

2. Vertex, Face, and Submesh Accumulation (`AccumulateMeshesInfo`):
- For each donor mesh in `meshes`:
  - Computes vertex transformation: for index `i = 0` to `meshVertexCount - 1`, computes world-space position `worldVertex = transform.TransformVertex(meshVertices[i])`. If `targetTransform != null`, converts into target local space via `targetTransform.InverseTransformVertex(worldVertex)`; otherwise appends `worldVertex` directly.
  - Renumbers faces: for each `face` in `meshFaces`, constructs `newFace = new Face(face)` and shifts vertex indices by `offset` via `newFace.ShiftIndexes(offset)`.
  - Preserves UV coordinates: if `!newFace.manualUV && !newFace.uv.useWorldSpace`, flags `newFace.manualUV = true` and appends `newFace` to `autoUvFaces` to prevent unwanted coordinate shifts when vertex coordinates change reference frames.
  - Consolidates submesh materials: resolves donor material `material = materialCount > 0 ? materials[Math.Clamp(face.submeshIndex, 0, materialCount - 1)] : null`. Looks up `submeshIndex = materialMap.IndexOf(material)`. If found (`submeshIndex > -1`), assigns `newFace.submeshIndex = submeshIndex`. If absent and `material == null`, assigns `newFace.submeshIndex = 0`. If absent and material is non-null, sets `newFace.submeshIndex = materialMap.Count` and adds `material` to `materialMap`.
  - Appends `newFace` to `faces`.
  - Renumbers shared vertex indices: iterates `meshSharedVertices` and `meshSharedTextures`, constructs `new SharedVertex(sv)`, executes `nsv.ShiftIndexes(offset)`, and appends to `sharedVertices` and `sharedTextures`.
  - Increments index tracker: `offset += meshVertexCount`.

3. Vertex Limit Splitting (`SplitByMaxVertexCount` and `CreateMeshFromSplit`):
- Calculates `uint meshCount = System.Math.Max(1u, vertexCount / maxVertexCount)` and `submeshCount = faces.Max(x => x.submeshIndex) + 1`.
- If `meshCount < 2`, creates a single mesh via `ProBuilderMesh.Create(vertices, faces, sharedVertices, sharedTextures, new Material[submeshCount])`.
- If `meshCount >= 2`, extracts shared lookup dictionaries via `SharedVertex.GetSharedVertexLookup(sharedVertices, sharedVertexLookup)` and `SharedVertex.GetSharedVertexLookup(sharedTextures, sharedTextureLookup)`.
- Iterates through `faces`: if `mv.Count + face.distinctIndexes.Count > maxVertexCount`, flushes accumulated `mv` (vertices), `mf` (faces), and `remap` dictionary to a new mesh via `CreateMeshFromSplit()`, then clears the buffers. For each distinct index in `face.distinctIndexes`, adds vertex to `mv` and records remap index `remap.Add(i, mv.Count - 1)`. Adds `face` to `mf`.
- In `CreateMeshFromSplit`, updates `face.indexesInternal[i] = remap[face.indexesInternal[i]]`, calls `face.InvalidateCache()`, maps shared vertex indices to new local vertex indices, and calls `ProBuilderMesh.Create()`.

        /// <summary>
        /// Break a ProBuilder mesh into multiple meshes if it's vertex count is greater than maxVertexCount.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        internal static List<ProBuilderMesh> SplitByMaxVertexCount(IList<Vertex> vertices, IList<Face> faces, IList<SharedVertex> sharedVertices, IList<SharedVertex> sharedTextures, uint maxVertexCount = ProBuilderMesh.maxVertexCount)
        {
            uint vertexCount = (uint)vertices.Count;
            uint meshCount = System.Math.Max(1u, vertexCount / maxVertexCount);
            var submeshCount = faces.Max(x => x.submeshIndex) + 1;

            if (meshCount < 2)
                return new List<ProBuilderMesh>() { ProBuilderMesh.Create(vertices, faces, sharedVertices, sharedTextures, new Material[submeshCount]) };

            var sharedVertexLookup = new Dictionary<int, int>();
            SharedVertex.GetSharedVertexLookup(sharedVertices, sharedVertexLookup);

            var sharedTextureLookup = new Dictionary<int, int>();
            SharedVertex.GetSharedVertexLookup(sharedTextures, sharedTextureLookup);

            var meshes = new List<ProBuilderMesh>();
            var mv = new List<Vertex>();
            var mf = new List<Face>();
            var remap = new Dictionary<int, int>();

            foreach (var face in faces)
            {
                if (mv.Count + face.distinctIndexes.Count > maxVertexCount)
                {
                    // finalize mesh
                    meshes.Add(CreateMeshFromSplit(mv, mf, sharedVertexLookup, sharedTextureLookup, remap, new Material[submeshCount]));
                    mv.Clear();
                    mf.Clear();
                    remap.Clear();
                }

                foreach (int i in face.distinctIndexes)
                {
                    mv.Add(vertices[i]);
                    remap.Add(i, mv.Count - 1);
                }

                mf.Add(face);
            }

            if (mv.Count > 0)
                meshes.Add(CreateMeshFromSplit(mv, mf, sharedVertexLookup, sharedTextureLookup, remap, new Material[submeshCount]));

            return meshes;
        }
	}

### MIRROR

The `MirrorObjects` menu action (located in `Editor/MenuActions/Object/MirrorObjects.cs`) duplicates or in-place reflects selected `ProBuilderMesh` objects across specified local Cartesian axes (X, Y, Z), accounting for coordinate space chirality, normal reversal, and UV orientation.

1. Settings and Bitmask Representation:
- Defines enum `MirrorSettings`: `[System.Flags] enum MirrorSettings { X = 0x1, Y = 0x2, Z = 0x4, Duplicate = 0x8 }`.
- Persists preferences via `Pref<MirrorSettings> m_MirrorAxes = new Pref<MirrorSettings>("MirrorObjects.mirrorAxes", MirrorSettings.X)`.
- Toolbar metadata: `group` returns `ToolbarGroup.Object`, `iconPath` returns `"Toolbar/Object_Mirror"`, `tooltip` returns `"Mirror Objects\nMirroring objects will duplicate and flip objects on the specified axes."`.
- Property `enabled` returns `base.enabled && MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount > 0`.
- `optionsMenuState` returns `MenuActionState.VisibleAndEnabled`.

2. UI Presentation (`CreateSettingsContent` and `OnSettingsGUI`):
- VisualElement UI creates four `Toggle` elements for X, Y, Z, and Duplicate.
- Toggling any axis modifies `m_MirrorAxes` via bitwise combination and invokes `PreviewActionManager.UpdatePreview()`.
- IMGUI `OnSettingsGUI()` displays an info `HelpBox`, renders `EditorGUILayout.Toggle()` fields for each flag inside an `EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck()` block, and renders a 'Mirror' button executing `EditorUtility.ShowNotification(PerformAction().notification)`.

3. Execution Flow (`PerformActionImplementation()`):
- Constructs reflection scale vector `scale`:
  - `scale.x = (m_MirrorAxes & MirrorSettings.X) > 0 ? -1f : 1f;`
  - `scale.y = (m_MirrorAxes & MirrorSettings.Y) > 0 ? -1f : 1f;`
  - `scale.z = (m_MirrorAxes & MirrorSettings.Z) > 0 ? -1f : 1f;`
- Extracts `bool duplicate = (m_MirrorAxes & MirrorSettings.Duplicate) != 0;`.
- For each `ProBuilderMesh pb` in `MeshSelection.topInternal`, invokes `Mirror(pb, scale, duplicate)` and collects resulting GameObjects into `res`.
- Updates selection: `MeshSelection.SetSelection(res); PreviewActionManager.selectionUpdateDisabled = true; ProBuilderEditor.Refresh();`.

4. Mirroring Algorithm (`Mirror(ProBuilderMesh pb, Vector3 scale, bool duplicate = true)`):
- If `duplicate` is true:
  - Instantiates clone: `mirroredObject = Object.Instantiate(pb.gameObject, pb.transform.parent, false).GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>()`.
  - Detaches shared mesh instance: `mirroredObject.MakeUnique()`.
  - Synchronizes parent transform and rotation: `mirroredObject.transform.parent = pb.transform.parent; mirroredObject.transform.localRotation = pb.transform.localRotation;`.
  - Registers undo: `Undo.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(mirroredObject.gameObject, "Mirror Object")`.
- If `duplicate` is false:
  - Registers object modification undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(pb, "Mirror")`.
  - Assigns `mirroredObject = pb`.
- Caches original local scale: `Vector3 lScale = mirroredObject.gameObject.transform.localScale;`.
- Applies reflection scale: `mirroredObject.transform.localScale = scale;`.
- Chirality / Winding Order Correction: Checks if reflection determinant is negative via `(scale.x * scale.y * scale.z) < 0`. If flipping across an odd number of axes (1 or 3 axes), the geometric handedness is reversed. To prevent surface normals from facing inward, it inverts the triangle winding order of every face: `foreach (var face in mirroredObject.facesInternal) face.Reverse();`.
- Bakes transform scale into vertex positions: calls `mirroredObject.FreezeScaleTransform()`, which multiplies local vertex positions by `transform.localScale` and resets scale to `(1, 1, 1)`.
- Restores original local scale: `mirroredObject.transform.localScale = lScale;`.
- Finalizes mesh: calls `mirroredObject.ToMesh()`, `mirroredObject.Refresh()`, and `mirroredObject.Optimize()`.

        public static ProBuilderMesh Mirror(ProBuilderMesh pb, Vector3 scale, bool duplicate = true)
        {
            ProBuilderMesh mirroredObject;

            if (duplicate)
            {
                mirroredObject = Object.Instantiate(pb.gameObject, pb.transform.parent, false).GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>();
                mirroredObject.MakeUnique();
                mirroredObject.transform.parent = pb.transform.parent;
                mirroredObject.transform.localRotation = pb.transform.localRotation;
                Undo.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(mirroredObject.gameObject, "Mirror Object");
            }
            else
            {
                UndoUtility.RecordObject(pb, "Mirror");
                mirroredObject = pb;
            }

            Vector3 lScale = mirroredObject.gameObject.transform.localScale;
            mirroredObject.transform.localScale = scale;

            // if flipping on an odd number of axes, flip winding order
            if ((scale.x * scale.y * scale.z) < 0)
            {
                foreach (var face in mirroredObject.facesInternal)
                    face.Reverse();
            }

            mirroredObject.FreezeScaleTransform();
            mirroredObject.transform.localScale = lScale;

            mirroredObject.ToMesh();
            mirroredObject.Refresh();
            mirroredObject.Optimize();

            return mirroredObject;
        }

> **Godot Note:** In Godot 4, mirroring geometry is performed by transforming vertex arrays by `Transform3D.FLIP_X`, `Transform3D.FLIP_Y`, or `Transform3D.FLIP_Z`. When determinant of `Basis` is negative (`basis.determinant() < 0`), triangle indices in the `ArrayMesh` surface must be reversed (`indices.invert()`) to maintain outward facing normal vectors.

### FREEZE TRANSFORM

The `FreezeTransform` menu action (located in `Editor/MenuActions/Object/FreezeTransform.cs`) resets an object's world transform component (position to `(0,0,0)`, rotation to identity, scale to `(1,1,1)`) while baking the existing transform matrix directly into vertex positions, keeping the mesh static in scene space.

1. Parity and Scale Detection:
- Method `ShouldFlipFaces(Vector3 scale)` calculates parity: `var globalSign = Mathf.Sign(scale.x) * Mathf.Sign(scale.y) * Mathf.Sign(scale.z); return globalSign < 0;`.
- If negative scale parity exists across the transform hierarchy, triangle winding must be reversed to preserve surface orientation.

2. Freeze Pipeline (`PerformActionImplementation()`):
- Returns `ActionResult.NoSelection` if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1`.
- Registers undo snapshot: `UndoUtility.RecordMeshAndTransformSelection("Freeze Transforms")`.
- Captures current vertex positions in world space across all selected meshes: `positions[i] = selection[i].VerticesInWorldSpace()` where `VerticesInWorldSpace()` projects local vertex coordinates through `transform.TransformPoint()`.
- For each `ProBuilderMesh pb` in `selection`:
  - Determines parity flip requirement: `bool flipFaces = ShouldFlipFaces(pb.transform.localScale);`.
  - Clears transform position and rotation: `pb.transform.SetPositionAndRotation(Vector3.zero, Quaternion.identity);`.
  - Clears transform scale: `pb.transform.localScale = Vector3.one;`.
  - Adjusts UV projection and face winding: iterates `pb.facesInternal`, flags `face.manualUV = true` (to freeze UV coordinates in place and prevent automated planar projection from shifting), and calls `face.Reverse()` if `flipFaces` is true.
  - Assigns captured world-space positions directly into the mesh: `pb.positions = positions[i];`.
  - Rebuilds geometry: calls `pb.ToMesh()`, `pb.Refresh()`, and `pb.Optimize()`.
- Updates UI: `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(); SceneView.RepaintAll();`.

### CENTER PIVOT

The `CenterPivot` menu action (located in `Editor/MenuActions/Object/CenterPivot.cs`) moves the pivot point of each selected `ProBuilderMesh` to the geometric center of its mesh bounding box, translating vertex positions in local space so that the object does not move in world space.

1. Hierarchy Preservation and Execution Pipeline (`CenterPivot.PerformActionImplementation()`):
- Returns `ActionResult.NoSelection` if `MeshSelection.selectedObjectCount < 1`.
- Registers complete undo state for both the `ProBuilderMesh` component and its `Transform` component across all selected objects via `UndoUtility.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(objects, "Center Pivot")`.
- For each `mesh` in `MeshSelection.topInternal`:
  - Unparents child transforms: calls `TransformUtility.UnparentChildren(mesh.transform)` to prevent children from moving when the parent's pivot changes.
  - Executes pivot centering: calls `mesh.CenterPivot(null)`.
  - Optimizes geometry: calls `mesh.Optimize()`.
  - Reparents child transforms: calls `TransformUtility.ReparentChildren(mesh.transform)`.
- Updates editor state via `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.

2. Pivot Calculation and Vertex Translation (`MeshTransform.CenterPivot(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, int[] indexes)`):
- Located in `Runtime/MeshOperations/MeshTransform.cs`.
- If `indexes == null || indexes.Length == 0`:
  - Computes center from mesh bounds: `center = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(mesh.mesh.bounds.center)`.
- If specific vertex indices are supplied in `indexes`:
  - Averages vertex positions: accumulates positions from `mesh.positionsInternal` and computes `center = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(center / (float)indexes.Length)`.
- Computes displacement vector: `Vector3 dir = (mesh.transform.position - center)`.
- Sets transform position to new center: `mesh.transform.position = center`.
- Compensates vertex positions in opposite direction: calls `mesh.ToMesh()` and `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, dir)` to maintain world-space geometric integrity.
- Updates normals and mesh buffers: calls `mesh.Refresh()`.

        public static void CenterPivot(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, int[] indexes)
        {
            if (mesh == null)
                throw new System.ArgumentNullException("mesh");

            Vector3 center = Vector3.zero;

            if (indexes != null && indexes.Length > 0)
            {
                Vector3[] positions = mesh.positionsInternal;

                if (positions == null || positions.Length < 3)
                    return;

                foreach (int i in indexes)
                    center += positions[i];

                center = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(center / (float)indexes.Length);
            }
            else
            {
                center = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(mesh.mesh.bounds.center);
            }

            Vector3 dir = (mesh.transform.position - center);

            mesh.transform.position = center;

            mesh.ToMesh();
```
